## File: activate.php

```php
<?php
require_once 'config.php';

if (isset($_GET['token'])) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT id FROM users 
                            WHERE activation_token = ? 
                            AND activation_expires > NOW()");
        $stmt->execute([$_GET['token']]);
        
        if ($stmt->rowCount() == 1) {
            $user_id = $stmt->fetchColumn();
            
            $db->prepare("UPDATE users SET 
                        activated = 1,
                        activation_token = NULL,
                        activation_expires = NULL
                        WHERE id = ?")
              ->execute([$user_id]);
            
            echo "Konto erfolgreich aktiviert! <a href='login.php'>Zum Login</a>";
        } else {
            echo "Ungültiger oder abgelaufener Aktivierungslink";
        }
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Activation Error: ".$e->getMessage());
        die("Aktivierungsfehler");
    }
} else {
    header("Location: register.php");
    exit();
}
```


## File: add_question.php

```php
<?php
session_start();
require_once '../config.php';

checkUserRole(ROLE_ADMIN);

$message = '';
$messageType = 'info';

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    $question_text = trim($_POST['question_text'] ?? '');
    $explanation = trim($_POST['explanation'] ?? '');
    $category_ids = $_POST['category_id'] ?? [];
    $answers = $_POST['answers'] ?? [];
    $correct_answer = $_POST['correct_answer'] ?? null;

    // Validierung
    $errors = [];
    
    if (empty($question_text)) {
        $errors[] = "Bitte geben Sie einen Fragetext ein.";
    }
    
    if (empty($category_ids)) {
        $errors[] = "Bitte wählen Sie mindestens eine Kategorie aus.";
    }
    
    // Leere Antworten entfernen
    $answers = array_filter($answers, function($answer) {
        return !empty(trim($answer));
    });
    
    if (count($answers) < 2) {
        $errors[] = "Bitte geben Sie mindestens 2 Antworten ein.";
    }
    
    if ($correct_answer === null || $correct_answer === '') {
        $errors[] = "Bitte markieren Sie eine richtige Antwort.";
    }

    if (!empty($errors)) {
        $message = implode('<br>', $errors);
        $messageType = 'danger';
    } else {
        try {
            $db->beginTransaction();

            $stmt = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO questions (question_text, explanation) VALUES (?, ?)");
            $stmt->execute([$question_text, $explanation]);
            $question_id = $db->lastInsertId();

            $stmt = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO question_categories (question_id, category_id) VALUES (?, ?)");
            foreach ($category_ids as $category_id) {
                $stmt->execute([$question_id, $category_id]);
            }

            // Antworten neu indizieren
            $answers = array_values($answers);
            foreach ($answers as $index => $answer_text) {
                $is_correct = ($index == $correct_answer) ? 1 : 0;
                $stmt = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO answers (question_id, answer_text, is_correct) VALUES (?, ?, ?)");
                $stmt->execute([$question_id, trim($answer_text), $is_correct]);
            }

            $db->commit();
            $message = "Frage erfolgreich hinzugefügt.";
            $messageType = 'success';
            
            // Formular zurücksetzen nach erfolgreichem Submit
            $_POST = [];
        } catch (PDOException $e) {
            $db->rollBack();
            $message = "Fehler beim Hinzufügen der Frage: " . $e->getMessage();
            $messageType = 'danger';
        }
    }
}

try {
    $stmt = $db->query("SELECT * FROM categories ORDER BY name");
    $categories = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
} catch (PDOException $e) {
    die("Fehler bei der Datenbankverbindung: " . $e->getMessage());
}
?>

    <script>
    let answerCounter = 0;

    function addAnswer() {
        const answersDiv = document.getElementById('answers');
        const answerCount = answersDiv.children.length;

        if (answerCount >= 4) {
            if (!confirm('Wirklich mehr als 4 Antworten hinzufügen?')) {
                return;
            }
        }

        answerCounter++;
        const newAnswer = document.createElement('div');
        newAnswer.classList.add('answer-group');
        newAnswer.innerHTML = `
            <div class="input-group">
                <input type="text" class="form-control" name="answers[]" placeholder="Antwort eingeben" required>
                <div class="input-group-append">
                    <div class="input-group-text">
                        <input type="radio" name="correct_answer" value="${answerCount}" required>
                        <span class="ml-2">Richtig</span>
                    </div>
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-danger btn-sm ml-2" onclick="removeAnswer(this)">
                        <i class="fas fa-trash"></i>
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>
        `;
        answersDiv.appendChild(newAnswer);
        updateDeleteButtons();
    }

    function removeAnswer(button) {
        const answersDiv = document.getElementById('answers');
        if (answersDiv.children.length > 1) {
            button.closest('.answer-group').remove();
            updateRadioValues();
            updateDeleteButtons();
        }
    }

    function updateRadioValues() {
        const answers = document.querySelectorAll('#answers .answer-group');
        answers.forEach((answer, index) => {
            answer.querySelector('input[type="radio"]').value = index;
        });
    }

    function updateDeleteButtons() {
        const answersDiv = document.getElementById('answers');
        const deleteButtons = answersDiv.querySelectorAll('button');
        deleteButtons.forEach(button => {
            button.disabled = answersDiv.children.length <= 1;
        });
    }

    // Formular-Validierung vor dem Submit
    document.getElementById('questionForm').addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
        const categories = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="category_id[]"]:checked');
        
        if (categories.length === 0) {
            e.preventDefault();
            alert('Bitte wählen Sie mindestens eine Kategorie aus!');
            return false;
        }

        const correctAnswer = document.querySelector('input[name="correct_answer"]:checked');
        if (!correctAnswer) {
            e.preventDefault();
            alert('Bitte markieren Sie eine richtige Antwort!');
            return false;
        }

        return true;
    });
    </script>
</body>
</html>https://quiz.sheiner.de/admin/add_question.php
```

```php
<?php
session_start();
require_once '../config.php';

// Überprüfen, ob der Benutzer angemeldet ist und die Rolle Admin hat
if (!isset($_SESSION['user_role']) || $_SESSION['user_role'] !== ROLE_ADMIN) {
    die("Zugriff verweigert. Nur Administratoren können diese Seite aufrufen.");
}

$message = '';

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    $username = trim($_POST['username']);
    $first_name = trim($_POST['first_name']);
    $last_name = trim($_POST['last_name']);
    $email = trim($_POST['email']);
    $password = password_hash($_POST['password'], PASSWORD_DEFAULT);
    $role = $_POST['role'];

    try {
        $db = new PDO("mysql:host=" . DB_HOST . ";dbname=" . DB_NAME, DB_USER, DB_PASS);
        $db->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);

        $stmt = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO users (username, first_name, last_name, email, password, role) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)");
        $stmt->execute([$username, $first_name, $last_name, $email, $password, $role]);

        $message = "Benutzer erfolgreich erstellt.";
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        $message = "Fehler beim Erstellen des Benutzers: " . $e->getMessage();
    }
}
?>
```

```php
        backToTopButton.style.display = "block";
    } else {
        backToTopButton.style.display = "none";
    }
}

    document.body.scrollTop = 0;
    document.documentElement.scrollTop = 0;
}

    $('.list-group-item').click(function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();

        $('#tableContainer').html('<div class="text-center mt-5"><div class="spinner-border text-primary" role="status"><span class="sr-only">Laden...</span></div><p class="mt-2">Lade Daten...</p></div>');

        $.ajax({
```

```php
<?php
require_once '../../config.php';

ini_set('display_errors', 1);
ini_set('display_startup_errors', 1);
error_reporting(E_ALL);

// Session starten
session_start();

// Überprüfen, ob der Benutzer angemeldet ist und die Rolle Admin hat
if (!isset($_SESSION['user_role']) || $_SESSION['user_role'] !== ROLE_ADMIN) {
    die("Zugriff verweigert. Sie haben keine Berechtigung, diese Seite zu sehen.");
}

// Funktion zum Escapen von Werten
function escape($value) {
    return str_replace(array("\\", "'", "\r", "\n"), array("\\\\", "\\'", "\\r", "\\n"), $value);
}

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    // Dateiname für den Dump
    $filename = 'database_dump_' . date('Y-m-d_H-i-s') . '.sql';

    // Header setzen, um den Download zu erzwingen
    header('Content-Type: application/octet-stream');
    header('Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="' . $filename . '"');

    // Tabellen auflisten
    $tables = array();
    $stmt = $db->query("SHOW TABLES");
    while ($row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_NUM)) {
        $tables[] = $row[0];
    }

    // Dump generieren
    foreach ($tables as $table) {
        // Tabellenstruktur
        $stmt = $db->query('SHOW CREATE TABLE ' . $table);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_NUM);
        echo "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `$table`;\n\n";
        echo $row[1] . ";\n\n";

        // Tabellendaten
        $stmt = $db->query('SELECT * FROM ' . $table);
        $num_fields = $stmt->columnCount();

        while ($row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_NUM)) {
            echo "INSERT INTO `$table` VALUES(";
            for ($j = 0; $j < $num_fields; $j++) {
                echo "'" . escape($row[$j]) . "'";
                if ($j < ($num_fields-1)) {
                    echo ',';
                }
            }
            echo ");\n";
        }
        echo "\n";
    }
    exit;
}
?>
```

```php
<?php
require_once '../../config.php';

ini_set('display_errors', 1);
ini_set('display_startup_errors', 1);
error_reporting(E_ALL);

// Session starten
session_start();

// Überprüfen, ob der Benutzer angemeldet ist und die Rolle Admin hat
if (!isset($_SESSION['user_role']) || $_SESSION['user_role'] !== ROLE_ADMIN) {
    die("Zugriff verweigert. Sie haben keine Berechtigung, diese Seite zu sehen.");
}

$message = '';

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    if (isset($_FILES['sql_file']) && $_FILES['sql_file']['error'] == 0) {
        $filename = $_FILES['sql_file']['tmp_name'];
        $handle = fopen($filename, "r+");
        $contents = fread($handle, filesize($filename));
        $sql = explode(';', $contents);
        fclose($handle);

        try {
            $db->beginTransaction();

            foreach($sql as $query) {
                $query = trim($query);
                if (!empty($query)) {
                    $db->exec($query);
                }
            }

            $db->commit();
            $message = "Import erfolgreich abgeschlossen.";
        } catch (PDOException $e) {
            $db->rollBack();
            $message = "Fehler beim Ausführen der Abfrage: " . $e->getMessage();
        }
    } else {
        $message = "Fehler beim Hochladen der Datei.";
    }
}
?>
```

## File: load_table.php

```php
<?php
require_once '../../config.php';

ini_set('display_errors', 1);
ini_set('display_startup_errors', 1);
error_reporting(E_ALL);

session_start();
checkUserRole(ROLE_ADMIN);

if (!isset($_POST['table'])) {
    http_response_code(400);
    echo "Keine Tabelle angegeben.";
    exit;
}

$table = $_POST['table'];

try {
    $db = new PDO("mysql:host=" . DB_HOST . ";dbname=" . DB_NAME, DB_USER, DB_PASS);
    $db->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);

    // Sicherheits-Check: nur erlaubte Tabellennamen (keine SQL-Injection möglich)
    $stmt = $db->prepare("SHOW TABLES LIKE ?");
    $stmt->execute([$table]);
    if ($stmt->rowCount() === 0) {
        http_response_code(404);
        echo "Tabelle nicht gefunden.";
        exit;
    }

    $stmt = $db->query("SELECT * FROM `$table` LIMIT 500"); // optional Limit, damit bei sehr großen Tabellen nicht alles geladen wird
    $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

    if (count($rows) > 0) {
        echo "<div class='table-responsive'>";
        echo "<table id='dynamicTable' class='table table-bordered display'>";
        echo "<thead class='thead-dark'><tr>";
        foreach ($rows[0] as $key => $value) {
            echo "<th scope='col'>" . htmlspecialchars($key) . "</th>";
        }
        echo "</tr></thead><tbody>";
        foreach ($rows as $row) {
            echo "<tr>";
            foreach ($row as $value) {
                echo "<td>" . htmlspecialchars($value ?? '', ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . "</td>";
            }
            echo "</tr>";
        }
        echo "</tbody></table>";
        echo "</div>";
    } else {
        echo "<div class='alert alert-warning'>Keine Daten in dieser Tabelle.</div>";
    }

} catch (PDOException $e) {
    echo "<div class='alert alert-danger'>Fehler: " . $e->getMessage() . "</div>";
}
?>
```

```php
// Nur POST-Requests erlauben
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
    http_response_code(405); // Method Not Allowed
    exit;
}

// CSRF-Token Validierung
if (!isset($_POST['csrf_token']) || $_POST['csrf_token'] !== $_SESSION['csrf_token']) {
    die("CSRF-Token ungültig");
}

// Validierung der Question-ID

if (!$questionId || $questionId < 1) {
    die("Ungültige Frage-ID");
}

try {
    // Soft-Delete durchführen
    $stmt = $db->prepare("
        UPDATE questions 
        SET deleted_at = NOW() 
        WHERE id = :question_id
        AND deleted_at IS NULL
    ");
    
    $stmt->execute([':question_id' => $questionId]);
    
    // Erfolgsmeldung mit Session speichern
    $_SESSION['success_message'] = "Frage #$questionId wurde gelöscht";
    
} catch (PDOException $e) {
    error_log("Database Error: " . $e->getMessage());
    die("Ein Datenbankfehler ist aufgetreten");
}

// Redirect zurück
header("Location: manage_questions.php");
exit;
```

## File: dublettencheck.php

```php
<?php
ini_set('display_errors', 1);
ini_set('display_startup_errors', 1);
error_reporting(E_ALL);
session_start();

require_once __DIR__.'/../config.php';

// Admin-Check
if (!isset($_SESSION['user_role']) || $_SESSION['user_role'] !== ROLE_ADMIN) {
    header('Location: ../../login.php');
    exit;
}

// CSRF-Token Handling
if (empty($_SESSION['csrf_token'])) {
    $_SESSION['csrf_token'] = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
}

define('BATCH_SIZE', 50);
$isAjax = !empty($_SERVER['HTTP_X_REQUESTED_WITH']) 
          && strtolower($_SERVER['HTTP_X_REQUESTED_WITH']) === 'xmlhttprequest';

// AJAX Handler
if ($isAjax && $_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    try {
        if ($_POST['action'] === 'init_scan') {
            $total = $db->query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM questions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL")->fetchColumn();
            $_SESSION['scan_status'] = [
                'total' => $total,
                'processed' => 0,
                'current_offset' => 0,
                'found' => 0
            ];
            echo json_encode(['total' => $total]);
            exit;
        }

        if ($_POST['action'] === 'process_batch' && isset($_SESSION['scan_status'])) {
            $db->beginTransaction();

            $stmt = $db->prepare("
                INSERT IGNORE INTO question_duplicate_checks (question_id, original_question_id, is_duplicate)
                SELECT q1.id, q2.id, 1
                FROM (
                    SELECT id, question_text 
                    FROM questions 
                    WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
                    ORDER BY id
                    LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset
                ) q1
                INNER JOIN questions q2 
                    ON q1.id < q2.id
                    AND SOUNDEX(q1.question_text) = SOUNDEX(q2.question_text)
                    AND q2.deleted_at IS NULL
                WHERE NOT EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM question_duplicate_checks
                    WHERE question_id = q1.id 
                      AND original_question_id = q2.id
                )
            ");

            $stmt->execute([
                ':limit' => BATCH_SIZE,
                ':offset' => $_SESSION['scan_status']['current_offset']
            ]);

            $affected = $stmt->rowCount();
            $_SESSION['scan_status']['processed'] += BATCH_SIZE;
            $_SESSION['scan_status']['current_offset'] += BATCH_SIZE;
            $_SESSION['scan_status']['found'] += $affected;

            $db->commit();
            
            echo json_encode([ 
                'processed' => min($_SESSION['scan_status']['processed'], $_SESSION['scan_status']['total']),
                'total' => $_SESSION['scan_status']['total'],
                'found' => $_SESSION['scan_status']['found']
            ]);
            exit;
        }
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        $db->rollBack();
        http_response_code(500);
        echo json_encode(['error' => $e->getMessage()]);
        exit;
    }
}


// Zusammenführungslogik optimiert
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST' && isset($_POST['merge'])) {
    try {
        // CSRF Token Validierung
        if (!hash_equals($_SESSION['csrf_token'], $_POST['csrf_token'])) {
            throw new Exception("CSRF Fehler");
        }

        $db->beginTransaction();

        // Validierung der erforderlichen Felder
        $required = ['dup_id', 'orig_id', 'question_text', 'explanation', 'categories', 'answers'];
        foreach ($required as $field) {
            if (empty($_POST[$field])) {
                throw new Exception("Fehlendes Feld: $field");
            }
        }

        // Überprüfung und Validierung der Antworten
        if (empty($_POST['answers']) || !is_array($_POST['answers'])) {
            throw new Exception("Keine gültigen Antworten angegeben.");
        }

        // Überprüfung, ob die Antworten existieren und gültig sind
        $answers = implode(',', array_map('intval', $_POST['answers']));
        if (empty($answers)) {
            throw new Exception("Keine gültigen Antworten gefunden.");
        }

        // Antworten der ursprünglichen Frage aktualisieren
        // Zuerst löschen wir die alten Antworten
        $db->exec("DELETE FROM answers WHERE question_id = " . (int)$_POST['orig_id']);
        
        // Dann fügen wir die Antworten von der doppelten Frage hinzu
        $db->exec("
            INSERT INTO answers (question_id, answer_text, is_correct)
            SELECT " . (int)$_POST['orig_id'] . ", answer_text, is_correct
            FROM answers
            WHERE id IN ($answers)
        ");

        // Kategorien der ursprünglichen Frage löschen
        $db->exec("DELETE FROM question_categories WHERE question_id = " . (int)$_POST['orig_id']);
        
        // Kategorien für die neue Frage hinzufügen
        $categories = implode(',', array_map('intval', $_POST['categories']));
        if (!empty($categories)) {
            $db->exec("
                INSERT INTO question_categories (question_id, category_id)
                SELECT " . (int)$_POST['orig_id'] . ", id
                FROM categories
                WHERE id IN ($categories)
            ");
        }

        // Die Dublette als gelöscht markieren
        $db->exec("UPDATE questions SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE id = " . (int)$_POST['dup_id']);
        $db->exec("
            UPDATE question_duplicate_checks 
            SET confirmed = 1 
            WHERE question_id = " . (int)$_POST['dup_id'] . "
               OR original_question_id = " . (int)$_POST['dup_id'] . "
        ");

        $db->commit();
        $_SESSION['message'] = "Erfolgreich zusammengeführt!";
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        $db->rollBack();
        $_SESSION['message'] = "Fehler: " . $e->getMessage();
    }
    header("Location: " . $_SERVER['PHP_SELF']);
    exit;
}

// Mark as Valid Handling
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST' && isset($_POST['mark_as_valid'])) {
    try {
        // CSRF Token Validierung
        if (!hash_equals($_SESSION['csrf_token'], $_POST['csrf_token'])) {
            throw new Exception("CSRF Validation Failed");
        }

        $dupId = (int)$_POST['dup_id'];
        
        // Validierung, dass die Dublette existiert
        if ($dupId <= 0) {
            throw new Exception("Ungültige Dublette ID");
        }

        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            UPDATE question_duplicate_checks 
            SET confirmed = 1, 
                is_duplicate = 0,
                processed_at = NOW()
            WHERE (question_id = ? OR original_question_id = ?)
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$dupId, $dupId]);

        $_SESSION['message'] = "Als gültig markiert!";
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        $_SESSION['message'] = "Fehler: " . $e->getMessage();
    }
    header("Location: " . $_SERVER['PHP_SELF']);
    exit;
}


// Dubletten abfragen
$duplicates = [];
try {
    $duplicates = $db->query("
        SELECT 
            q.id AS dup_id,
            q.question_text AS dup_text,
            COALESCE(q.explanation, 'Keine Erklärung') AS dup_expl,
            o.id AS orig_id,
            o.question_text AS orig_text,
            COALESCE(o.explanation, 'Keine Erklärung') AS orig_expl,
            COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c1.id), '') AS dup_cat_ids,
            COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c1.name), '') AS dup_cats,
            COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c2.id), '') AS orig_cat_ids,
            COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c2.name), '') AS orig_cats
        FROM question_duplicate_checks qdc
        JOIN questions q ON qdc.question_id = q.id AND q.deleted_at IS NULL
        JOIN questions o ON qdc.original_question_id = o.id AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
        LEFT JOIN question_categories qc1 ON q.id = qc1.question_id
        LEFT JOIN categories c1 ON qc1.category_id = c1.id
        LEFT JOIN question_categories qc2 ON o.id = qc2.question_id
        LEFT JOIN categories c2 ON qc2.category_id = c2.id
        WHERE qdc.confirmed = 0
        GROUP BY q.id, o.id
        ORDER BY qdc.processed_at DESC
    ")->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
} catch (PDOException $e) {
    error_log("DB-Fehler: ".$e->getMessage());
}

function getAnswers(PDO $db, int $questionId): array {
    $stmt = $db->prepare("
        SELECT id, answer_text, is_correct 
        FROM answers 
        WHERE question_id = ?
        ORDER BY id
    ");
    $stmt->execute([$questionId]);
    return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
}
?>

    <script>
        document.getElementById('startScan').addEventListener('click', async () => {
            const progressContainer = document.getElementById('progressContainer');
            const progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
            const statusText = document.getElementById('statusText');
            const foundCount = document.getElementById('foundCount');

            progressContainer.style.display = 'block';
            
            try {
                const initRes = await fetch('', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {
                        'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
                        'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest'
                    },
                    body: new URLSearchParams({ action: 'init_scan' })
                });
                
                const { total } = await initRes.json();
                let processed = 0;
                let found = 0;

                const processBatch = async () => {
                    const res = await fetch('', {
                        method: 'POST',
                        headers: {
                            'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
                            'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest'
                        },
                        body: new URLSearchParams({ action: 'process_batch' })
                    });
                    
                    const data = await res.json();
                    processed = data.processed;
                    found = data.found;
                    
                    progressBar.style.width = `${(processed / total * 100).toFixed(1)}%`;
                    statusText.textContent = `Durchsuche ${processed} von ${total}`;
                    foundCount.textContent = `${found} Duplikate gefunden`;

                    if (processed < total) {
                        setTimeout(processBatch, 500);
                    } else {
                        progressContainer.style.display = 'none';
                        location.reload();
                    }
                };

                await processBatch();
            } catch (e) {
                alert('Error: ' + e.message);
                progressContainer.style.display = 'none';
            }
        });

        document.querySelectorAll('.merge-form').forEach(form => {
            form.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
                if (!confirm('Aktion bestätigen?')) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                }
            });
        });

        document.querySelectorAll('.form-check-input[type="checkbox"]').forEach((checkbox) => {
            checkbox.addEventListener('change', function() {
                const dupId = this.id.replace('selectAll', '').replace('Dup', '');  // Hole die Dublette-ID aus der Checkbox-ID
                
                if (this.id.includes('Dup')) {  // Wenn der Schalter für die Dublette ist
                    // Finde alle Checkboxen, die zur entsprechenden Dublette gehören
                    const checkboxesDup = document.querySelectorAll(`.merge-form[data-dup-id="${dupId}"] input[type="checkbox"]`);
                    checkboxesDup.forEach(cb => {
                        cb.checked = this.checked;  // Setze den Status der Checkboxen in der Dublette
                    });
                } else if (this.id.includes('Orig')) {  // Wenn der Schalter für das Original ist
                    // Finde alle Checkboxen, die zur entsprechenden Original gehören
                    const checkboxesOrig = document.querySelectorAll(`.merge-form[data-orig-id="${dupId}"] input[type="checkbox"]`);
                    checkboxesOrig.forEach(cb => {
                        cb.checked = this.checked;  // Setze den Status der Checkboxen im Original
                    });
                }
            });
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```php
<?php
ini_set('display_errors', 1);
ini_set('display_startup_errors', 1);
error_reporting(E_ALL);
session_start();

require_once __DIR__.'/../../config.php';

// Admin-Check
if (!isset($_SESSION['user_role']) || $_SESSION['user_role'] !== ROLE_ADMIN) {
    header('Location: ../../login.php');
    exit;
}

// Filter-Parameter
$filterAction = $_GET['action'] ?? '';
$filterUser = (int)($_GET['user_id'] ?? 0);
$filterDays = (int)($_GET['days'] ?? 7);
$page = max(1, (int)($_GET['page'] ?? 1));
$perPage = 50;
$offset = ($page - 1) * $perPage;

// Query Builder
$whereClauses = [];
$params = [];

if (!empty($filterAction)) {
    $whereClauses[] = "al.action = ?";
    $params[] = $filterAction;
}

if ($filterUser > 0) {
    $whereClauses[] = "al.user_id = ?";
    $params[] = $filterUser;
}

$whereClauses[] = "al.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL ? DAY)";
$params[] = $filterDays;

$whereSQL = !empty($whereClauses) ? 'WHERE ' . implode(' AND ', $whereClauses) : '';

// Audit Logs laden
try {
    // Gesamt-Anzahl für Pagination
    $countStmt = $db->prepare("
        SELECT COUNT(*) 
        FROM audit_log al
        $whereSQL
    ");
    $countStmt->execute($params);
    $totalLogs = $countStmt->fetchColumn();
    $totalPages = ceil($totalLogs / $perPage);

    // Logs laden
    $stmt = $db->prepare("
        SELECT 
            al.*,
            u.username,
            u.email
        FROM audit_log al
        LEFT JOIN users u ON al.user_id = u.id
        $whereSQL
        ORDER BY al.created_at DESC
        LIMIT $perPage OFFSET $offset
    ");
    $stmt->execute($params);
    $logs = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

    // Verfügbare User für Filter
    $users = $db->query("
        SELECT DISTINCT u.id, u.username 
        FROM users u
        INNER JOIN audit_log al ON u.id = al.user_id
        ORDER BY u.username
    ")->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

    // Statistiken
    $stats = $db->prepare("
        SELECT 
            al.action,
            COUNT(*) as count,
            COUNT(DISTINCT al.user_id) as unique_users
        FROM audit_log al
        WHERE al.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL ? DAY)
        GROUP BY al.action
        ORDER BY count DESC
    ");
    $stats->execute([$filterDays]);
    $statistics = $stats->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

} catch (PDOException $e) {
    error_log("Audit Log Error: " . $e->getMessage());
    $logs = [];
    $users = [];
    $statistics = [];
    $totalPages = 0;
}

// Action Labels
$actionLabels = [
    'merge' => ['label' => 'Zusammenführung', 'class' => 'success'],
    'undo_merge' => ['label' => 'Rückgängig', 'class' => 'warning'],
    'mark_valid' => ['label' => 'Als gültig markiert', 'class' => 'info'],
    'delete' => ['label' => 'Gelöscht', 'class' => 'danger'],
    'create' => ['label' => 'Erstellt', 'class' => 'primary'],
    'update' => ['label' => 'Bearbeitet', 'class' => 'secondary']
];

function formatDetails($details) {
    if (empty($details)) return '-';
    
    $data = json_decode($details, true);
    if (!$data) return '-';
    
    $output = '<ul class="mb-0 small">';
    foreach ($data as $key => $value) {
        $key = htmlspecialchars($key);
        if (is_array($value) || is_object($value)) {
            $value = json_encode($value);
        }
        $value = htmlspecialchars($value);
        $output .= "<li><strong>$key:</strong> $value</li>";
    }
    $output .= '</ul>';
    
    return $output;
}
```

## File: duplicate_check.php

```php
<?php
ini_set('display_errors', 1);
ini_set('display_startup_errors', 1);
error_reporting(E_ALL);
session_start();

require_once __DIR__.'/../../config.php';

// Admin-Check
if (!isset($_SESSION['user_role']) || $_SESSION['user_role'] !== ROLE_ADMIN) {
    header('Location: ../../login.php');
    exit;
}

// CSRF-Token Handling
if (empty($_SESSION['csrf_token'])) {
    $_SESSION['csrf_token'] = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
}

define('BATCH_SIZE', 50);
$isAjax = !empty($_SERVER['HTTP_X_REQUESTED_WITH']) 
          && strtolower($_SERVER['HTTP_X_REQUESTED_WITH']) === 'xmlhttprequest';

// AJAX Handler
if ($isAjax && $_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    try {
        if ($_POST['action'] === 'init_scan') {
            $total = $db->query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM questions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL")->fetchColumn();
            $_SESSION['scan_status'] = [
                'total' => $total,
                'processed' => 0,
                'current_offset' => 0,
                'found' => 0
            ];
            echo json_encode(['total' => $total]);
            exit;
        }

        if ($_POST['action'] === 'process_batch' && isset($_SESSION['scan_status'])) {
            $db->beginTransaction();

            $stmt = $db->prepare("
                INSERT IGNORE INTO question_duplicate_checks (question_id, original_question_id, is_duplicate)
                SELECT q1.id, q2.id, 1
                FROM (
                    SELECT id, question_text 
                    FROM questions 
                    WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
                    ORDER BY id
                    LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset
                ) q1
                INNER JOIN questions q2 
                    ON q1.id < q2.id
                    AND SOUNDEX(q1.question_text) = SOUNDEX(q2.question_text)
                    AND q2.deleted_at IS NULL
                WHERE NOT EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM question_duplicate_checks
                    WHERE question_id = q1.id 
                      AND original_question_id = q2.id
                )
            ");

            $stmt->execute([
                ':limit' => BATCH_SIZE,
                ':offset' => $_SESSION['scan_status']['current_offset']
            ]);

            $affected = $stmt->rowCount();
            $_SESSION['scan_status']['processed'] += BATCH_SIZE;
            $_SESSION['scan_status']['current_offset'] += BATCH_SIZE;
            $_SESSION['scan_status']['found'] += $affected;

            $db->commit();
            
            echo json_encode([ 
                'processed' => min($_SESSION['scan_status']['processed'], $_SESSION['scan_status']['total']),
                'total' => $_SESSION['scan_status']['total'],
                'found' => $_SESSION['scan_status']['found']
            ]);
            exit;
        }

        // AJAX: Undo durchführen
        if ($_POST['action'] === 'undo_merge' && !empty($_POST['archive_id'])) {
            $archiveId = (int)$_POST['archive_id'];
            
            if (!hash_equals($_SESSION['csrf_token'], $_POST['csrf_token'] ?? '')) {
                throw new Exception("CSRF Fehler");
            }

            $db->beginTransaction();

            // Archive-Eintrag laden
            $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT * FROM questions_archive WHERE id = ? AND archived_by = ?");
            $stmt->execute([$archiveId, $_SESSION['user_id']]);
            $archived = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

            if (!$archived) {
                throw new Exception("Archiv-Eintrag nicht gefunden oder keine Berechtigung");
            }

            // Frage wiederherstellen
            $stmt = $db->prepare("
                INSERT INTO questions (id, question_text, explanation, created_at, updated_at)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            ");
            $stmt->execute([
                $archived['original_question_id'],
                $archived['question_text'],
                $archived['explanation'],
                $archived['created_at'],
                $archived['updated_at']
            ]);

            // Antworten wiederherstellen
            $answers = json_decode($archived['answers_backup'], true);
            if ($answers) {
                $stmt = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO answers (question_id, answer_text, is_correct) VALUES (?, ?, ?)");
                foreach ($answers as $answer) {
                    $stmt->execute([$archived['original_question_id'], $answer['answer_text'], $answer['is_correct']]);
                }
            }

            // Kategorien wiederherstellen
            $categories = json_decode($archived['categories_backup'], true);
            if ($categories) {
                $stmt = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO question_categories (question_id, category_id) VALUES (?, ?)");
                foreach ($categories as $catId) {
                    $stmt->execute([$archived['original_question_id'], $catId]);
                }
            }

            // Duplicate-Check zurücksetzen
            $stmt = $db->prepare("
                UPDATE question_duplicate_checks 
                SET confirmed = 0 
                WHERE question_id = ? OR original_question_id = ?
            ");
            $stmt->execute([$archived['original_question_id'], $archived['original_question_id']]);

            // Archive-Eintrag als wiederhergestellt markieren
            $stmt = $db->prepare("UPDATE questions_archive SET restored_at = NOW() WHERE id = ?");
            $stmt->execute([$archiveId]);

            // Audit Log
            $stmt = $db->prepare("
                INSERT INTO audit_log (user_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, details, created_at)
                VALUES (?, 'undo_merge', 'question', ?, ?, NOW())
            ");
            $stmt->execute([
                $_SESSION['user_id'],
                $archived['original_question_id'],
                json_encode(['archive_id' => $archiveId])
            ]);

            $db->commit();
            
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Erfolgreich rückgängig gemacht']);
            exit;
        }
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        if ($db->inTransaction()) {
            $db->rollBack();
        }
        http_response_code(500);
        echo json_encode(['error' => $e->getMessage()]);
        exit;
    }
}


// Zusammenführungslogik mit Backup und Audit
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST' && isset($_POST['merge'])) {
    try {
        // CSRF Token Validierung
        if (!hash_equals($_SESSION['csrf_token'], $_POST['csrf_token'])) {
            throw new Exception("CSRF Fehler");
        }

        $db->beginTransaction();

        // Validierung der erforderlichen Felder
        $dupId = (int)$_POST['dup_id'];
        $origId = (int)$_POST['orig_id'];
        
        if ($dupId <= 0 || $origId <= 0) {
            throw new Exception("Ungültige IDs");
        }

        // Backup der Dublette BEVOR sie gelöscht wird
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            SELECT q.*, 
                   (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('answer_text', answer_text, 'is_correct', is_correct))
                    FROM answers WHERE question_id = q.id) as answers_json,
                   (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(category_id)
                    FROM question_categories WHERE question_id = q.id) as categories_json
            FROM questions q 
            WHERE q.id = ? AND q.deleted_at IS NULL
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$dupId]);
        $dupData = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        if (!$dupData) {
            throw new Exception("Dublette nicht gefunden");
        }

        // In Archive speichern
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            INSERT INTO questions_archive (
                original_question_id, 
                merged_into_id,
                question_text, 
                explanation, 
                answers_backup, 
                categories_backup,
                created_at,
                updated_at,
                archived_at, 
                archived_by
            ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, NOW(), ?)
        ");
        $stmt->execute([
            $dupId,
            $origId,
            $dupData['question_text'],
            $dupData['explanation'],
            $dupData['answers_json'] ?? '[]',
            $dupData['categories_json'] ?? '[]',
            $dupData['created_at'],
            $dupData['updated_at'],
            $_SESSION['user_id']
        ]);

        $archiveId = $db->lastInsertId();

        // Frage-Text bestimmen
        $questionTextSource = $_POST['question_text'] ?? 'orig';
        $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT question_text FROM questions WHERE id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL");
        $stmt->execute([$questionTextSource === 'dup' ? $dupId : $origId]);
        $questionText = $stmt->fetchColumn();
        
        if (!$questionText) {
            throw new Exception("Fragentext nicht gefunden");
        }

        // Erklärung bestimmen
        $explanationSource = $_POST['explanation'] ?? 'orig';
        $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT explanation FROM questions WHERE id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL");
        $stmt->execute([$explanationSource === 'dup' ? $dupId : $origId]);
        $explanation = $stmt->fetchColumn();

        // Original-Frage aktualisieren
        $stmt = $db->prepare("UPDATE questions SET question_text = ?, explanation = ?, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$questionText, $explanation, $origId]);

        // Antworten verarbeiten
        if (!empty($_POST['answers']) && is_array($_POST['answers'])) {
            // Alte Antworten löschen
            $stmt = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM answers WHERE question_id = ?");
            $stmt->execute([$origId]);
            
            // Neue Antworten hinzufügen
            $answerIds = array_map('intval', $_POST['answers']);
            $placeholders = implode(',', array_fill(0, count($answerIds), '?'));
            
            $stmt = $db->prepare("
                INSERT INTO answers (question_id, answer_text, is_correct)
                SELECT ?, answer_text, is_correct
                FROM answers
                WHERE id IN ($placeholders)
            ");
            $stmt->execute(array_merge([$origId], $answerIds));
        }

        // Kategorien verarbeiten
        $stmt = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM question_categories WHERE question_id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$origId]);
        
        if (!empty($_POST['categories']) && is_array($_POST['categories'])) {
            $categoryIds = array_map('intval', $_POST['categories']);
            $stmt = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO question_categories (question_id, category_id) VALUES (?, ?)");
            
            foreach ($categoryIds as $catId) {
                if ($catId > 0) {
                    $stmt->execute([$origId, $catId]);
                }
            }
        }

        // Dublette als gelöscht markieren
        $stmt = $db->prepare("UPDATE questions SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$dupId]);
        
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            UPDATE question_duplicate_checks 
            SET confirmed = 1 
            WHERE question_id = ? OR original_question_id = ?
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$dupId, $dupId]);

        // Audit Log
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            INSERT INTO audit_log (user_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, details, created_at)
            VALUES (?, 'merge', 'question', ?, ?, NOW())
        ");
        $stmt->execute([
            $_SESSION['user_id'],
            $origId,
            json_encode([
                'merged_from' => $dupId,
                'archive_id' => $archiveId,
                'question_text_source' => $questionTextSource,
                'explanation_source' => $explanationSource,
                'answers_count' => count($_POST['answers'] ?? []),
                'categories_count' => count($_POST['categories'] ?? [])
            ])
        ]);

        // Logging
        error_log(sprintf(
            "Question Merge: User %d merged question %d into %d (Archive ID: %d)",
            $_SESSION['user_id'],
            $dupId,
            $origId,
            $archiveId
        ));

        $db->commit();
        $_SESSION['message'] = "Erfolgreich zusammengeführt! (Archiv-ID: $archiveId)";
        $_SESSION['last_merge_archive_id'] = $archiveId;
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        if ($db->inTransaction()) {
            $db->rollBack();
        }
        error_log("Merge Error: " . $e->getMessage());
        $_SESSION['message'] = "Fehler: " . $e->getMessage();
    }
    header("Location: " . $_SERVER['PHP_SELF']);
    exit;
}

// Mark as Valid Handling
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST' && isset($_POST['mark_as_valid'])) {
    try {
        // CSRF Token Validierung
        if (!hash_equals($_SESSION['csrf_token'], $_POST['csrf_token'])) {
            throw new Exception("CSRF Validation Failed");
        }

        $dupId = (int)$_POST['dup_id'];
        
        if ($dupId <= 0) {
            throw new Exception("Ungültige Dublette ID");
        }

        $db->beginTransaction();

        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            UPDATE question_duplicate_checks 
            SET confirmed = 1, 
                is_duplicate = 0,
                processed_at = NOW()
            WHERE question_id = ? OR original_question_id = ?
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$dupId, $dupId]);

        // Audit Log
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            INSERT INTO audit_log (user_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, details, created_at)
            VALUES (?, 'mark_valid', 'question', ?, ?, NOW())
        ");
        $stmt->execute([
            $_SESSION['user_id'],
            $dupId,
            json_encode(['marked_as_valid' => true])
        ]);

        $db->commit();

        error_log(sprintf(
            "Question marked as valid: User %d marked question %d as not duplicate",
            $_SESSION['user_id'],
            $dupId
        ));

        $_SESSION['message'] = "Als gültig markiert!";
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        if ($db->inTransaction()) {
            $db->rollBack();
        }
        error_log("Mark Valid Error: " . $e->getMessage());
        $_SESSION['message'] = "Fehler: " . $e->getMessage();
    }
    header("Location: " . $_SERVER['PHP_SELF']);
    exit;
}


// Dubletten abfragen
$duplicates = [];
try {
    $duplicates = $db->query("
        SELECT 
            q.id AS dup_id,
            q.question_text AS dup_text,
            COALESCE(q.explanation, 'Keine Erklärung') AS dup_expl,
            o.id AS orig_id,
            o.question_text AS orig_text,
            COALESCE(o.explanation, 'Keine Erklärung') AS orig_expl,
            COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c1.id), '') AS dup_cat_ids,
            COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c1.name), '') AS dup_cats,
            COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c2.id), '') AS orig_cat_ids,
            COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c2.name), '') AS orig_cats,
            qdc.processed_at
        FROM question_duplicate_checks qdc
        JOIN questions q ON qdc.question_id = q.id AND q.deleted_at IS NULL
        JOIN questions o ON qdc.original_question_id = o.id AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
        LEFT JOIN question_categories qc1 ON q.id = qc1.question_id
        LEFT JOIN categories c1 ON qc1.category_id = c1.id
        LEFT JOIN question_categories qc2 ON o.id = qc2.question_id
        LEFT JOIN categories c2 ON qc2.category_id = c2.id
        WHERE qdc.confirmed = 0
        GROUP BY q.id, o.id, qdc.processed_at
        ORDER BY qdc.processed_at DESC
    ")->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
} catch (PDOException $e) {
    error_log("DB-Fehler: ".$e->getMessage());
}

// Letzte Merges laden (für Undo-Funktion)
$recentMerges = [];
try {
    $stmt = $db->prepare("
        SELECT qa.*, u.username 
        FROM questions_archive qa
        LEFT JOIN users u ON qa.archived_by = u.id
        WHERE qa.archived_by = ? 
          AND qa.restored_at IS NULL
          AND qa.archived_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR)
        ORDER BY qa.archived_at DESC
        LIMIT 10
    ");
    $stmt->execute([$_SESSION['user_id']]);
    $recentMerges = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
} catch (PDOException $e) {
    error_log("Recent Merges Error: ".$e->getMessage());
}

function getAnswers(PDO $db, int $questionId): array {
    $stmt = $db->prepare("
        SELECT id, answer_text, is_correct 
        FROM answers 
        WHERE question_id = ?
        ORDER BY id
    ");
    $stmt->execute([$questionId]);
    return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
}

    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.0/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
    <script>
        const csrfToken = '<?= $_SESSION['csrf_token'] ?>';

        // Scan starten
        document.getElementById('startScan').addEventListener('click', async () => {
            const progressContainer = document.getElementById('progressContainer');
            const progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
            const statusText = document.getElementById('statusText');
            const foundCount = document.getElementById('foundCount');
            const startBtn = document.getElementById('startScan');

            startBtn.disabled = true;
            progressContainer.style.display = 'block';
            
            try {
                const initRes = await fetch('', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {
                        'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
                        'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest'
                    },
                    body: new URLSearchParams({ action: 'init_scan' })
                });
                
                if (!initRes.ok) throw new Error('Server Error');
                
                const { total } = await initRes.json();
                let processed = 0;
                let found = 0;

                const processBatch = async () => {
                    const res = await fetch('', {
                        method: 'POST',
                        headers: {
                            'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
                            'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest'
                        },
                        body: new URLSearchParams({ action: 'process_batch' })
                    });
                    
                    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Batch processing failed');
                    
                    const data = await res.json();
                    processed = data.processed;
                    found = data.found;
                    
                    const percentage = Math.min((processed / total * 100), 100).toFixed(1);
                    progressBar.style.width = `${percentage}%`;
                    progressBar.textContent = `${percentage}%`;
                    statusText.textContent = `Durchsuche ${processed} von ${total}`;
                    foundCount.textContent = `${found} Duplikate gefunden`;

                    if (processed < total) {
                        setTimeout(processBatch, 500);
                    } else {
                        setTimeout(() => {
                            progressContainer.style.display = 'none';
                            location.reload();
                        }, 1000);
                    }
                };

                await processBatch();
            } catch (e) {
                alert('Fehler beim Scan: ' + e.message);
                progressContainer.style.display = 'none';
                startBtn.disabled = false;
            }
        });

        // Undo-Funktion
        document.querySelectorAll('.undo-btn').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', async function() {
                const archiveId = this.dataset.archiveId;
                const questionId = this.dataset.questionId;
                
                if (!confirm(`Zusammenführung rückgängig machen?\nFrage #${questionId} wird wiederhergestellt.`)) {
                    return;
                }

                this.disabled = true;
                this.textContent = 'Wird ausgeführt...';

                try {
                    const res = await fetch('', {
                        method: 'POST',
                        headers: {
                            'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
                            'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest'
                        },
                        body: new URLSearchParams({
                            action: 'undo_merge',
                            archive_id: archiveId,
                            csrf_token: csrfToken
                        })
                    });

                    const data = await res.json();

                    if (res.ok && data.success) {
                        alert(data.message);
                        location.reload();
                    } else {
                        throw new Error(data.error || 'Unbekannter Fehler');
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    alert('Fehler beim Rückgängigmachen: ' + e.message);
                    this.disabled = false;
                    this.textContent = 'Rückgängig';
                }
            });
        });

        // Form Submit Bestätigung
        document.querySelectorAll('.merge-form').forEach(form => {
            form.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
                const isMarkValid = e.submitter && e.submitter.name === 'mark_as_valid';
                const message = isMarkValid 
                    ? 'Als gültig markieren? Die Dublette bleibt erhalten.' 
                    : 'Wirklich zusammenführen? Die Dublette wird gelöscht (kann 24h rückgängig gemacht werden).';
                
                if (!confirm(message)) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                }
            });
        });

        // Select All Toggle für Dublette
        document.querySelectorAll('.select-all-dup').forEach(toggle => {
            toggle.addEventListener('change', function() {
                const dupId = this.dataset.dupId;
                const form = this.closest('.merge-form');
                const checkboxes = form.querySelectorAll('[data-section="dup"]');
                
                checkboxes.forEach(cb => {
                    cb.checked = this.checked;
                });
            });
        });

        // Select All Toggle für Original
        document.querySelectorAll('.select-all-orig').forEach(toggle => {
            toggle.addEventListener('change', function() {
                const origId = this.dataset.origId;
                const form = this.closest('.merge-form');
                const checkboxes = form.querySelectorAll('[data-section="orig"]');
                
                checkboxes.forEach(cb => {
                    cb.checked = this.checked;
                });
            });
        });

        // Kategorie-Badge Click Handler
        document.querySelectorAll('.category-pill').forEach(label => {
            label.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                const checkbox = this.querySelector('.category-checkbox');
                if (e.target !== checkbox) {
                    checkbox.checked = !checkbox.checked;
                    e.preventDefault();
                }
            });
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```php
<?php
session_start();
require_once '../config.php';

checkUserRole(ROLE_MANAGER);

// ===== LOGGING-FUNKTIONEN =====
function logQuestionAction($db, $userId, $questionId, $action, $details = '') {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            INSERT INTO log_entries (user_id, type, action, entity_type, entity_id, details, created_at)
            VALUES (?, 'audit', ?, 'question', ?, ?, NOW())
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$userId, $action, $questionId, $details]);
        return true;
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Logging-Fehler: " . $e->getMessage());
        return false;
    }
}

function getQuestionLogs($db, $questionId) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            SELECT l.action, l.details, l.created_at, u.first_name, u.last_name
            FROM log_entries l
            LEFT JOIN users u ON l.user_id = u.id
            WHERE l.entity_type = 'question' AND l.entity_id = ?
            ORDER BY l.created_at DESC
            LIMIT 100
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$questionId]);
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Fehler beim Abrufen der Logs: " . $e->getMessage());
        return [];
    }
}

// ===== FUNKTIONEN =====
function getQuestion($db, $id) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT q.*, GROUP_CONCAT(qc.category_id) as category_ids 
                              FROM questions q 
                              LEFT JOIN question_categories qc ON q.id = qc.question_id 
                              WHERE q.id = ?
                              GROUP BY q.id");
        $stmt->execute([$id]);
        return $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Fehler beim Abrufen der Frage: " . $e->getMessage());
        return null;
    }
}

function getAnswers($db, $questionId) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT * FROM answers WHERE question_id = ? ORDER BY id");
        $stmt->execute([$questionId]);
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Fehler beim Abrufen der Antworten: " . $e->getMessage());
        return [];
    }
}

function getCategories($db) {   
    try {
        $stmt = $db->query("SELECT * FROM categories ORDER BY name");
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Fehler beim Abrufen der Kategorien: " . $e->getMessage());
        return [];
    }
}

function getCategoryNamesByIds($db, $ids) {
    if (empty($ids)) return [];
    try {
        $placeholders = implode(',', array_fill(0, count($ids), '?'));
        $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT name FROM categories WHERE id IN ($placeholders)");
        $stmt->execute(array_values($ids));
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_COLUMN);
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Fehler beim Abrufen der Kategorienamen: " . $e->getMessage());
        return [];
    }
}

function getReportsForQuestion($db, $questionId) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            SELECT r.*, u.first_name, u.last_name
            FROM reports r
            JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id
            WHERE r.question_id = ?
            ORDER BY 
                CASE 
                    WHEN r.status = 'open' THEN 1
                    WHEN r.status = 'in_progress' THEN 2
                    WHEN r.status = 'resolved' THEN 3
                    WHEN r.status = 'rejected' THEN 4
                    ELSE 5
                END, 
                r.created_at DESC
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$questionId]);
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Fehler beim Abrufen der Reports: " . $e->getMessage());
        return [];
    }
}

function markReportAsResolved($db, $reportId) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("UPDATE reports SET status = 'resolved', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$reportId]);
        return true;
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Fehler beim Aktualisieren des Meldestatus: " . $e->getMessage());
        return false;
    }
}

function getSubmitterForQuestion($db, $questionId) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            SELECT 
                u.first_name AS submitter_first_name, 
                u.last_name AS submitter_last_name,
                qs.submitted_at,
                qs.status,
                r.first_name AS reviewer_first_name,
                r.last_name AS reviewer_last_name,
                qs.reviewed_at
            FROM question_submissions qs
            JOIN users u ON qs.user_id = u.id
            LEFT JOIN users r ON qs.reviewed_by = r.id
            WHERE qs.question_id = ?
            LIMIT 1
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$questionId]);
        return $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log('Fehler beim Abrufen des Einreichers: ' . $e->getMessage());
        return null;
    }
}

function updateSubmissionStatus($db, $questionId, $status, $reviewedBy) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            UPDATE question_submissions 
            SET status = ?, reviewed_by = ?, reviewed_at = NOW() 
            WHERE question_id = ?
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$status, $reviewedBy, $questionId]);
        return true;
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log('Fehler beim Aktualisieren des Frage-Status: ' . $e->getMessage());
        return false;
    }
}

// ===== INITIALISIERUNG =====
$categories = getCategories($db);
$message = '';
$messageType = 'info';

if (isset($_GET['id'])) {
    $questionId = intval($_GET['id']);
    $question = getQuestion($db, $questionId);
    $answers = getAnswers($db, $questionId);
} else {
    die("Frage nicht angegeben.");
}

$isDeleted = $question['deleted_at'] !== NULL;
$reports = getReportsForQuestion($db, $questionId);
$submitter = getSubmitterForQuestion($db, $questionId);
$questionLogs = getQuestionLogs($db, $questionId);

// ===== POST-HANDLER: DELETE/RESTORE (INTEGRIERT) =====
if (isset($_POST['action']) && in_array($_POST['action'], ['delete', 'restore'])) {
    $action = $_POST['action'];
    
    try {
        $db->beginTransaction();
        
        if ($action === 'delete') {
            $stmt = $db->prepare("UPDATE questions SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE id = ?");
            $stmt->execute([$questionId]);
            $logAction = 'question_deleted';
            $logDetails = 'question_deleted###Frage gelöscht (Softdelete)';
            $message = "Frage erfolgreich gelöscht.";
            $isDeleted = true;
        } else {
            $stmt = $db->prepare("UPDATE questions SET deleted_at = NULL WHERE id = ?");
            $stmt->execute([$questionId]);
            $logAction = 'question_restored';
            $logDetails = 'question_restored###Frage wiederhergestellt';
            $message = "Frage erfolgreich wiederhergestellt.";
            $isDeleted = false;
        }
        
        logQuestionAction($db, $_SESSION['user_id'], $questionId, $logAction, $logDetails);
        $db->commit();
        $messageType = 'success';
        $questionLogs = getQuestionLogs($db, $questionId);
        
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        $db->rollBack();
        $message = "Fehler: " . $e->getMessage();
        $messageType = 'danger';
        error_log("Fehler bei Lösch-/Wiederherstellungsoperation: " . $e->getMessage());
    }
}

// ===== POST-HANDLER: FRAGENBEARBEITUNG =====
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST' && !isset($_POST['resolve_report_id']) && !isset($_POST['submission_status']) && !isset($_POST['action'])) {
    $questionText = $_POST['question_text'];
    $explanation = $_POST['explanation'] ?? '';
    $categoryIds = $_POST['category_ids'] ?? [];
    $deleteAnswers = $_POST['delete_answers'] ?? [];
    $answerTexts = $_POST['answer_text'] ?? [];
    $correctAnswerId = $_POST['correct_answer'] ?? null;

    try {
        $db->beginTransaction();
        
        $changes = [];
        $changeTypes = [];
        $oldQuestion = getQuestion($db, $questionId);
        $oldAnswers = getAnswers($db, $questionId);

        // 1. GELÖSCHTE ANTWORTEN
        if (!empty($deleteAnswers)) {
            foreach ($oldAnswers as $answer) {
                if (in_array($answer['id'], $deleteAnswers)) {
                    $statusText = $answer['is_correct'] ? 'RICHTIG' : 'FALSCH';
                    $changes[] = "DELETED_ANSWER||Antwort gelöscht: ID=" . $answer['id'] . " | Text=\"" . $answer['answer_text'] . "\" | Status=" . $statusText;
                    $changeTypes[] = 'answer_deleted';
                }
            }
            
            $placeholders = implode(',', array_fill(0, count($deleteAnswers), '?'));
            $stmt = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM answers WHERE id IN ($placeholders)");
            $stmt->execute($deleteAnswers);
        }

        // 2. FRAGETEXT ÄNDERUNG
        if ($oldQuestion['question_text'] !== $questionText) {
            $changes[] = "QUESTION_TEXT||Fragetext geändert: VON=\"" . $oldQuestion['question_text'] . "\" → AUF=\"" . $questionText . "\"";
            $changeTypes[] = 'question_edited';
        }
        
        // 3. ERKLÄRUNG ÄNDERUNG
        $oldExplanation = $oldQuestion['explanation'] ?? '';
        if ($oldExplanation !== $explanation) {
            if (empty($oldExplanation) && !empty($explanation)) {
                $changes[] = "EXPLANATION||Erklärung hinzugefügt: VON=\"(leer)\" → AUF=\"" . $explanation . "\"";
                $changeTypes[] = 'explanation_added';
            } elseif (!empty($oldExplanation) && empty($explanation)) {
                $changes[] = "EXPLANATION||Erklärung entfernt: VON=\"" . $oldExplanation . "\" → AUF=\"(leer)\"";
                $changeTypes[] = 'explanation_removed';
            } else {
                $changes[] = "EXPLANATION||Erklärung geändert: VON=\"" . $oldExplanation . "\" → AUF=\"" . $explanation . "\"";
                $changeTypes[] = 'explanation_edited';
            }
        }

        // Aktualisiere Frage
        $stmt = $db->prepare("UPDATE questions SET question_text = ?, explanation = ? WHERE id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$questionText, $explanation, $questionId]);

        // 4. KATEGORIEN ÄNDERUNGEN
        $oldCategoryIds = array_filter(explode(',', $oldQuestion['category_ids'] ?? ''));
        $addedCategoryIds = array_diff($categoryIds, $oldCategoryIds);
        $removedCategoryIds = array_diff($oldCategoryIds, $categoryIds);
        
        if (!empty($addedCategoryIds)) {
            $addedNames = getCategoryNamesByIds($db, $addedCategoryIds);
            foreach ($addedNames as $name) {
                $changes[] = "CATEGORY_ADDED||Kategorie hinzugefügt: \"" . $name . "\"";
                $changeTypes[] = 'category_added';
            }
        }
        
        if (!empty($removedCategoryIds)) {
            $removedNames = getCategoryNamesByIds($db, $removedCategoryIds);
            foreach ($removedNames as $name) {
                $changes[] = "CATEGORY_REMOVED||Kategorie entfernt: \"" . $name . "\"";
                $changeTypes[] = 'category_removed';
            }
        }

        // Kategorien aktualisieren
        $db->prepare("DELETE FROM question_categories WHERE question_id = ?")->execute([$questionId]);
        if (!empty($categoryIds)) {
            $stmt = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO question_categories (question_id, category_id) VALUES (?, ?)");
            foreach ($categoryIds as $catId) {
                $stmt->execute([$questionId, $catId]);
            }
        }

        // 5. ANTWORTEN AKTUALISIEREN
        $stmt = $db->prepare("UPDATE answers SET answer_text = ?, is_correct = ? WHERE id = ?");
        
        foreach ($oldAnswers as $oldAnswer) {
            if (!in_array($oldAnswer['id'], $deleteAnswers) && isset($answerTexts[$oldAnswer['id']])) {
                $newText = $answerTexts[$oldAnswer['id']];
                $newIsCorrect = ($oldAnswer['id'] == $correctAnswerId) ? 1 : 0;
                
                if ($oldAnswer['answer_text'] !== $newText) {
                    $changes[] = "ANSWER_TEXT||Antworttext geändert: ID=" . $oldAnswer['id'] . " | VON=\"" . $oldAnswer['answer_text'] . "\" → AUF=\"" . $newText . "\"";
                    $changeTypes[] = 'answer_text_edited';
                }
                
                if ($oldAnswer['is_correct'] != $newIsCorrect) {
                    $statusAlt = $oldAnswer['is_correct'] ? "RICHTIG" : "FALSCH";
                    $statusNeu = $newIsCorrect ? "RICHTIG" : "FALSCH";
                    $changes[] = "ANSWER_STATUS||Antwortstatus geändert: ID=" . $oldAnswer['id'] . " | Text=\"" . $newText . "\" | VON=" . $statusAlt . " → AUF=" . $statusNeu;
                    $changeTypes[] = 'answer_status_changed';
                }
                
                $stmt->execute([$newText, $newIsCorrect, $oldAnswer['id']]);
            }
        }

        // 6. NEUE ANTWORTEN
        if (isset($_POST['new_answers']) && !empty($_POST['new_answers'])) {
            $stmt = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO answers (question_id, answer_text, is_correct) VALUES (?, ?, ?)");
            foreach ($_POST['new_answers'] as $newAnswerId => $text) {
                $isCorrect = ($newAnswerId == $correctAnswerId) ? 1 : 0;
                $stmt->execute([$questionId, $text, $isCorrect]);
                $newInsertedId = $db->lastInsertId();
                $status = $isCorrect ? 'RICHTIG' : 'FALSCH';
                $changes[] = "ANSWER_ADDED||Neue Antwort hinzugefügt: ID=" . $newInsertedId . " | Text=\"" . $text . "\" | Status=" . $status;
                $changeTypes[] = 'answer_added';
            }
        }

        // LOGGING
        if (!empty($changes)) {
            $typeString = implode(',', array_unique($changeTypes));
            $logDetails = $typeString . '###' . implode(' | ', $changes);
            logQuestionAction($db, $_SESSION['user_id'], $questionId, 'question_edited', $logDetails);
        }

        $db->commit();
        $message = "Frage erfolgreich aktualisiert!";
        $messageType = 'success';
        
        $question = getQuestion($db, $questionId);
        $answers = getAnswers($db, $questionId);
        $questionLogs = getQuestionLogs($db, $questionId);

    } catch (Exception $e) {
        $db->rollBack();
        $message = "Fehler: " . $e->getMessage();
        $messageType = 'danger';
        error_log("Fehler bei Fragenbearbeitung: " . $e->getMessage());
    }
}

// ===== POST-HANDLER: REPORT ALS ERLEDIGT MARKIEREN =====
if (isset($_POST['resolve_report_id'])) {
    $reportId = intval($_POST['resolve_report_id']);
    if (markReportAsResolved($db, $reportId)) {
        logQuestionAction($db, $_SESSION['user_id'], $questionId, 'report_resolved', "report_resolved###Report #$reportId als erledigt markiert");
        $message = "Meldung erfolgreich als erledigt markiert.";
        $messageType = 'success';
    } else {
        $message = "Fehler beim Aktualisieren der Meldung.";
        $messageType = 'danger';
    }
    $reports = getReportsForQuestion($db, $questionId);
    $questionLogs = getQuestionLogs($db, $questionId);
}

// ===== POST-HANDLER: SUBMISSION-STATUS ÄNDERN =====
if (isset($_POST['submission_status']) && isset($_POST['question_id'])) {
    $newStatus = $_POST['submission_status'];
    $questionId = intval($_POST['question_id']);
    $reviewedBy = $_SESSION['user_id'];

    if (updateSubmissionStatus($db, $questionId, $newStatus, $reviewedBy)) {
        $statusText = [
            'approved' => 'genehmigt',
            'rejected' => 'abgelehnt',
            'pending' => 'zurückgesetzt auf ausstehend'
        ][$newStatus] ?? $newStatus;
        
        logQuestionAction($db, $reviewedBy, $questionId, 'submission_status_changed', "submission_status_changed###Status auf '$statusText' geändert");
        
        $message = "Status erfolgreich geändert auf: <strong>$statusText</strong>";
        $messageType = 'success';
    } else {
        $message = "Fehler beim Aktualisieren des Fragenstatus.";
        $messageType = 'danger';
    }

    $submitter = getSubmitterForQuestion($db, $questionId);
    $questionLogs = getQuestionLogs($db, $questionId);
}

        <div class="log-container">
```
