```php
                <i class="fas fa-history text-info"></i> Aktivitätsverlauf
            </h5>
            
            <?php if (empty($questionLogs)): ?>
                <div class="alert alert-info">
                    <i class="fas fa-info-circle"></i> Noch keine Aktivitäten für diese Frage aufgezeichnet.
                </div>
            <?php else: ?>
                <div class="log-table-container">
                    <table class="log-table">
                        <thead>
                            <tr>
                                <th style="width: 140px;">Datum & Uhrzeit</th>
                                <th style="width: 130px;">Benutzer</th>
                                <th>Aktion & Details</th>
                            </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody>
                            <?php foreach ($questionLogs as $log): ?>
                                <?php
                                    $userName = ($log['first_name'] && $log['last_name']) 
                                        ? htmlspecialchars(($log['first_name'] ?? '') . ' ' . ($log['last_name'] ?? '')) 
                                        : 'System';
                                    
                                    $actionTranslations = [
                                        'question_edited' => 'Frage bearbeitet',
                                        'report_resolved' => 'Meldung erledigt',
                                        'submission_status_changed' => 'Status geändert',
                                        'question_deleted' => 'Frage gelöscht',
                                        'question_restored' => 'Frage wiederhergestellt'
                                    ];
                                    $actionText = $actionTranslations[$log['action']] ?? $log['action'];
                                    
                                    $iconClass = 'edit';
                                    $iconChar = '<i class="fas fa-edit"></i>';
                                    
                                    if ($log['action'] === 'report_resolved') {
                                        $iconClass = 'success';
                                        $iconChar = '<i class="fas fa-check-circle"></i>';
                                    } elseif ($log['action'] === 'submission_status_changed') {
                                        $iconClass = 'warning';
                                        $iconChar = '<i class="fas fa-exchange-alt"></i>';
                                    } elseif ($log['action'] === 'question_deleted') {
                                        $iconClass = 'danger';
                                        $iconChar = '<i class="fas fa-trash"></i>';
                                    } elseif ($log['action'] === 'question_restored') {
                                        $iconClass = 'success';
                                        $iconChar = '<i class="fas fa-undo"></i>';
                                    }
                                    
                                    $iconGroup = '';
                                    $changesSummary = '';
                                    
                                    if ($log['details']) {
                                        $parts = explode('###', $log['details'], 2);
                                        
                                        if (count($parts) === 2) {
                                            $changeTypes = explode(',', $parts[0]);
                                            $detailsText = $parts[1];
                                            
                                            $typeIcons = [
                                                'question_edited' => ['badge' => 'badge-question', 'title' => 'Frage'],
                                                'answer_added' => ['badge' => 'badge-answer', 'title' => 'Antwort +'],
                                                'answer_deleted' => ['badge' => 'badge-deleted', 'title' => 'Antwort -'],
                                                'answer_text_edited' => ['badge' => 'badge-answer', 'title' => 'Text'],
                                                'answer_status_changed' => ['badge' => 'badge-status', 'title' => 'Status'],
                                                'category_added' => ['badge' => 'badge-category', 'title' => 'Kategorie +'],
                                                'category_removed' => ['badge' => 'badge-category', 'title' => 'Kategorie -'],
                                                'explanation_added' => ['badge' => 'badge-explanation', 'title' => 'Erklärung +'],
                                                'explanation_removed' => ['badge' => 'badge-explanation', 'title' => 'Erklärung -'],
                                                'explanation_edited' => ['badge' => 'badge-explanation', 'title' => 'Erklärung'],
                                                'report_resolved' => ['badge' => 'badge-status', 'title' => 'Report'],
                                                'submission_status_changed' => ['badge' => 'badge-status', 'title' => 'Status']
                                            ];
                                            
                                            $uniqueTypes = array_unique($changeTypes);
                                            foreach ($uniqueTypes as $type) {
                                                if (isset($typeIcons[$type])) {
                                                    $td = $typeIcons[$type];
                                                    $iconGroup .= '<span class="change-badge ' . $td['badge'] . '">' . $td['title'] . '</span>';
                                                }
                                            }
                                            
                                            $detailParts = explode(' | ', $detailsText);
                                            $changesSummary = '';
                                            
                                            foreach ($detailParts as $part) {
                                                $clean = preg_replace('/^[A-Z_]+\|\|/', '', $part);
                                                $clean = str_replace('&', 'und', $clean);
                                                $clean = str_replace('(Softdelete)', '', $clean);
                                                $clean = trim($clean);
                                                
                                                if (empty($clean)) continue;
                                                
                                                // Parse VON/AUF Pattern
                                                if (preg_match('/^(.+?):\s*VON="([^"]*?)"\s*→\s*AUF="([^"]*?)"/', $clean, $matches)) {
                                                    $label = $matches[1];
                                                    $oldVal = $matches[2];
                                                    $newVal = $matches[3];
                                                    
                                                    $changesSummary .= '<div class="log-change-header">' . htmlspecialchars($label) . '</div>';
                                                    $changesSummary .= '<div class="log-value-pair">';
                                                    $changesSummary .= '<span class="log-old">VON: ' . htmlspecialchars($oldVal) . '</span>';
                                                    $changesSummary .= '<span class="log-arrow">↓</span>';
                                                    $changesSummary .= '<span class="log-new">AUF: ' . htmlspecialchars($newVal) . '</span>';
                                                    $changesSummary .= '</div>';
                                                } else {
                                                    // Einfache Änderungen
                                                    if (strpos($clean, 'gelöscht') !== false) {
                                                        $changesSummary .= '<div class="log-summary-item"><span class="log-simple-action log-action-delete">' . htmlspecialchars($clean) . '</span></div>';
                                                    } elseif (strpos($clean, 'wiederhergestellt') !== false) {
                                                        $changesSummary .= '<div class="log-summary-item"><span class="log-simple-action log-action-restore">' . htmlspecialchars($clean) . '</span></div>';
                                                    } else {
                                                        $changesSummary .= '<div class="log-summary-item">' . htmlspecialchars($clean) . '</div>';
                                                    }
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                ?>
                                <tr>
                                    <td class="log-time"><?php echo date('d.m.Y H:i:s', strtotime($log['created_at'])); ?></td>
                                    <td class="log-user"><?php echo $userName; ?></td>
                                    <td class="log-details">
                                        <div class="log-action">
                                            <div class="log-icon <?php echo $iconClass; ?>">
                                                <?php echo $iconChar; ?>
                                            </div>
                                            <span class="log-text"><?php echo $actionText; ?></span>
                                        </div>
                                        <?php if ($iconGroup): ?>
                                            <div class="log-badges"><?php echo $iconGroup; ?></div>
                                        <?php endif; ?>
                                        <?php 
                                        // Nur Details anzeigen, wenn es echte inhaltliche Änderungen gibt
                                        // Bei question_deleted/restored reicht die Überschrift
                                        $showDetails = !in_array($log['action'], ['question_deleted', 'question_restored']) && $changesSummary;
                                        ?>
                                        <?php if ($showDetails): ?>
                                            <div class="log-summary"><?php echo $changesSummary; ?></div>
                                        <?php endif; ?>
                                    </td>
                                </tr>
                            <?php endforeach; ?>
                        </tbody>
                    </table>
                </div>
                <div class="text-muted mt-3" style="font-size: 0.75rem; padding: 0 10px;">
                    <i class="fas fa-info-circle"></i> <?php echo count($questionLogs); ?> Einträge (letzte 100)
                </div>
            <?php endif; ?>
        </div>

        <!-- DELETE/RESTORE ACTION BUTTONS -->
        <?php if (!$isDeleted): ?>
            <form method="post" onsubmit="return confirm('Frage wirklich löschen?');">
                <input type="hidden" name="action" value="delete">
                <button type="submit" class="btn btn-danger btn-modern btn-block btn-lg">
                    <i class="fas fa-trash"></i> Frage löschen
                </button>
            </form>
        <?php else: ?>
            <form method="post" onsubmit="return confirm('Frage wirklich wiederherstellen?');">
                <input type="hidden" name="action" value="restore">
                <button type="submit" class="btn btn-success btn-modern btn-block btn-lg">
                    <i class="fas fa-undo"></i> Frage wiederherstellen
                </button>
            </form>
        <?php endif; ?>
    </div>
    
    <script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.5.1.min.js"></script>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@popperjs/core@2.5.3/dist/umd/popper.min.js"></script>
    <script src="https://stackpath.bootstrapcdn.com/bootstrap/4.5.2/js/bootstrap.min.js"></script>
    
    <script>
    let answerCounter = <?php echo count($answers); ?>;

    function addAnswer() {
        const answersDiv = document.getElementById('answers');
        answerCounter++;
        const newAnswerId = 'new_' + answerCounter;

        const newAnswer = document.createElement('div');
        newAnswer.classList.add('answer-group');
        newAnswer.innerHTML = `
            <div class="input-group">
                <input type="text" name="new_answers[${newAnswerId}]" class="form-control" placeholder="Neue Antwort eingeben" required>
                <div class="input-group-append">
                    <div class="input-group-text">
                        <input type="radio" name="correct_answer" value="${newAnswerId}" required>
                        <span class="ml-2">Richtig</span>
                    </div>
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-danger btn-sm ml-2" onclick="removeNewAnswer(this)">
                        <i class="fas fa-trash"></i>
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>
        `;
        answersDiv.appendChild(newAnswer);
    }

    function removeNewAnswer(button) {
        if (confirm('Diese neue Antwort wirklich entfernen?')) {
            button.closest('.answer-group').remove();
        }
    }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```php
<?php
session_start();
require_once '../config.php';

checkUserRole(ROLE_ADMIN);

$userId = isset($_GET['id']) ? intval($_GET['id']) : 0;

if (!$userId) {
    header("Location: user_management.php");
    exit;
}

$stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?");
$stmt->execute([$userId]);
$user = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

if (!$user) {
    header("Location: user_management.php");
    exit;
}

// Holen Sie alle verfügbaren Kategorien
$stmtCategories = $db->query("SELECT * FROM categories");
$categories = $stmtCategories->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

// Überprüfen Sie, ob die user_categories Tabelle existiert
$stmt = $db->query("SHOW TABLES LIKE 'user_categories'");
$tableExists = $stmt->rowCount() > 0;

$userCategories = [];
if ($tableExists) {
    // Holen Sie die Kategorien, auf die der Benutzer Zugriff hat
    $stmtUserCategories = $db->prepare("SELECT category_id FROM user_categories WHERE user_id = ?");
    $stmtUserCategories->execute([$userId]);
    $userCategories = $stmtUserCategories->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_COLUMN);
}

// Benutzerstatistik abrufen
function getUserStatistics($db, $userId) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT 
            SUM(correct_count) as total_correct,
            SUM(incorrect_count) as total_incorrect,
            udp.current_points,
            udp.streak,
            udp.last_answered,
            COUNT(CASE WHEN DATE(us.last_shown) = CURDATE() THEN 1 END) as questions_today
            FROM user_statistics us
            LEFT JOIN user_daily_points udp ON udp.user_id = us.user_id
            WHERE us.user_id = ? 
            GROUP BY us.user_id");
        $stmt->execute([$userId]);
        return $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Fehler beim Abrufen der Benutzerstatistik: " . $e->getMessage());
        return false;
    }
}

$userStats = getUserStatistics($db, $userId);
if ($userStats) {
    $totalCorrect = $userStats['total_correct'] ?? 0;
    $totalIncorrect = $userStats['total_incorrect'] ?? 0;
    $totalQuestions = $totalCorrect + $totalIncorrect;
    $correctPercentage = $totalQuestions > 0 ? ($totalCorrect / $totalQuestions) * 100 : 0;
    $incorrectPercentage = $totalQuestions > 0 ? ($totalIncorrect / $totalQuestions) * 100 : 0;
    
    $currentPoints = $userStats['current_points'] ?? 0;
    $questionsToday = $userStats['questions_today'] ?? 0;
    $streak = $userStats['streak'] ?? 0;
    $lastActive = $userStats['last_answered'] 
                ? date('d.m.Y H:i', strtotime($userStats['last_answered'])) 
                : 'Noch keine Aktivität';
}
?>
```

```php
function getCategories($db) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->query("SELECT id, name FROM categories ORDER BY name");
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Fehler beim Abrufen der Kategorien: " . $e->getMessage());
        return [];
    }
}

function getAllQuestionsForExport($db, $categoryIds) {
    try {
        $placeholders = implode(',', array_fill(0, count($categoryIds), '?'));
        $sql = "
            SELECT q.id, q.question_text, q.explanation, 
                   GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT qc.category_id ORDER BY qc.category_id ASC SEPARATOR ',') AS category_ids,
                   GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT a.answer_text ORDER BY a.id ASC SEPARATOR '|') AS answers,
                   (SELECT answer_text FROM answers WHERE question_id = q.id AND is_correct = 1 LIMIT 1) AS correct_answer
            FROM questions q 
            JOIN question_categories qc ON q.id = qc.question_id
            LEFT JOIN answers a ON q.id = a.question_id
            WHERE qc.category_id IN ($placeholders)
            GROUP BY q.id
            ORDER BY q.id
        ";
        $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($categoryIds);
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Fehler beim Abrufen der Fragen: " . $e->getMessage());
        return [];
    }
}

function exportCSV($questions) {
    header('Content-Type: text/csv; charset=UTF-8');
    header('Content-Disposition: attachment; filename=questions_export.csv');
    
    echo "\xEF\xBB\xBF"; // BOM für UTF-8

    $output = fopen('php://output', 'w');

    // Überschrift schreiben
    fputcsv($output, ['ID', 'Frage', 'Antworten', 'Richtige Antwort', 'Erklärung', 'Kategorie-IDs'], ';', '"', '\\');

    foreach ($questions as $question) {
        $answers = explode('|', $question['answers']);
        $answersString = implode('|', $answers);
        $correctAnswerIndex = array_search($question['correct_answer'], $answers) + 1;
        
        $row = [
            $question['id'],
            $question['question_text'],
            $answersString,
            $correctAnswerIndex,
            $question['explanation'],
            $question['category_ids']
        ];
        
        fputcsv($output, $row, ';', '"', '\\');
    }

    fclose($output);
    exit;
}

$categories = getCategories($db);
$message = '';

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    if (isset($_POST['export']) && !empty($_POST['categories'])) {
        $selectedCategories = $_POST['categories'];
        $questions = getAllQuestionsForExport($db, $selectedCategories);
        if ($questions) {
            exportCSV($questions);
        } else {
            $message = "Keine Fragen für die ausgewählten Kategorien gefunden.";
        }
    } elseif (isset($_POST['export']) && empty($_POST['categories'])) {
        $message = "Bitte wählen Sie mindestens eine Kategorie aus.";
    }
}

        function updateCounter() {
            const checked = document.querySelectorAll('.category-checkbox:checked').length;
            document.getElementById('counter').textContent = checked + ' ausgewählt';
            document.getElementById('exportBtn').disabled = checked === 0;
        }

        // Initial counter update
        updateCounter();
```

```php
<?php
session_start();
ini_set('display_errors', 1);
ini_set('display_startup_errors', 1);
error_reporting(E_ALL);

require_once '../config.php';

// Überprüfen, ob der Benutzer angemeldet ist und die Rolle Admin oder Manager hat
checkUserRole(ROLE_ADMIN);


function importCSV($db, $file) {
    $error = null;
    $lineNumber = 0;
    if (($handle = fopen($file, "r")) !== FALSE) {
        // Überspringen der Kopfzeile
        fgetcsv($handle, 0, ";", '"', '\\'); // Escape-Zeichen hinzugefügt
        $lineNumber++;
        
        $db->beginTransaction();
        try {
            while (($data = fgetcsv($handle, 0, ";", '"', '\\')) !== FALSE) { // Escape-Zeichen hinzugefügt
                $lineNumber++;
                if (count($data) != 5) {
                    throw new Exception("Ungültiges CSV-Format in Zeile $lineNumber. Jede Zeile muss 5 Felder haben. Gefundene Daten: " . implode(",", $data));
                }
                
                $question = $data[0];
                $answers = explode("|", $data[1]);
                $correctAnswerIndex = (int)$data[2] - 1;
                $explanation = $data[3];
                $categories = explode(",", $data[4]);
                $answerCount = count($answers);
                if ($answerCount < 3 || $answerCount > 6 ) {
                    throw new Exception("Jede Frage muss zwischen 4 und 6 Antwortmöglichkeiten haben. Fehler in Zeile $lineNumber. Gefundene Antworten: ". implode(", ", $answers));
                }
                
                // Frage einfügen
                $stmt = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO questions (question_text, explanation) VALUES (?, ?)");
                $stmt->execute([$question, $explanation]);
                $questionId = $db->lastInsertId();
                
                // Antworten einfügen
                foreach ($answers as $index => $answer) {
                    $isCorrect = ($index == $correctAnswerIndex) ? 1 : 0;
                    $stmt = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO answers (question_id, answer_text, is_correct) VALUES (?, ?, ?)");
                    $stmt->execute([$questionId, $answer, $isCorrect]);
                }
                
                // Kategorien zuordnen
                foreach ($categories as $categoryId) {
                    $categoryId = trim($categoryId);
                    $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT id FROM categories WHERE id = ?");
                    $stmt->execute([$categoryId]);
                    if ($stmt->fetch()) {
                        $stmt = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO question_categories (question_id, category_id) VALUES (?, ?)");
                        $stmt->execute([$questionId, $categoryId]);
                    } else {
                        throw new Exception("Ungültige Kategorie-ID: " . $categoryId);
                    }
                }
            }
            $db->commit();
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            $db->rollBack();
            $error = "Fehler beim Import: " . $e->getMessage();
        }
        fclose($handle);
    } else {
        $error = "Konnte die Datei nicht öffnen.";
    }
    return $error;
}

$message = '';

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    if (isset($_FILES['csv_file'])) {
        $file = $_FILES['csv_file']['tmp_name'];
        $error = importCSV($db, $file);
        if ($error) {
            $message = $error;
        } else {
            $message = "CSV-Datei erfolgreich importiert.";
        }
    }
}
?>

        $('.custom-file-input').on('change', function() {

            $(this).next('.custom-file-label').html(fileName);
```

```php
<?php
ini_set('display_errors', 1);
ini_set('display_startup_errors', 1);
error_reporting(E_ALL);
session_start();
require_once '../config.php';

checkUserRole(ROLE_MANAGER);

// Funktion zum Abrufen aller Kategorien
function getCategories($db) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->query("SELECT c.id, c.name, 
                            COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN q.deleted_at IS NULL THEN qc.question_id END) as question_count 
                            FROM categories c
                            LEFT JOIN question_categories qc ON c.id = qc.category_id
                            LEFT JOIN questions q ON qc.question_id = q.id
                            GROUP BY c.id
                            ORDER BY c.name");
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Fehler beim Abrufen der Kategorien: " . $e->getMessage());
        return [];
    }
}

// Funktion zum Hinzufügen einer neuen Kategorie
function addCategory($db, $name) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO categories (name) VALUES (?)");
        $stmt->execute([$name]);
        return true;
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Fehler beim Hinzufügen der Kategorie: " . $e->getMessage());
        return false;
    }
}

// Funktion zum Löschen einer Kategorie
function deleteCategory($db, $id) {
    try {
        $db->beginTransaction();

        // Lösche nur die Zuordnung der Fragen zur Kategorie, nicht die Fragen selbst
        $stmt = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM question_categories WHERE category_id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$id]);

        // Lösche die Kategorie selbst
        $stmt = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM categories WHERE id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$id]);

        $db->commit();
        return true;
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        $db->rollBack();
        error_log("Fehler beim Löschen der Kategorie: " . $e->getMessage());
        return false;
    }
}

// Funktion zum Bearbeiten des Namens einer Kategorie
function updateCategoryName($db, $id, $newName) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("UPDATE categories SET name = ? WHERE id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$newName, $id]);
        return true;
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Fehler beim Bearbeiten des Kategorienamens: " . $e->getMessage());
        return false;
    }
}

$message = '';
$messageType = 'info';

// Verarbeitung des Formulars zum Hinzufügen einer Kategorie
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST' && isset($_POST['add_category'])) {
    $categoryName = trim($_POST['category_name']);
    if (!empty($categoryName)) {
        if (addCategory($db, $categoryName)) {
            $message = "Kategorie erfolgreich hinzugefügt.";
            $messageType = 'success';
        } else {
            $message = "Fehler beim Hinzufügen der Kategorie.";
            $messageType = 'danger';
        }
    } else {
        $message = "Bitte geben Sie einen Kategorienamen ein.";
        $messageType = 'warning';
    }
}

// Verarbeitung der Anfrage zum Löschen einer Kategorie
if (isset($_POST['delete_category'])) {
    $categoryId = $_POST['category_id'];
    if (deleteCategory($db, $categoryId)) {
        $message = "Kategorie erfolgreich gelöscht.";
        $messageType = 'success';
    } else {
        $message = "Fehler beim Löschen der Kategorie.";
        $messageType = 'danger';
    }
}

// Verarbeitung der Anfrage zum Bearbeiten des Namens einer Kategorie
if (isset($_POST['edit_category_name'])) {
    $categoryId = $_POST['category_id'];
    $newCategoryName = trim($_POST['new_category_name']);
    if (!empty($newCategoryName)) {
        if (updateCategoryName($db, $categoryId, $newCategoryName)) {
            $message = "Kategoriename erfolgreich geändert.";
            $messageType = 'success';
        } else {
            $message = "Fehler beim Bearbeiten des Kategorienamens.";
            $messageType = 'danger';
        }
    } else {
        $message = "Bitte geben Sie einen neuen Kategorienamen ein.";
        $messageType = 'warning';
    }
}

// Abrufen aller Kategorien
$categories = getCategories($db);

// Gesamtanzahl EINDEUTIGER Fragen (nicht gelöscht)
$totalQuestionsStmt = $db->query("SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q.id) 
                                   FROM questions q 
                                   INNER JOIN question_categories qc ON q.id = qc.question_id
                                   WHERE q.deleted_at IS NULL");
$totalQuestions = $totalQuestionsStmt->fetchColumn();
?>
```

```php
<?php
ini_set('display_errors', 1);
ini_set('display_startup_errors', 1);
error_reporting(E_ALL);
session_start();

if (!isset($_SESSION['csrf_token'])) {
    $_SESSION['csrf_token'] = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
}

require_once '../config.php';
checkUserRole(ROLE_MANAGER);

// Admin-Navigation wird später im HTML eingebunden

// AJAX-Handler für DataTables serverseitige Verarbeitung
if (isset($_GET['ajax']) && $_GET['ajax'] === 'datatable') {
    header('Content-Type: application/json');
    
    $draw = intval($_GET['draw']);
    $start = intval($_GET['start']);
    $length = intval($_GET['length']);
    $searchValue = $_GET['search']['value'] ?? '';
    $orderColumn = intval($_GET['order'][0]['column'] ?? 1);
    $orderDir = $_GET['order'][0]['dir'] ?? 'DESC';
    
    $categoryIds = $_SESSION['category_filter'] ?? [];
    $showUncategorized = isset($_SESSION['show_uncategorized']) && $_SESSION['show_uncategorized'];
    $includeDeleted = isset($_SESSION['include_deleted']) && $_SESSION['include_deleted'];
    
    // Spalten-Mapping
    $columns = ['q.id', 'q.id', 'q.question_text', 'categories'];
    $orderBy = $columns[$orderColumn] ?? 'q.id';
    
    // Basis-Query
    $baseSql = "
        SELECT 
            q.id, 
            q.question_text, 
            q.deleted_at,
            GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.name ORDER BY c.name ASC SEPARATOR ', ') AS categories
        FROM questions q 
        LEFT JOIN question_categories qc ON q.id = qc.question_id
        LEFT JOIN categories c ON qc.category_id = c.id
    ";
    
    $whereClauses = [];
    $params = [];
    
    // Soft-Delete-Filter
    if (!$includeDeleted) {
        $whereClauses[] = "q.deleted_at IS NULL";
    }
    
    // Kategorien-Filter
    if (!empty($categoryIds)) {
        $placeholders = implode(',', array_fill(0, count($categoryIds), '?'));
        $whereClauses[] = "(c.id IN ($placeholders) OR c.id IS NULL)";
        $params = array_merge($params, $categoryIds);
    }
    
    // Unkategorisierte Fragen
    if ($showUncategorized && empty($categoryIds)) {
        $whereClauses[] = "c.id IS NULL";
    }
    
    // Suchfilter
    if (!empty($searchValue)) {
        $whereClauses[] = "(q.question_text LIKE ? OR q.id LIKE ?)";
        $searchParam = "%$searchValue%";
        $params[] = $searchParam;
        $params[] = $searchParam;
    }
    
    $whereClause = !empty($whereClauses) ? "WHERE " . implode(" AND ", $whereClauses) : "";
    $groupBy = "GROUP BY q.id";
    
    // Gesamtanzahl (gefiltert)
    $countSql = "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q.id) as total FROM questions q 
                 LEFT JOIN question_categories qc ON q.id = qc.question_id
                 LEFT JOIN categories c ON qc.category_id = c.id 
                 $whereClause";
    $countStmt = $db->prepare($countSql);
    foreach ($params as $index => $value) {
        $countStmt->bindValue($index + 1, $value);
    }
    $countStmt->execute();
    $recordsFiltered = $countStmt->fetchColumn();
    
    // Gesamtanzahl (ungefiltert)
    $totalStmt = $db->query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM questions" . (!$includeDeleted ? " WHERE deleted_at IS NULL" : ""));
    $recordsTotal = $totalStmt->fetchColumn();
    
    // Daten abrufen
    $sql = "$baseSql $whereClause $groupBy ORDER BY $orderBy $orderDir LIMIT $length OFFSET $start";
    $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
    foreach ($params as $index => $value) {
        $stmt->bindValue($index + 1, $value);
    }
    $stmt->execute();
    $questions = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    
    // Daten für DataTables formatieren
    $data = [];
    foreach ($questions as $question) {
        $categoryParam = !empty($categoryIds) ? '&category=' . implode('&category[]=', $categoryIds) : '';
        
        $checkbox = '<input type="checkbox" class="question-checkbox" value="' . $question['id'] . '">';
        
        $questionText = htmlspecialchars($question['question_text'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        if ($question['deleted_at']) {
            $questionText .= ' <span class="badge badge-danger ml-2">Gelöscht</span>';
        }
        
        $categories = htmlspecialchars($question['categories'] ?? 'Keine Kategorie', ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        if ($question['deleted_at']) {
            $categories .= '<div class="text-muted small">Gelöscht am: ' . date('d.m.Y H:i', strtotime($question['deleted_at'])) . '</div>';
        }
        
        // Aktionen
        $actions = '<a href="edit_question.php?id=' . $question['id'] . $categoryParam . '" class="btn btn-primary btn-sm btn-action mb-1">
                        <i class="fas fa-edit"></i> Bearbeiten
                    </a>';
        
        if (!$question['deleted_at']) {
            $actions .= '<form action="delete_question.php" method="post" class="d-inline" onsubmit="return confirm(\'Frage wirklich als gelöscht markieren?\');">
                            <input type="hidden" name="csrf_token" value="' . $_SESSION['csrf_token'] . '">
                            <input type="hidden" name="question_id" value="' . $question['id'] . '">
                            <button type="submit" class="btn btn-danger btn-sm btn-action mb-1">
                                <i class="fas fa-trash"></i> Löschen
                            </button>
                        </form>';
        } else {
            $actions .= '<form action="restore_question.php" method="post" class="d-inline" onsubmit="return confirm(\'Frage wiederherstellen?\');">
                            <input type="hidden" name="csrf_token" value="' . $_SESSION['csrf_token'] . '">
                            <input type="hidden" name="question_id" value="' . $question['id'] . '">
                            <button type="submit" class="btn btn-success btn-sm btn-action mb-1">
                                <i class="fas fa-undo"></i> Wiederherstellen
                            </button>
                        </form>';
        }
        
        $data[] = [
            $checkbox,
            $question['id'],
            $questionText,
            $categories,
            $actions
        ];
    }
    
    echo json_encode([
        'draw' => $draw,
        'recordsTotal' => $recordsTotal,
        'recordsFiltered' => $recordsFiltered,
        'data' => $data
    ]);
    exit;
}

// Kategorien abrufen
function getCategories($db) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->query("SELECT id, name FROM categories ORDER BY name");
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Fehler beim Abrufen der Kategorien: " . $e->getMessage());
        return [];
    }
}

// Filter-Handling
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST' && isset($_POST['apply_filter'])) {
    $_SESSION['category_filter'] = $_POST['category'] ?? [];
    $_SESSION['show_uncategorized'] = isset($_POST['uncategorized']);
    $_SESSION['include_deleted'] = isset($_POST['include_deleted']);
    header("Location: manage_questions.php");
    exit();
}

if (isset($_GET['reset_filter'])) {
    unset($_SESSION['category_filter']);
    unset($_SESSION['show_uncategorized']);
    unset($_SESSION['include_deleted']);
    header("Location: manage_questions.php");
    exit();
}

$categories = getCategories($db);
$categoryIds = $_SESSION['category_filter'] ?? [];
$showUncategorized = $_SESSION['show_uncategorized'] ?? false;
$includeDeleted = $_SESSION['include_deleted'] ?? false;
?>

    <script>
    $(document).ready(function() {
        // Select2 initialisieren
        $('#categoryFilter').select2({
            theme: 'bootstrap',
            placeholder: 'Kategorien auswählen...',
            allowClear: true
        });

        // DataTable mit serverseitiger Verarbeitung
        const table = $('#questionsTable').DataTable({
            processing: true,
            serverSide: true,
            ajax: {
                url: '?ajax=datatable',
                type: 'GET',
                error: function(xhr, error, code) {
                    console.error('DataTables Error:', error);
                }
            },
            columns: [
                { data: 0, orderable: false, searchable: false },
                { data: 1 },
                { data: 2 },
                { data: 3 },
                { data: 4, orderable: false, searchable: false }
            ],
            order: [[1, 'desc']],
            pageLength: 25,
            lengthMenu: [[10, 25, 50, 100, 250], [10, 25, 50, 100, 250]],
            language: {
                processing: '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin fa-2x"></i><br>Wird geladen...',
                lengthMenu: 'Zeige _MENU_ Einträge',
                zeroRecords: 'Keine Einträge gefunden',
                info: 'Zeige _START_ bis _END_ von _TOTAL_ Einträgen',
                infoEmpty: 'Keine Einträge verfügbar',
                infoFiltered: '(gefiltert von _MAX_ Einträgen)',
                search: 'Suche:',
                paginate: {
                    first: 'Erste',
                    last: 'Letzte',
                    next: 'Nächste',
                    previous: 'Vorherige'
                }
            },
            drawCallback: function() {
                // Nach dem Laden der Daten
                $('#loadingOverlay').removeClass('active');
            }
        });

        // Loading anzeigen beim Neuladen
        table.on('preXhr', function() {
            $('#loadingOverlay').addClass('active');
        });

        // Select All Checkbox
        $('#selectAll').on('click', function() {
            $('.question-checkbox').prop('checked', this.checked);
        });

        // Kategorien zuordnen
        $('#saveCategories').on('click', function() {
            const selectedQuestions = $('.question-checkbox:checked').map(function() {
                return $(this).val();
            }).get();

            if (selectedQuestions.length === 0) {
                alert('Bitte wählen Sie mindestens eine Frage aus.');
                return;
            }

            $('#question_ids').val(selectedQuestions.join(','));
            
            // Hier AJAX-Call zum Speichern der Kategorien
            const formData = $('#categoryForm').serialize();
            
            $.ajax({
                url: 'assign_categories.php',
                method: 'POST',
                data: formData,
                success: function(response) {
                    alert('Kategorien erfolgreich zugeordnet!');
                    $('#categoryModal').modal('hide');
                    table.ajax.reload();
                },
                error: function() {
                    alert('Fehler beim Zuordnen der Kategorien.');
                }
            });
        });
    });
    </script>
</body>
```

```php
function getAllUsers($db) {
    try {
        // Erweiterte SQL-Abfrage, um auch Vor- und Nachnamen abzurufen
        $stmt = $db->query("SELECT id, first_name, last_name, username, email, role, last_login, logged_out, logged_in, activated FROM users ORDER BY username");
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Fehler beim Abrufen der Benutzer: " . $e->getMessage());
        return [];
    }
}

$users = getAllUsers($db);
$message = '';

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST' && isset($_POST['delete'])) {
    $userId = $_POST['user_id'];
    $stmt = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM users WHERE id = ?");
    if ($stmt->execute([$userId])) {
        $message = "Benutzer erfolgreich gelöscht.";
        $users = getAllUsers($db); // Aktualisiere die Benutzerliste
    } else {
        $message = "Fehler beim Löschen des Benutzers.";
    }
}

function formatDateTime($dateTime) {
    if ($dateTime) {
        return date("d.m.Y H:i:s", strtotime($dateTime));
    }
    return "N/A";
}

function calculateSessionDuration($lastLogin, $loggedOut) {
    if ($lastLogin && $loggedOut) {
        $start = new DateTime($lastLogin);
        $end = new DateTime($loggedOut);
        $interval = $start->diff($end);
        if ($interval->h > 0) {
            return $interval->h . " Stunden, " . $interval->i . " Minuten";
        } else {
            return $interval->i . " Minuten";
        }
    }
    return "N/A";
}
```

```php
    try {
        $db = new PDO("mysql:host=" . DB_HOST . ";dbname=" . DB_NAME, DB_USER, DB_PASS);
        $db->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);

        $db->beginTransaction();

        // Frage einfügen
        $stmt = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO questions (question_text, explanation) VALUES (?, ?)");
        $stmt->execute([$question_text, $explanation]);
        $question_id = $db->lastInsertId();

        // Kategorien zuweisen
        $stmt = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO question_categories (question_id, category_id) VALUES (?, ?)");
        foreach ($category_ids as $category_id) {
            $stmt->execute([$question_id, $category_id]);
        }

        // Antworten einfügen
        foreach ($answers as $index => $answer_text) {
            $is_correct = ($index == $correct_answer) ? 1 : 0;
            $stmt = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO answers (question_id, answer_text, is_correct) VALUES (?, ?, ?)");
            $stmt->execute([$question_id, $answer_text, $is_correct]);
        }

        $db->commit();
        $message = "Frage erfolgreich hinzugefügt.";
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        $db->rollBack();
        $message = "Fehler beim Hinzufügen der Frage: " . $e->getMessage();

    function addAnswer() {
    const answersDiv = document.getElementById('answers');
    const answerCount = answersDiv.children.length;

    // Bestätigung bei mehr als 4 Antworten
    if (answerCount >= 4) {
        if (!confirm('Wirklich mehr als 4 Antworten hinzufügen?')) {
            return;
        }
    }

    const newAnswer = document.createElement('div');
    newAnswer.classList.add('input-group', 'mb-3');
    newAnswer.innerHTML = `
        <input type="text" class="form-control" name="answers[]" required>
        <div class="input-group-append">
            <div class="input-group-text">
                <input type="radio" name="correct_answer" value="${answerCount}" required>
            </div>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-danger ml-2" onclick="removeAnswer(this)" ${answerCount === 0 ? 'disabled' : ''}>
                <i class="fas fa-trash"></i>
            </button>
        </div>
    `;
    answersDiv.appendChild(newAnswer);

    // Deaktiviere Lösch-Button bei erstem Element
    updateDeleteButtons();
}

function removeAnswer(button) {
    const answersDiv = document.getElementById('answers');
    if (answersDiv.children.length > 1) {
        button.closest('.input-group').remove();
        updateRadioValues();
        updateDeleteButtons();
    }
}

function updateRadioValues() {
    const answers = document.getElementById('answers').children;
    answers.forEach((answer, index) => {
        answer.querySelector('input[type="radio"]').value = index;
    });
}

function updateDeleteButtons() {
    const answersDiv = document.getElementById('answers');
    const deleteButtons = answersDiv.querySelectorAll('button');
    deleteButtons.forEach(button => {
        button.disabled = answersDiv.children.length <= 1;
    });
}
```

```php
<?php
session_start();
require_once '../config.php';
$userRole = $_SESSION['user_role'] ?? null;
if ($userRole === ROLE_ADMIN) {
    require_once __DIR__ . '/../inc/admin_nav_inc.php';
}

checkUserRole(ROLE_MANAGER);

// ===== LOGGING-FUNKTIONEN =====
function logQuestionAction($db, $userId, $questionId, $action, $details = '') {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            INSERT INTO log_entries (user_id, type, action, entity_type, entity_id, details, created_at)
            VALUES (?, 'audit', ?, 'question', ?, ?, NOW())
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$userId, $action, $questionId, $details]);
        return true;
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Logging-Fehler: " . $e->getMessage());
        return false;
    }
}

function getQuestionLogs($db, $questionId) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            SELECT l.action, l.details, l.created_at, u.first_name, u.last_name
            FROM log_entries l
            LEFT JOIN users u ON l.user_id = u.id
            WHERE l.entity_type = 'question' AND l.entity_id = ?
            ORDER BY l.created_at DESC
            LIMIT 100
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$questionId]);
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Fehler beim Abrufen der Logs: " . $e->getMessage());
        return [];
    }
}

// ===== FUNKTIONEN =====
function getQuestion($db, $id) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT q.*, GROUP_CONCAT(qc.category_id) as category_ids 
                              FROM questions q 
                              LEFT JOIN question_categories qc ON q.id = qc.question_id 
                              WHERE q.id = ?
                              GROUP BY q.id");
        $stmt->execute([$id]);
        return $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Fehler beim Abrufen der Frage: " . $e->getMessage());
        return null;
    }
}

function getAnswers($db, $questionId) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT * FROM answers WHERE question_id = ? ORDER BY id");
        $stmt->execute([$questionId]);
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Fehler beim Abrufen der Antworten: " . $e->getMessage());
        return [];
    }
}

function getCategories($db) {   
    try {
        $stmt = $db->query("SELECT * FROM categories ORDER BY name");
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Fehler beim Abrufen der Kategorien: " . $e->getMessage());
        return [];
    }
}

function getCategoryNamesByIds($db, $ids) {
    if (empty($ids)) return [];
    try {
        $placeholders = implode(',', array_fill(0, count($ids), '?'));
        $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT name FROM categories WHERE id IN ($placeholders)");
        $stmt->execute(array_values($ids));
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_COLUMN);
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Fehler beim Abrufen der Kategorienamen: " . $e->getMessage());
        return [];
    }
}

function getReportsForQuestion($db, $questionId) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            SELECT r.*, u.first_name, u.last_name
            FROM reports r
            JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id
            WHERE r.question_id = ?
            ORDER BY 
                CASE 
                    WHEN r.status = 'open' THEN 1
                    WHEN r.status = 'in_progress' THEN 2
                    WHEN r.status = 'resolved' THEN 3
                    WHEN r.status = 'rejected' THEN 4
                    ELSE 5
                END, 
                r.created_at DESC
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$questionId]);
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Fehler beim Abrufen der Reports: " . $e->getMessage());
        return [];
    }
}

function markReportAsResolved($db, $reportId) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("UPDATE reports SET status = 'resolved', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$reportId]);
        return true;
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Fehler beim Aktualisieren des Meldestatus: " . $e->getMessage());
        return false;
    }
}

function getSubmitterForQuestion($db, $questionId) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            SELECT 
                u.first_name AS submitter_first_name, 
                u.last_name AS submitter_last_name,
                qs.submitted_at,
                qs.status,
                r.first_name AS reviewer_first_name,
                r.last_name AS reviewer_last_name,
                qs.reviewed_at
            FROM question_submissions qs
            JOIN users u ON qs.user_id = u.id
            LEFT JOIN users r ON qs.reviewed_by = r.id
            WHERE qs.question_id = ?
            LIMIT 1
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$questionId]);
        return $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log('Fehler beim Abrufen des Einreichers: ' . $e->getMessage());
        return null;
    }
}

function updateSubmissionStatus($db, $questionId, $status, $reviewedBy) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            UPDATE question_submissions 
            SET status = ?, reviewed_by = ?, reviewed_at = NOW() 
            WHERE question_id = ?
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$status, $reviewedBy, $questionId]);
        return true;
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log('Fehler beim Aktualisieren des Frage-Status: ' . $e->getMessage());
        return false;
    }
}

// ===== INITIALISIERUNG =====
$categories = getCategories($db);
$message = '';

if (isset($_GET['id'])) {
    $questionId = intval($_GET['id']);
    $question = getQuestion($db, $questionId);
    $answers = getAnswers($db, $questionId);
} else {
    die("Frage nicht angegeben.");
}

$isDeleted = $question['deleted_at'] !== NULL;
$reports = getReportsForQuestion($db, $questionId);
$submitter = getSubmitterForQuestion($db, $questionId);
$questionLogs = getQuestionLogs($db, $questionId);

// ===== POST-HANDLER: FRAGENBEARBEITUNG =====
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST' && !isset($_POST['resolve_report_id']) && !isset($_POST['submission_status'])) {
    $questionText = $_POST['question_text'];
    $explanation = $_POST['explanation'] ?? '';
    $categoryIds = $_POST['category_ids'] ?? [];
    $deleteAnswers = $_POST['delete_answers'] ?? [];
    $answerTexts = $_POST['answer_text'] ?? [];
    $correctAnswerId = $_POST['correct_answer'] ?? null;

    try {
        $db->beginTransaction();
        
        $changes = [];
        $changeTypes = []; // Für Icons
        $oldQuestion = getQuestion($db, $questionId);
        $oldAnswers = getAnswers($db, $questionId);

        // 1. GELÖSCHTE ANTWORTEN
        if (!empty($deleteAnswers)) {
            foreach ($oldAnswers as $answer) {
                if (in_array($answer['id'], $deleteAnswers)) {
                    $statusText = $answer['is_correct'] ? 'RICHTIG' : 'FALSCH';
                    $changes[] = "DELETED_ANSWER||Antwort gelöscht: ID=" . $answer['id'] . " | Text=\"" . $answer['answer_text'] . "\" | Status=" . $statusText;
                    $changeTypes[] = 'answer_deleted';
                }
            }
            
            $placeholders = implode(',', array_fill(0, count($deleteAnswers), '?'));
            $stmt = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM answers WHERE id IN ($placeholders)");
            $stmt->execute($deleteAnswers);
        }

        // 2. FRAGETEXT ÄNDERUNG
        if ($oldQuestion['question_text'] !== $questionText) {
            $changes[] = "QUESTION_TEXT||Fragetext geändert: VON=\"" . $oldQuestion['question_text'] . "\" → AUF=\"" . $questionText . "\"";
            $changeTypes[] = 'question_edited';
        }
        
        // 3. ERKLÄRUNG ÄNDERUNG
        $oldExplanation = $oldQuestion['explanation'] ?? '';
        if ($oldExplanation !== $explanation) {
            if (empty($oldExplanation) && !empty($explanation)) {
                $changes[] = "EXPLANATION||Erklärung hinzugefügt: VON=\"(leer)\" → AUF=\"" . $explanation . "\"";
                $changeTypes[] = 'explanation_added';
            } elseif (!empty($oldExplanation) && empty($explanation)) {
                $changes[] = "EXPLANATION||Erklärung entfernt: VON=\"" . $oldExplanation . "\" → AUF=\"(leer)\"";
                $changeTypes[] = 'explanation_removed';
            } else {
                $changes[] = "EXPLANATION||Erklärung geändert: VON=\"" . $oldExplanation . "\" → AUF=\"" . $explanation . "\"";
                $changeTypes[] = 'explanation_edited';
            }
        }

        // Aktualisiere Frage
        $stmt = $db->prepare("UPDATE questions SET question_text = ?, explanation = ? WHERE id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$questionText, $explanation, $questionId]);

        // 4. KATEGORIEN ÄNDERUNGEN
        $oldCategoryIds = array_filter(explode(',', $oldQuestion['category_ids'] ?? ''));
        $addedCategoryIds = array_diff($categoryIds, $oldCategoryIds);
        $removedCategoryIds = array_diff($oldCategoryIds, $categoryIds);
        
        if (!empty($addedCategoryIds)) {
            $addedNames = getCategoryNamesByIds($db, $addedCategoryIds);
            foreach ($addedNames as $name) {
                $changes[] = "CATEGORY_ADDED||Kategorie hinzugefügt: \"" . $name . "\" (von NICHT AUSGEWÄHLT → auf AUSGEWÄHLT)";
                $changeTypes[] = 'category_added';
            }
        }
        
        if (!empty($removedCategoryIds)) {
            $removedNames = getCategoryNamesByIds($db, $removedCategoryIds);
            foreach ($removedNames as $name) {
                $changes[] = "CATEGORY_REMOVED||Kategorie entfernt: \"" . $name . "\" (von AUSGEWÄHLT → auf NICHT AUSGEWÄHLT)";
                $changeTypes[] = 'category_removed';
            }
        }

        // Kategorien aktualisieren
        $db->prepare("DELETE FROM question_categories WHERE question_id = ?")->execute([$questionId]);
        if (!empty($categoryIds)) {
            $stmt = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO question_categories (question_id, category_id) VALUES (?, ?)");
            foreach ($categoryIds as $catId) {
                $stmt->execute([$questionId, $catId]);
            }
        }

        // 5. ANTWORTEN AKTUALISIEREN
        $stmt = $db->prepare("UPDATE answers SET answer_text = ?, is_correct = ? WHERE id = ?");
        
        foreach ($oldAnswers as $oldAnswer) {
            // Nur nicht gelöschte Antworten prüfen
            if (!in_array($oldAnswer['id'], $deleteAnswers) && isset($answerTexts[$oldAnswer['id']])) {
                $newText = $answerTexts[$oldAnswer['id']];
                $newIsCorrect = ($oldAnswer['id'] == $correctAnswerId) ? 1 : 0;
                
                // Text geändert?
                if ($oldAnswer['answer_text'] !== $newText) {
                    $changes[] = "ANSWER_TEXT||Antworttext geändert: ID=" . $oldAnswer['id'] . " | VON=\"" . $oldAnswer['answer_text'] . "\" → AUF=\"" . $newText . "\"";
                    $changeTypes[] = 'answer_text_edited';
                }
                
                // Richtig/Falsch geändert?
                if ($oldAnswer['is_correct'] != $newIsCorrect) {
                    $statusAlt = $oldAnswer['is_correct'] ? "RICHTIG" : "FALSCH";
                    $statusNeu = $newIsCorrect ? "RICHTIG" : "FALSCH";
                    $changes[] = "ANSWER_STATUS||Antwortstatus geändert: ID=" . $oldAnswer['id'] . " | Text=\"" . $newText . "\" | VON=" . $statusAlt . " → AUF=" . $statusNeu;
                    $changeTypes[] = 'answer_status_changed';
                }
                
                $stmt->execute([$newText, $newIsCorrect, $oldAnswer['id']]);
            }
        }

        // 6. NEUE ANTWORTEN
        if (isset($_POST['new_answers']) && !empty($_POST['new_answers'])) {
            $stmt = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO answers (question_id, answer_text, is_correct) VALUES (?, ?, ?)");
            foreach ($_POST['new_answers'] as $newAnswerId => $text) {
                $isCorrect = ($newAnswerId == $correctAnswerId) ? 1 : 0;
                $stmt->execute([$questionId, $text, $isCorrect]);
                $newInsertedId = $db->lastInsertId();
                $status = $isCorrect ? 'RICHTIG' : 'FALSCH';
                $changes[] = "ANSWER_ADDED||Neue Antwort hinzugefügt: ID=" . $newInsertedId . " | Text=\"" . $text . "\" | Status=" . $status . " (von NICHT VORHANDEN → auf VORHANDEN)";
                $changeTypes[] = 'answer_added';
            }
        }

        // LOGGING mit Typ-Information
        if (!empty($changes)) {
            // Speichere die Änderungstypen für die Anzeige
            $typeString = implode(',', array_unique($changeTypes));
            $logDetails = $typeString . '###' . implode(' | ', $changes);
            logQuestionAction($db, $_SESSION['user_id'], $questionId, 'question_edited', $logDetails);
        }

        $db->commit();
        $message = "Frage erfolgreich aktualisiert!";
        
        $question = getQuestion($db, $questionId);
        $answers = getAnswers($db, $questionId);
        $questionLogs = getQuestionLogs($db, $questionId);

    } catch (Exception $e) {
        $db->rollBack();
        $message = "Fehler: " . $e->getMessage();
        error_log("Fehler bei Fragenbearbeitung: " . $e->getMessage());
    }
}

// ===== POST-HANDLER: REPORT ALS ERLEDIGT MARKIEREN =====
if (isset($_POST['resolve_report_id'])) {
    $reportId = intval($_POST['resolve_report_id']);
    if (markReportAsResolved($db, $reportId)) {
        logQuestionAction($db, $_SESSION['user_id'], $questionId, 'report_resolved', "report_resolved###Report #$reportId als erledigt markiert");
        $message = "Meldung erfolgreich als erledigt markiert.";
    } else {
        $message = "Fehler beim Aktualisieren der Meldung.";
    }
    $reports = getReportsForQuestion($db, $questionId);
    $questionLogs = getQuestionLogs($db, $questionId);
}

// ===== POST-HANDLER: SUBMISSION-STATUS ÄNDERN =====
if (isset($_POST['submission_status']) && isset($_POST['question_id'])) {
    $newStatus = $_POST['submission_status'];
    $questionId = intval($_POST['question_id']);
    $reviewedBy = $_SESSION['user_id'];

    if (updateSubmissionStatus($db, $questionId, $newStatus, $reviewedBy)) {
        $statusText = [
            'approved' => 'genehmigt',
            'rejected' => 'abgelehnt',
            'pending' => 'zurückgesetzt auf ausstehend'
        ][$newStatus] ?? $newStatus;
        
        logQuestionAction($db, $reviewedBy, $questionId, 'submission_status_changed', "submission_status_changed###Status auf '$statusText' geändert");
        
        switch ($newStatus) {
            case 'approved':
                $message = "Die Frage wurde als <strong>genehmigt</strong> markiert.";
                break;
            case 'rejected':
                $message = "Die Frage wurde als <strong>abgelehnt</strong> markiert.";
                break;
            case 'pending':
                $message = "Die Frage wurde auf <strong>ausstehend</strong> zurückgesetzt.";
                break;
        }
    } else {
        $message = "Fehler beim Aktualisieren des Fragenstatus.";
    }

    $submitter = getSubmitterForQuestion($db, $questionId);
    $questionLogs = getQuestionLogs($db, $questionId);
}

                                                    $uniqueTypes = array_unique($changeTypes);
                                                    foreach ($uniqueTypes as $type) {

    <script>
    let answerCounter = <?php echo count($answers); ?>;

    function addAnswer() {
        const answersDiv = document.getElementById('answers');
        const answerCount = answersDiv.children.length;

        if (answerCount >= 4) {
            if (!confirm('Wirklich mehr als 4 Antworten hinzufügen?')) {
                return;
            }
        }

        answerCounter++;
        const newAnswerId = 'new_' + answerCounter;

        const newAnswer = document.createElement('div');
        newAnswer.classList.add('form-group');
        newAnswer.innerHTML = `
            <div class="input-group mb-3">
                <input type="text" name="new_answers[${newAnswerId}]" class="form-control" placeholder="Neue Antwort eingeben" required>
                <div class="input-group-append">
                    <div class="input-group-text">
                        <input type="radio" name="correct_answer" value="${newAnswerId}" required>
                        <label class="mb-0 ml-2">Richtig</label>
                    </div>
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-danger ml-2" onclick="removeNewAnswer(this)">
                        <i class="fas fa-trash"></i>
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>
        `;
        answersDiv.appendChild(newAnswer);
    }

    function removeNewAnswer(button) {
        if (confirm('Diese neue Antwort wirklich entfernen?')) {
            button.closest('.form-group').remove();
        }
    }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```php
// Benutzerstatistik abrufen
function getUserStatistics($db, $userId) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT 
            SUM(correct_count) as total_correct,
            SUM(incorrect_count) as total_incorrect,
            udp.current_points,
            udp.streak,
            udp.last_answered,
            COUNT(CASE WHEN DATE(us.last_shown) = CURDATE() THEN 1 END) as questions_today
            FROM user_statistics us
            LEFT JOIN user_daily_points udp ON udp.user_id = us.user_id
            WHERE us.user_id = ? 
            GROUP BY us.user_id");
        $stmt->execute([$userId]);
        return $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Fehler beim Abrufen der Benutzerstatistik: " . $e->getMessage());
        return false;
    }
}
```

## File: old_manage_categories.php

```php
<?php
ini_set('display_errors', 1);
ini_set('display_startup_errors', 1);
error_reporting(E_ALL);
session_start();
require_once '../config.php';

// Überprüfen, ob der Benutzer angemeldet ist und die Rolle Admin oder Manager hat
checkUserRole(ROLE_MANAGER);

// Funktion zum Abrufen aller Kategorien
function getCategories($db) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->query("SELECT c.id, c.name, COUNT(qc.question_id) as question_count 
                            FROM categories c
                            LEFT JOIN question_categories qc ON c.id = qc.category_id
                            GROUP BY c.id
                            ORDER BY c.name");
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Fehler beim Abrufen der Kategorien: " . $e->getMessage());
        return [];
    }
}

// Funktion zum Hinzufügen einer neuen Kategorie
function addCategory($db, $name) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO categories (name) VALUES (?)");
        $stmt->execute([$name]);
        return true;
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Fehler beim Hinzufügen der Kategorie: " . $e->getMessage());
        return false;
    }
}

// Funktion zum Löschen einer Kategorie
function deleteCategory($db, $id) {
    try {
        $db->beginTransaction();

        // Lösche nur die Zuordnung der Fragen zur Kategorie, nicht die Fragen selbst
        $stmt = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM question_categories WHERE category_id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$id]);

        // Lösche die Kategorie selbst
        $stmt = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM categories WHERE id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$id]);

        $db->commit();
        return true;
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        $db->rollBack();
        error_log("Fehler beim Löschen der Kategorie: " . $e->getMessage());
        return false;
    }
}

// Funktion zum Bearbeiten des Namens einer Kategorie
function updateCategoryName($db, $id, $newName) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("UPDATE categories SET name = ? WHERE id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$newName, $id]);
        return true;
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Fehler beim Bearbeiten des Kategorienamens: " . $e->getMessage());
        return false;
    }
}

$message = '';

// Verarbeitung des Formulars zum Hinzufügen einer Kategorie
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST' && isset($_POST['add_category'])) {
    $categoryName = trim($_POST['category_name']);
    if (!empty($categoryName)) {
        if (addCategory($db, $categoryName)) {
            $message = "Kategorie erfolgreich hinzugefügt.";
        } else {
            $message = "Fehler beim Hinzufügen der Kategorie.";
        }
    } else {
        $message = "Bitte geben Sie einen Kategorienamen ein.";
    }
}

// Verarbeitung der Anfrage zum Löschen einer Kategorie
if (isset($_POST['delete_category'])) {
    $categoryId = $_POST['category_id'];
    $questionCount = $_POST['question_count'];
    
    // Warnung bei Löschung einer Kategorie mit Fragen
    if ($questionCount > 0) {
        echo "<script>
                if (confirm('Achtung: Diese Kategorie enthält Fragen. Möchten Sie diese Kategorie wirklich löschen?')) {
                    window.location.href = '?delete_confirmed=true&category_id=' + $categoryId;
                }
              </script>";
    } else {
        if (deleteCategory($db, $categoryId)) {
            $message = "Kategorie erfolgreich gelöscht.";
        } else {
            $message = "Fehler beim Löschen der Kategorie.";
        }
    }
}

// Verarbeitung der Bestätigung zum Löschen der Kategorie
if (isset($_GET['delete_confirmed']) && $_GET['delete_confirmed'] == 'true' && isset($_GET['category_id'])) {
    $categoryId = $_GET['category_id'];
    if (deleteCategory($db, $categoryId)) {
        $message = "Kategorie erfolgreich gelöscht.";
    } else {
        $message = "Fehler beim Löschen der Kategorie.";
    }
}

// Verarbeitung der Anfrage zum Bearbeiten des Namens einer Kategorie
if (isset($_POST['edit_category_name'])) {
    $categoryId = $_POST['category_id'];
    $newCategoryName = trim($_POST['new_category_name']);
    if (!empty($newCategoryName)) {
        if (updateCategoryName($db, $categoryId, $newCategoryName)) {
            $message = "Kategoriename erfolgreich geändert.";
        } else {
            $message = "Fehler beim Bearbeiten des Kategorienamens.";
        }
    } else {
        $message = "Bitte geben Sie einen neuen Kategorienamen ein.";
    }
}

// Abrufen aller Kategorien
$categories = getCategories($db);
?>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="de">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Kategorien verwalten - Quiz App</title>
```

```php
function getAllQuestions($db, $categoryIds = [], $showUncategorized = false, $includeDeleted = false) {
    try {
        // Basis-SQL mit Soft-Delete-Option
        $sql = "
            SELECT 
                q.id, 
                q.question_text, 
                q.deleted_at,
                GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.name ORDER BY c.name ASC SEPARATOR ', ') AS categories,
                (SELECT answer_text FROM answers WHERE question_id = q.id AND is_correct = 1 LIMIT 1) AS correct_answer
            FROM questions q 
            LEFT JOIN question_categories qc ON q.id = qc.question_id
            LEFT JOIN categories c ON qc.category_id = c.id
        ";

        $whereClauses = [];
        $params = [];

        // Soft-Delete-Filter (nur wenn nicht explizit gewünscht)
        if (!$includeDeleted) {
            $whereClauses[] = "q.deleted_at IS NULL";
        }

        // Kategorien-Filter
        if (!empty($categoryIds)) {
            $whereClauses[] = "c.id IN (" . implode(',', array_fill(0, count($categoryIds), '?')) . ")";
            $params = array_merge($params, $categoryIds);
        }

        // Unkategorisierte Fragen
        if ($showUncategorized) {
            $whereClauses[] = "c.id IS NULL";
        }

        // WHERE-Klausel kombinieren
        if (!empty($whereClauses)) {
            $sql .= " WHERE " . implode(" AND ", $whereClauses);
        }

        $sql .= " GROUP BY q.id ORDER BY q.id DESC";

        $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
        
        // Parameter binden
        foreach ($params as $index => $value) {
            $stmt->bindValue($index + 1, $value, PDO::PARAM_INT);
        }

        $stmt->execute();
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Fehler beim Abrufen der Fragen: " . $e->getMessage());
        return [];
    }
}

// Hole die Kategorien zur Anzeige im Filter
function getCategories($db) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->query("SELECT id, name FROM categories ORDER BY name");
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Fehler beim Abrufen der Kategorien: " . $e->getMessage());
        return [];
    }
}

// Überprüfen und Speichern der Filterkriterien in der Session
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'GET' && isset($_GET['category'])) {
    $_SESSION['category_filter'] = $_GET['category'];
}

// Filter zurücksetzen, wenn der Button gedrückt wird
if (isset($_GET['reset_filter'])) {
    unset($_SESSION['category_filter']);
    header("Location: manage_questions.php");
    exit();
}

// Abrufen der Filterkriterien aus der Session, wenn verfügbar
$categoryIds = isset($_SESSION['category_filter']) ? $_SESSION['category_filter'] : [];
$showUncategorized = isset($_GET['uncategorized']) ? true : false;

// Hole Kategorien und Fragen basierend auf den Filtereinstellungen
$categories = getCategories($db);
$questions = getAllQuestions($db, $categoryIds, $showUncategorized);

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST' && isset($_POST['delete'])) {
    $questionId = $_POST['question_id'];
    if (deleteQuestion($db, $questionId)) {
        $message = "Frage erfolgreich gelöscht.";
        $questions = getAllQuestions($db, $categoryIds, $showUncategorized); // Aktualisiere die Fragenliste
    } else {
        $message = "Fehler beim Löschen der Frage.";
    }
}

// Softdelete
function softDeleteQuestion($pdo, $questionId) {
    try {
        $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
            UPDATE questions 
            SET deleted_at = NOW() 
            WHERE id = ?
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$questionId]);
        return "Frage #$questionId wurde soft-gelöscht.";
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        return "Fehler: " . $e->getMessage();
    }
}

// Wiederherstellen
function undeleteQuestion($pdo, $questionId) {
    try {
        $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
            UPDATE questions 
            SET deleted_at = NULL 
            WHERE id = ?
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$questionId]);
        return "Frage #$questionId wurde wiederhergestellt.";
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        return "Fehler: " . $e->getMessage();
    }
}
```

```php
        DB_USER,

    );
    $db->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);

} catch (PDOException $e) {
    die("<div class='alert alert-danger'>Datenbankverbindung fehlgeschlagen: " . htmlspecialchars($e->getMessage()) . "</div>");
}

    $_SESSION['csrf_token'] = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));

// Funktionen
function getAllReports($db) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            SELECT r.id, r.question_id, r.user_id, r.report_type,
                   r.details, r.created_at, r.status, r.feedback,
                   u.first_name, u.last_name
            FROM reports r
            LEFT JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id
            WHERE r.status NOT IN ('resolved', 'rejected')
            ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
        ");
        $stmt->execute();
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("getAllReports Fehler: " . $e->getMessage());
        return [];
    }
}

function updateReportStatus($db, $reportId, $status, $feedback) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            UPDATE reports
            SET status = :status,
                feedback = :feedback
            WHERE id = :id
        ");

        $stmt->execute([
            ':status' => $status,
            ':feedback' => trim($feedback),
            ':id' => $reportId
        ]);

        return $stmt->rowCount() > 0;
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("UpdateReportStatus Fehler ID $reportId: " . $e->getMessage());
        return false;
    }
}

function sendUserNotification($db, $userId, $reportId, $message) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            INSERT INTO user_notifications (user_id, report_id, message)
            VALUES (:user_id, :report_id, :message)
        ");
        $stmt->execute([
            ':user_id' => $userId,
            ':report_id' => $reportId,
            ':message' => trim($message)
        ]);
        return $stmt->rowCount() > 0;
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("sendUserNotification Fehler für User ID $userId und Report ID $reportId: " . $e->getMessage());
        return false;
    }
}


// POST-Handler
$message = '';
$validStatuses = ['open', 'in_progress', 'resolved', 'rejected'];

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST' && isset($_POST['update_status'])) {
    // CSRF-Validierung
    if (!isset($_POST['csrf_token']) || !hash_equals($_SESSION['csrf_token'], $_POST['csrf_token'])) {
        die("Ungültige Anfrage");
    }

    // Eingabeverarbeitung
    $reportId = filter_input(INPUT_POST, 'report_id', FILTER_VALIDATE_INT);
    $status = filter_input(INPUT_POST, 'status', FILTER_SANITIZE_SPECIAL_CHARS);
    $feedback = filter_input(INPUT_POST, 'feedback', FILTER_SANITIZE_SPECIAL_CHARS);

    // Validierung
    if (!$reportId || !in_array($status, $validStatuses)) {
        $message = '<div class="alert alert-danger">Ungültige Eingabewerte</div>';
    } else {
        if (updateReportStatus($db, $reportId, $status, $feedback)) {
            // E-Mail nur senden, wenn Feedback vorhanden ist und Status 'resolved' oder 'rejected' ist
            if (!empty(trim($feedback)) && ($status === 'resolved' || $status === 'rejected')) {
                // Finde die E-Mail und Namen des Reporters
                $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT u.email, u.first_name, u.last_name FROM reports r LEFT JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.id = :report_id");
                $stmt->execute([':report_id' => $reportId]);
                $reportUserData = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

                if ($reportUserData && isset($reportUserData['email'])) {
                    // E-Mail senden
                    $empfaengerEmail = $reportUserData['email'];
                    $empfaengerName = $reportUserData['first_name'] . ' ' . $reportUserData['last_name'];

                    if (sendReportFeedbackEmail($empfaengerEmail, $empfaengerName, $reportId, trim($feedback), $status)) {
                        $_SESSION['message'] = [
                            'type' => 'success',
                            'text' => 'Status aktualisiert und E-Mail gesendet'
                        ];
                    } else {
                        $_SESSION['message'] = [
                            'type' => 'warning',
                            'text' => 'Status aktualisiert, aber das Senden der E-Mail ist fehlgeschlagen.'
                        ];
                        error_log("Fehler beim Senden der Feedback-E-Mail für Report ID $reportId an " . $empfaengerEmail);
                    }
                } else {
                    $_SESSION['message'] = [
                        'type' => 'warning',
                        'text' => 'Status aktualisiert, aber die E-Mail-Adresse für diesen Report konnte nicht gefunden werden.'
                    ];
                    error_log("E-Mail-Adresse für Report ID $reportId nicht gefunden.");
                }
            } else {
                $_SESSION['message'] = [
                    'type' => 'success',
                    'text' => 'Status erfolgreich aktualisiert'
                ];
            }
            header("Location: " . htmlspecialchars($_SERVER['PHP_SELF']));
            exit;
        } else {
            $message = '<div class="alert alert-danger">Aktualisierung fehlgeschlagen. Fehler-Log: ' . time() . '</div>';
        }
    }
}


// Session-Nachrichten
if (isset($_SESSION['message'])) {
    $message = '<div class="alert alert-' . htmlspecialchars($_SESSION['message']['type']) . '">'
             . htmlspecialchars($_SESSION['message']['text']) . '</div>';
    unset($_SESSION['message']);
}

$reports = getAllReports($db);
?>
```

```php
function getAllReports($db) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            SELECT r.id, r.question_id, r.user_id, r.report_type, 
                   r.details, r.created_at, r.status, r.feedback,
                   u.first_name, u.last_name
            FROM reports r
            LEFT JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id
            ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
        ");
        $stmt->execute();
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("getAllReports Fehler: " . $e->getMessage());
        return [];
    }
}

function updateReportStatus($db, $reportId, $status, $feedback) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            UPDATE reports
            SET status = :status,
                feedback = :feedback
            WHERE id = :id
        ");
        
        $stmt->execute([
            ':status' => $status,
            ':feedback' => trim($feedback),
            ':id' => $reportId
        ]);
        
        return $stmt->rowCount() > 0;
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("UpdateReportStatus Fehler ID $reportId: " . $e->getMessage());
        return false;
    }
}
```
