<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

error_reporting(E_ALL);
ini_set('display_errors', '1');

session_start();

require_once '../config.php';
require_once '../vendor/autoload.php';

use TCPDF;

checkUserRole('admin');

// DB-Verbindung
if (!isset($pdo) || !$pdo instanceof PDO) {
    try {
        $pdo = new PDO(
            "mysql:host=" . DB_HOST . ";dbname=" . DB_NAME . ";charset=utf8mb4",
            DB_USER,
            DB_PASS,
            [
                PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION,
                PDO::ATTR_DEFAULT_FETCH_MODE => PDO::FETCH_ASSOC,
                PDO::ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES => false
            ]
        );
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("DB-Verbindungsfehler: " . $e->getMessage());
        die("Datenbankverbindung fehlgeschlagen.");
    }
}

/**
 * Fragen und Antworten abrufen
 */
function getQuestions(PDO $pdo, array $categorySettings): array {
    $result = [];
    $usedQuestionIds = []; // Tracking für bereits verwendete Fragen
    
    foreach ($categorySettings as $catId => $settings) {
        $stmtCat = $pdo->prepare("SELECT name FROM categories WHERE id = ?");
        $stmtCat->execute([$catId]);
        $catName = $stmtCat->fetchColumn();
        
        if (!$catName) continue;

        // Wenn limit = 0, dann alle Fragen holen
        $sql = "
            SELECT q.id, q.question_text
            FROM questions q
            JOIN question_categories qc ON q.id = qc.question_id
            WHERE qc.category_id = ? AND q.deleted_at IS NULL
            ORDER BY RAND()
        ";
        
        if ($settings['limit'] > 0) {
            $sql .= " LIMIT " . (int)$settings['limit'];
        }

        $stmt = $pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute([$catId]);
        $questions = $stmt->fetchAll();

        $stmtAns = $pdo->prepare("
            SELECT answer_text, is_correct 
            FROM answers 
            WHERE question_id = ? 
            ORDER BY RAND()
        ");

        $categoryQuestions = [];
        foreach ($questions as $question) {
            // Nur Fragen hinzufügen, die noch nicht verwendet wurden
            if (!in_array($question['id'], $usedQuestionIds)) {
                $stmtAns->execute([$question['id']]);
                $question['answers'] = $stmtAns->fetchAll();
                $categoryQuestions[] = $question;
                $usedQuestionIds[] = $question['id'];
            }
        }

        if (!empty($categoryQuestions)) {
            $result[] = [
                'category_id' => $catId,
                'category_name' => $catName,
                'questions' => $categoryQuestions
            ];
        }
    }
    
    return $result;
}

/**
 * Custom TCPDF Klasse für Header und Footer
 */
class CustomPDF extends TCPDF {
    private $docTitle = '';
    
    public function setDocTitle($title) {
        $this->docTitle = $title;
    }
    
    public function Header() {
        if (!empty($this->docTitle)) {
            $this->SetFont('helvetica', 'B', 14);
            $this->Cell(0, 10, $this->docTitle, 0, 1, 'C');
            $this->Ln(2);
        }
    }
    
    public function Footer() {
        $this->SetY(-12);
        
        // Dezente Linie über der Fußzeile (direkt über der Seitenzahl)
        $this->SetDrawColor(220, 220, 220);
        $this->SetLineWidth(0.3);
        $this->Line(15, $this->GetY() - 2, 195, $this->GetY() - 2);
        
        $this->SetFont('helvetica', '', 9);
        $this->SetX(15);
        $this->Cell(180, 10, 'Seite ' . $this->getAliasNumPage() . ' von ' . $this->getAliasNbPages(), 0, 0, 'C');
    }
}

/**
 * PDF generieren (Aufgaben- oder Lösungsbogen)
 */
function generatePdf(array $questionsData, bool $isSolution): void {
    $pdf = new CustomPDF('P', 'mm', 'A4', true, 'UTF-8');
    
    $pdf->setDocTitle($isSolution ? 'Lösungsbogen' : '');
    $pdf->SetCreator('Prüfungsgenerator');
    $pdf->SetAuthor('Gesundheitsamt');
    $pdf->SetTitle($isSolution ? 'Lösungsbogen' : 'Prüfung');
    
    $pdf->SetMargins(15, 25, 15);
    $pdf->SetAutoPageBreak(true, 20);
    $pdf->setImageScale(PDF_IMAGE_SCALE_RATIO);
    
    $pdf->AddPage();

    $questionCounter = 1;

    foreach ($questionsData as $categoryIndex => $category) {
        // Jede Kategorie beginnt auf einer neuen Seite (außer der ersten)
        if ($categoryIndex > 0) {
            $pdf->AddPage();
        }

        $pdf->SetFont('helvetica', 'B', 14);
        $pdf->SetFillColor(240, 242, 245);
        $pdf->Cell(0, 10, $category['category_name'], 0, 1, 'L', true);
        $pdf->Ln(4);

        foreach ($category['questions'] as $question) {
            // Platzbedarf berechnen
            $questionText = strip_tags($question['question_text']);
            $pdf->SetFont('helvetica', 'B', 11);
            
            // Fragenummer-Breite
            $questionNumber = $questionCounter . '. ';
            $numberWidth = $pdf->GetStringWidth($questionNumber);
            $questionHeight = $pdf->getStringHeight(180 - $numberWidth, $questionText);

            $answerHeight = 0;
            $pdf->SetFont('helvetica', '', 10);
            foreach ($question['answers'] as $answer) {
                $answerHeight += $pdf->getStringHeight(172, strip_tags($answer['answer_text'])) + 6;
            }

            $totalHeight = 4 + $questionHeight + 3 + $answerHeight + 8; // ID + Frage + Abstand + Antworten + Trennlinie

            // Verfügbare Höhe auf aktueller Seite
            $availableHeight = $pdf->getPageHeight() - $pdf->GetY() - 20; // 20mm für Footer

            // Intelligenter Seitenumbruch: Nur wenn Frage wirklich nicht mehr passt
            // Aber: Wenn noch mehr als 40% der Seite verfügbar ist, versuchen wir es
            if ($totalHeight > $availableHeight) {
                // Wenn weniger als 80mm verfügbar sind, umbrechen
                // Sonst versuchen wir die Frage noch zu platzieren
                if ($availableHeight < 80) {
                    $pdf->AddPage();
                }
            }

            // Frage-Block mit zartem Hintergrund
            $startY = $pdf->GetY();
            
            // ID dezent in der Ecke
            $pdf->SetFont('helvetica', '', 7);
            $pdf->SetTextColor(150, 150, 150);
            $pdf->Cell(180, 4, 'ID: ' . $question['id'], 0, 1, 'R');
            $pdf->SetTextColor(0, 0, 0);

            // Fragentext mit Einrückung bei mehrzeiligen Fragen
            $pdf->SetFont('helvetica', 'B', 11);
            
            // Fragenummer und Text getrennt behandeln für Einrückung
            $questionNumber = $questionCounter . '. ';
            $questionTextOnly = $questionText;
            
            // Breite der Fragenummer berechnen
            $numberWidth = $pdf->GetStringWidth($questionNumber);
            
            // Fragenummer ausgeben
            $startX = $pdf->GetX();
            $startY = $pdf->GetY();
            $pdf->Cell($numberWidth, 5, $questionNumber, 0, 0, 'L');
            
            // Fragentext mit Einrückung für mehrzeilige Darstellung
            $pdf->MultiCell(180 - $numberWidth, 5, $questionTextOnly, 0, 'L', false, 1, $startX + $numberWidth, $startY);
            $pdf->Ln(3);

            // Antworten
            $pdf->SetFont('helvetica', '', 10);
            
            foreach ($question['answers'] as $answer) {
                $isCorrect = (bool)$answer['is_correct'];
                $answerText = strip_tags($answer['answer_text']);

                $x = $pdf->GetX();
                $y = $pdf->GetY();

                // Checkbox als Kästchen mit schwarzem Rahmen zeichnen
                $boxSize = 4;
                $pdf->SetDrawColor(0, 0, 0); // Schwarz
                $pdf->SetLineWidth(0.4);
                $pdf->Rect($x + 1, $y + 1, $boxSize, $boxSize, 'D');
                $pdf->SetDrawColor(0, 0, 0); // Sicherstellen dass schwarz bleibt
                
                // Häkchen bei Lösungsbogen
                if ($isSolution && $isCorrect) {
                    $pdf->SetFont('zapfdingbats', '', 9);
                    $pdf->SetTextColor(0, 128, 0);
                    $pdf->SetXY($x, $y + 0.5);
                    $pdf->Cell(7, 6, '4', 0, 0, 'C');
                    $pdf->SetFont('helvetica', 'B', 10);
                } else {
                    $pdf->SetFont('helvetica', '', 10);
                }

                // Antworttext mit Einrückung - Text etwas nach unten
                $pdf->SetXY($x + 8, $y + 0.5);
                
                if ($isSolution && $isCorrect) {
                    $pdf->SetTextColor(0, 128, 0);
                }
                
                // MultiCell für mehrzeilige Antworten mit Einrückung
                $pdf->MultiCell(172, 5, $answerText, 0, 'L', false, 1, '', '', true, 0, false, true, 0, 'T');
                
                $pdf->SetTextColor(0, 0, 0);
                
                // Mehr Abstand zwischen Antworten
                $pdf->Ln(1);
            }

            // Zarte Trennlinie
            $pdf->Ln(3);
            $pdf->SetDrawColor(220, 220, 220);
            $pdf->SetLineWidth(0.3);
            $pdf->Line($pdf->GetX(), $pdf->GetY(), $pdf->GetX() + 180, $pdf->GetY());
            $pdf->SetDrawColor(0, 0, 0); // Zurück auf schwarz für nächste Kästchen
            $pdf->Ln(5);

            $questionCounter++;
        }
    }

    $filename = $isSolution ? 'Loesungsbogen.pdf' : 'Pruefung.pdf';
    $pdf->Output($filename, 'I');
    exit;
}

/**
 * Kategorieeinstellungen validieren
 */
function validateCategorySettings(array $postData): array {
    $categorySettings = [];

    if (empty($postData['categories']) || !is_array($postData['categories'])) {
        return $categorySettings;
    }

    foreach ($postData['categories'] as $catId => $settings) {
        if (!is_numeric($catId)) continue;

        $isActive = isset($settings['active']) && $settings['active'] == '1';
        $limit = isset($settings['limit']) && is_numeric($settings['limit']) 
            ? max(0, (int)$settings['limit']) 
            : 0;

        if ($isActive) {
            $categorySettings[(int)$catId] = ['limit' => $limit];
        }
    }

    return $categorySettings;
}

// Formularverarbeitung
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST' && isset($_POST['action'])) {
    $categorySettings = validateCategorySettings($_POST);

    if (empty($categorySettings)) {
        die("Bitte mindestens eine Kategorie auswählen.");
    }

    $questionsData = getQuestions($pdo, $categorySettings);

    if (empty($questionsData)) {
        die("Keine Fragen gefunden! Bitte Kategorieeinstellungen überprüfen.");
    }

    // Fragen in Session speichern für zweites PDF
    $_SESSION['quiz_data'] = $questionsData;
    $_SESSION['quiz_timestamp'] = time();

    if ($_POST['action'] === 'pdf') {
        generatePdf($questionsData, false);
    }
}

// Lösungsbogen aus Session-Daten generieren
if (isset($_GET['loesungen']) && isset($_SESSION['quiz_data'])) {
    // Session-Daten nur 5 Minuten gültig
    if (isset($_SESSION['quiz_timestamp']) && (time() - $_SESSION['quiz_timestamp']) < 300) {
        generatePdf($_SESSION['quiz_data'], true);
    } else {
        die("Session abgelaufen. Bitte generieren Sie die Prüfung erneut.");
    }
}

// Kategorien laden
$categories = $pdo->query("SELECT id, name FROM categories ORDER BY name")->fetchAll();

    die("<div class='alert alert-danger'>Datenbankverbindung fehlgeschlagen: " . htmlspecialchars($e->getMessage()) . "</div>");

// Berechtigungsprüfung
checkUserRole(ROLE_ADMIN);

// CSRF-Token Handling
if (empty($_SESSION['csrf_token'])) {
    $_SESSION['csrf_token'] = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
}

// Funktionen
function getReportsByStatus($db, $statuses) {
    try {
        $placeholders = str_repeat('?,', count($statuses) - 1) . '?';
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            SELECT r.id, r.question_id, r.user_id, r.report_type,
                   r.details, r.created_at, r.status, r.feedback,
                   u.first_name, u.last_name,
                   qr.id as review_id, qr.status as review_status, qr.reviewer_id,
                   rev.first_name as reviewer_first_name, rev.last_name as reviewer_last_name
            FROM reports r
            LEFT JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id
            LEFT JOIN question_reviews qr ON r.id = qr.report_id
            LEFT JOIN users rev ON qr.reviewer_id = rev.id
            WHERE r.status IN ($placeholders)
            ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
        ");
        $stmt->execute($statuses);
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("getReportsByStatus Fehler: " . $e->getMessage());
        return [];
    }
}

function updateReportStatus($db, $reportId, $status, $feedback) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            UPDATE reports
            SET status = :status,
                feedback = :feedback
            WHERE id = :id
        ");
        $stmt->execute([
            ':status' => $status,
            ':feedback' => trim($feedback),
            ':id' => $reportId
        ]);
        return $stmt->rowCount() > 0;
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("UpdateReportStatus Fehler ID $reportId: " . $e->getMessage());
        return false;
    }
}

// POST-Handler
$message = '';

$validStatuses = ['open', 'resolved', 'rejected'];

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST' && isset($_POST['pool_action'])) {
    if (!isset($_POST['csrf_token']) || !hash_equals($_SESSION['csrf_token'], $_POST['csrf_token'])) {
        http_response_code(403);
        die(json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Ungültige Anfrage (CSRF-Token fehlt oder ungültig)']));
    }
    
    header('Content-Type: application/json');
    
    try {
        $reportId = filter_input(INPUT_POST, 'report_id', FILTER_VALIDATE_INT);
        if (!$reportId) {
            throw new Exception('Ungültige Report-ID');
        }
        
        switch ($_POST['pool_action']) {
            case 'move_to_pool':
                $result = $reviewSystem->moveToPool($reportId, $_SESSION['user_id']);
                echo json_encode($result);
                exit;
                
            case 'remove_from_pool':
                $result = $reviewSystem->removeFromPool($reportId, $_SESSION['user_id']);
                echo json_encode($result);

            default:
                throw new Exception('Unbekannte Pool-Aktion: ' . $_POST['pool_action']);

    } catch (Exception $e) {
        http_response_code(500);
        error_log("Pool-Aktion Fehler: " . $e->getMessage());

}

if (isset($_GET['action']) && $_GET['action'] === 'get_question') {

        $question = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        
        if (!$question) {
            die(json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Frage nicht gefunden']));
        }
        
        // Hole alle Kategorien für diese Frage
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            SELECT c.id, c.name
            FROM question_categories qc
            JOIN categories c ON qc.category_id = c.id
            WHERE qc.question_id = ?
            ORDER BY c.name
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$questionId]);
        $question['categories'] = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        
        // Hole Antworten
        $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT answer_text, is_correct FROM answers WHERE question_id = ? ORDER BY id");
        $stmt->execute([$questionId]);
        $question['answers'] = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        
        // Hole alle Meldungen zu dieser Frage
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            SELECT r.id, r.report_type, r.details, r.status, r.feedback, r.created_at,
                   u.first_name, u.last_name
            FROM reports r
            LEFT JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id
            WHERE r.question_id = ?
            ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$questionId]);
        $question['reports'] = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        
        // Hole Log-Einträge für diese Frage (über Reviews)
        try {
            $stmt = $db->prepare("
                SELECT l.action, l.details, l.created_at, u.first_name, u.last_name
                FROM log_entries l
                LEFT JOIN users u ON l.user_id = u.id
                LEFT JOIN question_reviews qr ON l.entity_type = 'review' AND l.entity_id = qr.id
                LEFT JOIN reports r ON qr.report_id = r.id
                WHERE r.question_id = ?
                ORDER BY l.created_at DESC
                LIMIT 20
            ");
            $stmt->execute([$questionId]);
            $question['logs'] = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        } catch (PDOException $e) {
            error_log("Log-Abfrage Fehler für Frage $questionId: " . $e->getMessage());
            $question['logs'] = [];
        }
        
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'question' => $question]);
        exit;
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        error_log("get_question Fehler: " . $e->getMessage() . " | Trace: " . $e->getTraceAsString());
        die(json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Datenbankfehler: ' . $e->getMessage()]));
    }
}

// Handler für Review-Aktionen (approve, reject, question)
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST' && isset($_POST['review_action'])) {
    if (!isset($_POST['csrf_token']) || !hash_equals($_SESSION['csrf_token'], $_POST['csrf_token'])) {
        http_response_code(403);
        die(json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Ungültige Anfrage (CSRF-Token fehlt oder ungültig)']));
    }
    
    header('Content-Type: application/json');
    
    try {
        switch ($_POST['review_action']) {
            case 'approve':
                $result = $reviewSystem->approveReview($_POST['review_id'], $_SESSION['user_id']);
                echo json_encode($result);
                exit;
                
            case 'reject':
                $result = $reviewSystem->rejectReview(
                    $_POST['review_id'], 
                    $_SESSION['user_id'], 
                    $_POST['feedback']
                );
                echo json_encode($result);
                exit;
                
            case 'question':
                $result = $reviewSystem->sendQuestionToReviewer(
                    $_POST['review_id'], 
                    $_SESSION['user_id'], 
                    $_POST['question']
                );
                echo json_encode($result);
                exit;
                
            default:
                throw new Exception('Unbekannte Review-Aktion: ' . $_POST['review_action']);
        }
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        http_response_code(500);
        error_log("Review-Aktion Fehler: " . $e->getMessage());
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Serverfehler: ' . $e->getMessage()]);
        exit;
    }
}

// Handler für Status-Update (ohne Pool-Status)
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST' && isset($_POST['update_status'])) {
    if (!isset($_POST['csrf_token']) || !hash_equals($_SESSION['csrf_token'], $_POST['csrf_token'])) {
        die("Ungültige Anfrage");
    }

    $reportId = filter_input(INPUT_POST, 'report_id', FILTER_VALIDATE_INT);
    $status = filter_input(INPUT_POST, 'status', FILTER_SANITIZE_SPECIAL_CHARS);
    $feedback = filter_input(INPUT_POST, 'feedback', FILTER_SANITIZE_SPECIAL_CHARS);

    if (!$reportId || !in_array($status, $validStatuses)) {
        $message = '<div class="alert alert-danger">Ungültige Eingabewerte</div>';
    } else {
        if (updateReportStatus($db, $reportId, $status, $feedback)) {
            // E-Mail nur senden, wenn Feedback vorhanden ist und Status 'resolved' oder 'rejected' ist
            if (!empty(trim($feedback)) && ($status === 'resolved' || $status === 'rejected')) {
                $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT u.email, u.first_name, u.last_name FROM reports r LEFT JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.id = :report_id");
                $stmt->execute([':report_id' => $reportId]);
                $reportUserData = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

                if ($reportUserData && isset($reportUserData['email'])) {
                    $empfaengerEmail = $reportUserData['email'];
                    $empfaengerName = $reportUserData['first_name'] . ' ' . $reportUserData['last_name'];

                    if (sendReportFeedbackEmail($empfaengerEmail, $empfaengerName, $reportId, trim($feedback), $status)) {
                        $_SESSION['message'] = ['type' => 'success', 'text' => 'Status aktualisiert und E-Mail gesendet'];
                    } else {
                        $_SESSION['message'] = ['type' => 'warning', 'text' => 'Status aktualisiert, aber E-Mail-Versand fehlgeschlagen'];
                        error_log("Fehler beim Senden der Feedback-E-Mail für Report ID $reportId an " . $empfaengerEmail);
                    }
                } else {
                    $_SESSION['message'] = ['type' => 'warning', 'text' => 'Status aktualisiert, aber E-Mail-Adresse nicht gefunden'];
                    error_log("E-Mail-Adresse für Report ID $reportId nicht gefunden.");
                }
            } else {
                $_SESSION['message'] = ['type' => 'success', 'text' => 'Status erfolgreich aktualisiert'];
            }
            header("Location: " . htmlspecialchars($_SERVER['PHP_SELF']));
            exit;
        } else {
            $message = '<div class="alert alert-danger">Aktualisierung fehlgeschlagen</div>';
        }
    }
}

// Session-Nachrichten
if (isset($_SESSION['message'])) {
    $message = '<div class="alert alert-' . htmlspecialchars($_SESSION['message']['type']) . ' alert-dismissible fade show" role="alert">'
             . '<i class="fas fa-' . (strpos($_SESSION['message']['type'], 'success') !== false ? 'check-circle' : (strpos($_SESSION['message']['type'], 'warning') !== false ? 'exclamation-circle' : 'times-circle')) . '"></i> '
             . htmlspecialchars($_SESSION['message']['text'])
             . '<button type="button" class="close" data-dismiss="alert">&times;</button></div>';
    unset($_SESSION['message']);
}

// Lade Reports nach Status
$openReports = getReportsByStatus($db, ['open']);
$poolReports = getReportsByStatus($db, ['in_pool', 'in_review', 'in_progress']);
$resolvedReports = getReportsByStatus($db, ['resolved']);
$rejectedReports = getReportsByStatus($db, ['rejected']);

// Hole alle pending Reviews für Modals
$pendingReviews = $reviewSystem->getPendingReviewsForAdmin();
?>

    <script>
    let currentReviewId = null;
    const csrfToken = '<?= $_SESSION['csrf_token'] ?>';
    const reviewsData = <?= json_encode($pendingReviews) ?>;
    
    $(document).ready(function() {
        $('.report-table').DataTable({
            language: { url: '//cdn.datatables.net/plug-ins/1.13.6/i18n/de-DE.json' },
            columnDefs: [{ targets: -1, orderable: false, searchable: false }],
            pageLength: 25,
            order: [[0, 'desc']]
        });
    });
    
    // Pool-Aktionen
    function moveToPool(reportId) {
        if (!confirm('Meldung in den Review-Pool verschieben?\n\n✓ Erstellt Review-Eintrag in der Datenbank\n✓ Reviewer können die Frage korrigieren\n✓ Du kannst sie jederzeit zurückholen')) return;
        
        $.post('', { pool_action: 'move_to_pool', report_id: reportId, csrf_token: csrfToken })
        .done(function(data) {
            if (data.success) { 
                alert('✅ ' + data.message); 
                location.reload(); 
            } else { 
                alert('❌ Fehler: ' + data.message); 
            }
        })
        .fail(function(xhr, status, error) {
            console.error('Fehlerdetails:', xhr.responseText);
            alert('❌ Netzwerkfehler: ' + error);
        });
    }
    
    function removeFromPool(reportId) {
        if (!confirm('Meldung aus dem Pool entfernen?\n\n✓ Löscht Review-Eintrag komplett\n✓ Setzt Status auf "Offen" zurück\n✓ Nur möglich wenn noch nicht in Bearbeitung')) return;
        
        $.post('', { pool_action: 'remove_from_pool', report_id: reportId, csrf_token: csrfToken })
        .done(function(data) {
            if (data.success) { 
                alert('✅ ' + data.message); 
                location.reload(); 
            } else { 
                alert('❌ ' + data.message); 
            }
        })
        .fail(function(xhr, status, error) {
            console.error('Fehlerdetails:', xhr.responseText);
            alert('❌ Netzwerkfehler: ' + error);
        });
    }
    
    function showReviewDetails(reviewId) {

                <strong>Details:</strong> ${escapeHtml(review.report_details).replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}
            </div>
        `;
        
        if (review.reviewer_note) {
            html += `<div class="info-box"><strong><i class="fas fa-comment"></i> Bemerkung des Reviewers:</strong><br>
                ${escapeHtml(review.reviewer_note).replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}</div>`;

        if (review.reviewer_feedback) {

        }
        
        if (review.source) {

                ${escapeHtml(review.source).replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}`;
            if (review.source_note) {
                html += `<hr><strong><i class="fas fa-info-circle"></i> Erklärung zur Quelle:</strong><br>
                    ${escapeHtml(review.source_note).replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}`;

        html += `

                    </tr>

                    </tr>
                    <tr>
                        <td class="current-version"><strong>Erklärung:</strong><br>
                            ${review.current_explanation ? escapeHtml(review.current_explanation).replace(/\n/g, '<br>') : '<em class="text-muted">Keine Erklärung</em>'}</td>
                        <td class="proposed-version"><strong>Erklärung:</strong><br>

    function approveReview(reviewId) {
        if (!confirm('Änderungen genehmigen und Frage aktualisieren?\n\n✓ Die Frage wird übernommen\n✓ Der Reviewer erhält +1 Punkt')) return;
        
        $('#reviewModal').modal('hide');
        
        $.post('', { review_action: 'approve', review_id: reviewId, csrf_token: csrfToken })
        .done(function(data) {
            if (data.success) { alert('✅ ' + data.message); location.reload(); }
            else { alert('❌ Fehler: ' + data.message); }
        })
        .fail(function(xhr, status, error) {
            console.error('Fehlerdetails:', xhr.responseText);
            alert('❌ Netzwerkfehler: ' + error);
        });
    }
    
    function openRejectModal(reviewId) {
        currentReviewId = reviewId;
        $('#reviewModal').modal('hide');
        $('#rejectFeedback').val('');
        $('#rejectModal').modal('show');
    }
    
    function submitReject() {
        const feedback = $('#rejectFeedback').val().trim();
        if (!feedback) { alert('Bitte gib eine Begründung ein'); return; }
        
        $.post('', { review_action: 'reject', review_id: currentReviewId, feedback: feedback, csrf_token: csrfToken })
        .done(function(data) {
            if (data.success) { alert('✅ ' + data.message); location.reload(); }
            else { alert('❌ Fehler: ' + data.message); }
        })
        .fail(function(xhr, status, error) {
            console.error('Fehlerdetails:', xhr.responseText);
            alert('❌ Netzwerkfehler: ' + error);
        });
    }
    
    function openQuestionModal(reviewId) {
        currentReviewId = reviewId;
        $('#reviewModal').modal('hide');
        $('#questionText').val('');
        $('#questionModal').modal('show');
    }
    
    function submitQuestion() {
        const question = $('#questionText').val().trim();
        if (!question) { alert('Bitte gib eine Frage ein'); return; }
        
        $.post('', { review_action: 'question', review_id: currentReviewId, question: question, csrf_token: csrfToken })
        .done(function(data) {
            if (data.success) { alert('✅ ' + data.message); location.reload(); }
            else { alert('❌ Fehler: ' + data.message); }
        })
        .fail(function(xhr, status, error) {
            console.error('Fehlerdetails:', xhr.responseText);
            alert('❌ Netzwerkfehler: ' + error);
        });
    }
    
    function escapeHtml(text) {
        const map = { '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#039;' };
        return String(text).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function(m) { return map[m]; });
    }
    
    function showQuestionPreview(questionId) {
        $('#questionPreviewBody').html('<div class="text-center"><i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin fa-2x"></i><br>Laden...</div>');
        $('#editQuestionLink').attr('href', 'edit_question.php?id=' + questionId);
        $('#questionPreviewModal').modal('show');
        
        const reportTypeLabels = {
            'suggestion': 'Verbesserungsvorschlag',
            'typo': 'Rechtschreibfehler',
            'wrong_answer': 'Falsche Antwort',
            'wrong_question': 'Falsche Frage'
        };
        
        const statusLabels = {
            'open': '<span class="badge badge-warning">Offen</span>',
            'in_pool': '<span class="badge badge-info">Im Pool</span>',
            'in_progress': '<span class="badge badge-primary">In Bearbeitung</span>',
            'in_review': '<span class="badge badge-primary">In Review</span>',
            'resolved': '<span class="badge badge-success">Erledigt</span>',
            'rejected': '<span class="badge badge-danger">Verworfen</span>'
        };
        
        $.get('', { action: 'get_question', question_id: questionId, csrf_token: csrfToken })
        .done(function(data) {
            if (data.success) {
                const q = data.question;
                let html = `
                    <div class="row">
                        <div class="col-md-6">
                            <div class="question-id-badge mb-3">
                                <i class="fas fa-question-circle"></i> Frage-ID: ${questionId}
                            </div>
                `;
                
                if (q.categories && q.categories.length > 0) {
                    html += `<div class="mb-3">`;
                    q.categories.forEach(function(cat) {
                        html += `<span class="category-badge"><i class="fas fa-folder"></i> ${escapeHtml(cat.name)}</span>`;
                    });
                    html += `</div>`;
                }
                
                html += `
                            <div class="question-box">
                                <h6><strong>Frage:</strong></h6>
                                <p>${escapeHtml(q.question_text).replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}</p>
                `;
                
                if (q.explanation) {
                    html += `
                        <hr>
                        <h6><strong>Erklärung:</strong></h6>
                        <p>${escapeHtml(q.explanation).replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}</p>
                    `;
                }
                
                html += `</div><h6 class="mt-3"><strong>Antworten:</strong></h6>`;
                
                q.answers.forEach(function(answer) {
                    html += `
                        <div class="answer-item ${answer.is_correct ? 'correct' : 'incorrect'}">
                            <span style="font-size: 20px;">${answer.is_correct ? '✅' : '❌'}</span>
                            <span><strong>${answer.is_correct ? 'RICHTIG' : 'FALSCH'}:</strong> ${escapeHtml(answer.answer_text)}</span>
                        </div>
                    `;
                });
                
                html += `
                            <div class="mt-3">
                                <small class="text-muted">
                                    <i class="fas fa-clock"></i> Erstellt: ${formatDate(q.created_at)}<br>
                                    <i class="fas fa-edit"></i> Aktualisiert: ${formatDate(q.updated_at)}
                                </small>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="col-md-6">
                            <h6><i class="fas fa-flag"></i> Meldungen (${q.reports.length})</h6>
                `;
                
                if (q.reports.length === 0) {
                    html += '<div class="alert alert-info"><small>Keine Meldungen vorhanden</small></div>';
                } else {
                    q.reports.forEach(function(report) {
                        html += `
                            <div class="report-item">
                                <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-start mb-2">
                                    <div>
                                        <strong>${reportTypeLabels[report.report_type] || report.report_type}</strong>
                                        ${statusLabels[report.status] || report.status}
                                    </div>
                                    <small class="text-muted">#${report.id}</small>
                                </div>
                                <div><strong>Von:</strong> ${escapeHtml(report.first_name + ' ' + report.last_name)}</div>
                                <div><strong>Details:</strong> ${escapeHtml(report.details).replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}</div>
                        `;
                        
                        if (report.feedback) {
                            html += `<div class="mt-2"><strong>Feedback:</strong> ${escapeHtml(report.feedback)}</div>`;
                        }
                        
                        html += `<small class="text-muted">${formatDate(report.created_at)}</small></div>`;
                    });
                }
                
                html += `<h6 class="mt-4"><i class="fas fa-history"></i> Aktivitätsverlauf</h6>`;
                
                if (q.logs.length === 0) {
                    html += '<div class="alert alert-info"><small>Keine Aktivitäten vorhanden</small></div>';
                } else {
                    q.logs.forEach(function(log) {
                        const userName = log.first_name && log.last_name ? escapeHtml(log.first_name + ' ' + log.last_name) : 'System';
                        html += `<div class="log-item"><small><strong>${formatDate(log.created_at)}</strong> · ${userName} · ${escapeHtml(log.details || log.action)}</small></div>`;
                    });
                }
                
                html += `</div></div>`;
                $('#questionPreviewBody').html(html);
            } else {
                $('#questionPreviewBody').html('<div class="alert alert-danger">Fehler beim Laden: ' + escapeHtml(data.message) + '</div>');
            }
        })
        .fail(function() {
            $('#questionPreviewBody').html('<div class="alert alert-danger">Netzwerkfehler beim Laden der Frage</div>');
        });
    }
    
    function formatDate(dateStr) {
        if (!dateStr) return '-';
        const d = new Date(dateStr);
        return d.toLocaleDateString('de-DE') + ' ' + d.toLocaleTimeString('de-DE', {hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit'});
    }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

<?php
function renderReportTable($reports, $tableId, $csrfToken) {
    $icons = [
        'suggestion' => 'fas fa-lightbulb',
        'typo' => 'fas fa-font',
        'wrong_answer' => 'fas fa-times-circle',
        'wrong_question' => 'fas fa-question-circle'
    ];
    
    $descriptions = [
        'suggestion' => 'Verbesserungsvorschlag',
        'typo' => 'Rechtschreibfehler',
        'wrong_answer' => 'Falsche Antwort',
        'wrong_question' => 'Falsche Frage'
    ];
    
    $iconColors = [
        'suggestion' => 'text-warning',
        'typo' => 'text-primary',
        'wrong_answer' => 'text-danger',
        'wrong_question' => 'text-muted'
    ];
    
    ob_start();
    ?>
    <table class="table table-hover table-sm report-table" id="<?= $tableId ?>">
        <thead>
            <tr>
                <th>ID</th>
                <th>Frage</th>
                <th>Benutzer</th>
                <th>Typ</th>

                <th>Review-Status</th>
                <th>Erstellt</th>
                <th>Aktionen</th>
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
            <?php foreach($reports as $report): ?>
                <?php 
                $row_class = '';
                switch ($report['status']) {
                    case 'open': $row_class = 'status-open'; break;
                    case 'in_pool':
                    case 'in_review':
                    case 'in_progress': $row_class = 'status-in_pool'; break;
                    case 'resolved': $row_class = 'status-resolved'; break;
                    case 'rejected': $row_class = 'status-rejected'; break;
                }
                $icon_color = $iconColors[$report['report_type']] ?? '';
                
                // Bestimme ob Pool-Buttons angezeigt werden sollen
                $showPoolButtons = in_array($report['status'], ['open', 'in_pool']);
                $canRemoveFromPool = ($report['status'] === 'in_pool' && 
                                      $report['review_status'] === 'pool');
                ?>
                <tr class="<?= $row_class ?>">
                    <td><?= htmlspecialchars($report['id']) ?></td>
                    <td>
                        <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-info" 
                                onclick="showQuestionPreview(<?= $report['question_id'] ?>)"
                                title="Frage ansehen">
                            #<?= $report['question_id'] ?>
                        </button>
                    </td>
                    <td><?= htmlspecialchars($report['first_name'] . ' ' . $report['last_name']) ?></td>
                    <td>
                        <i class="<?= $icons[$report['report_type']] ?> <?= $icon_color ?>" 
                           title="<?= $descriptions[$report['report_type']] ?>"></i>
                    </td>
                    <td class="details-cell"><?= nl2br(htmlspecialchars($report['details'])) ?></td>
                    <td>
                        <?php if ($report['review_id'] && $report['review_status'] === 'pending_approval'): ?>
                            <button class="btn btn-sm btn-info" onclick="showReviewDetails(<?= $report['review_id'] ?>)">
                                <i class="fas fa-eye"></i> Review prüfen
                            </button>
                        <?php elseif ($report['review_id']): ?>
                            <?php 
                            $reviewStatusLabels = [
                                'pool' => '<span class="badge badge-secondary">Im Pool</span>',
                                'in_review' => '<span class="badge badge-primary">In Bearbeitung</span>',
                                'approved' => '<span class="badge badge-success">Genehmigt</span>',
                                'rejected' => '<span class="badge badge-danger">Abgelehnt</span>'
                            ];
                            echo $reviewStatusLabels[$report['review_status']] ?? '<span class="badge badge-secondary">' . htmlspecialchars($report['review_status']) . '</span>';
                            ?>
                            <?php if ($report['reviewer_first_name']): ?>
                                <br><small><?= htmlspecialchars($report['reviewer_first_name'] . ' ' . $report['reviewer_last_name']) ?></small>
                            <?php endif; ?>
                        <?php else: ?>
                            <span class="text-muted">-</span>
                        <?php endif; ?>
                    </td>
                    <td><?= date('d.m.Y H:i', strtotime($report['created_at'])) ?></td>
                    <td>
                        <div class="action-form">
                            <?php if ($report['status'] === 'open'): ?>
                                <!-- Button: In Pool verschieben -->
                                <button type="button" 
                                        class="btn btn-primary btn-block btn-sm mb-2" 
                                        onclick="moveToPool(<?= $report['id'] ?>)">
                                    <i class="fas fa-arrow-right"></i> In Pool verschieben
                                </button>

                                        onclick="removeFromPool(<?= $report['id'] ?>)">
                                    <i class="fas fa-undo"></i> Aus Pool entfernen
                                </button>
                            <?php endif; ?>
                            
                            <?php if (!in_array($report['status'], ['in_review', 'in_progress'])): ?>
                                <!-- Status-Update-Formular (nur für open, in_pool, resolved, rejected) -->
                                <form method="post">
                                    <input type="hidden" name="csrf_token" value="<?= htmlspecialchars($csrfToken) ?>">
                                    <input type="hidden" name="report_id" value="<?= $report['id'] ?>">

                                            <option value="resolved" <?= $report['status'] === 'resolved' ? 'selected' : '' ?>>Erledigt</option>
                                            <option value="rejected" <?= $report['status'] === 'rejected' ? 'selected' : '' ?>>Verworfen</option>
                                        </select>
                                        <small class="text-muted d-block mt-1">
                                            ℹ️ "Im Pool" nur über Button möglich
                                        </small>
                                    </div>

                                    <div class="form-group">
                                        <label>Kommentar:</label>
                                        <textarea name="feedback" 
                                            class="form-control form-control-sm"
                                            placeholder="Nachricht an den Melder..."
                                            rows="3"><?= htmlspecialchars($report['feedback'] ?? '', ENT_QUOTES | ENT_SUBSTITUTE, 'UTF-8', false) ?></textarea>
                                        <small class="text-muted d-block mt-2">
                                            💡 E-Mail bei Status "Erledigt" oder "Verworfen"

                                    <button type="submit" name="update_status" class="btn btn-success btn-sm btn-block">
                                        <i class="fas fa-save"></i> Speichern
                                    </button>
                                </form>
                            <?php else: ?>
                                <!-- Hinweis für in_review/in_progress -->
                                <div class="alert alert-info p-2 mb-0">
                                    <small>
                                        <i class="fas fa-info-circle"></i> 
                                        Status wird über Review-System verwaltet

                            <?php endif; ?>
                        </div>
                    </td>

            <?php endforeach; ?>
        </tbody>
    </table>
    <?php
    return ob_get_clean();
}
?>

<?php
ini_set('display_errors', 1);
ini_set('display_startup_errors', 1);
error_reporting(E_ALL);
session_start();

require_once '../config.php';

// Überprüfung der Berechtigung
checkUserRole([ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_MANAGER]); // Beide Rollen erlauben

// Nur POST-Requests erlauben
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
    http_response_code(405); // Method Not Allowed
    exit;
}

// CSRF-Token Validierung
if (!isset($_POST['csrf_token']) || $_POST['csrf_token'] !== $_SESSION['csrf_token']) {
    die("CSRF-Token ungültig");
}

// Validierung der Question-ID
$questionId = filter_input(INPUT_POST, 'question_id', FILTER_VALIDATE_INT);
if (!$questionId || $questionId < 1) {
    die("Ungültige Frage-ID");
}

try {
    // Frage wiederherstellen (nur wenn bereits gelöscht)
    $stmt = $db->prepare("
        UPDATE questions 
        SET deleted_at = NULL 
        WHERE id = :question_id
        AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL
    ");
    
    $stmt->execute([':question_id' => $questionId]);
    
    // Erfolgsmeldung mit Session speichern
    $_SESSION['success_message'] = "Frage #$questionId wurde wiederhergestellt";
    
} catch (PDOException $e) {
    error_log("Database Error: " . $e->getMessage());
    die("Ein Datenbankfehler ist aufgetreten");
}

// Redirect zurück
header("Location: manage_questions.php");
exit;
?>

    header('Content-Type: application/json');
    
    try {
        switch ($_POST['action']) {
            case 'move_to_pool':
                $result = $reviewSystem->moveToPool($_POST['report_id'], $_SESSION['user_id']);
                echo json_encode($result);
                exit;
                
            case 'remove_from_pool':
                $result = $reviewSystem->removeFromPool($_POST['report_id'], $_SESSION['user_id']);
                echo json_encode($result);
                exit;
                
            case 'approve':
                // Erweiterte Genehmigung mit editierbaren Daten und E-Mail-Optionen
                $data = [
                    'question_text' => $_POST['final_question_text'],
                    'explanation' => $_POST['final_explanation'],
                    'answers' => json_decode($_POST['final_answers'], true),
                    'admin_message' => $_POST['admin_message'] ?? '',
                    'include_source' => isset($_POST['include_source']) && $_POST['include_source'] === 'true',
                    'include_reviewer_feedback' => isset($_POST['include_reviewer_feedback']) && $_POST['include_reviewer_feedback'] === 'true',
                    'send_copy_to_reviewer' => isset($_POST['send_copy_to_reviewer']) && $_POST['send_copy_to_reviewer'] === 'true',
                    'source' => $_POST['source'] ?? '',
                    'source_note' => $_POST['source_note'] ?? '',
                    'reviewer_feedback' => $_POST['reviewer_feedback'] ?? ''
                ];
                
                $result = $reviewSystem->approveReviewWithDetails($_POST['review_id'], $_SESSION['user_id'], $data);
                echo json_encode($result);
                exit;
                
            case 'reject':
                $result = $reviewSystem->rejectReview(
                    $_POST['review_id'], 
                    $_SESSION['user_id'], 
                    $_POST['feedback']
                );
                echo json_encode($result);
                exit;
                
            case 'question':
                $result = $reviewSystem->sendQuestionToReviewer(
                    $_POST['review_id'], 
                    $_SESSION['user_id'], 
                    $_POST['question']
                );
                echo json_encode($result);
                exit;
                
            default:
                throw new Exception('Unbekannte Aktion: ' . $_POST['action']);
        }
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        http_response_code(500);
        error_log("Admin Reviews Fehler: " . $e->getMessage() . " | Trace: " . $e->getTraceAsString());
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Serverfehler: ' . $e->getMessage()]);
        exit;
    }
}

// Hole offene Meldungen für Pool
$stmt = $db->query("
    SELECT r.*, q.question_text, q.id as question_id, u.first_name, u.last_name,
           qr.id as review_id, qr.status as review_status, qr.reviewer_id,
           rev.first_name as reviewer_first_name, rev.last_name as reviewer_last_name
    FROM reports r
    JOIN questions q ON r.question_id = q.id
    LEFT JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id
    LEFT JOIN question_reviews qr ON r.id = qr.report_id
    LEFT JOIN users rev ON qr.reviewer_id = rev.id
    WHERE r.status IN ('open', 'in_pool', 'in_review', 'in_progress')
    ORDER BY 
        CASE r.status
            WHEN 'open' THEN 1
            WHEN 'in_pool' THEN 2
            WHEN 'in_review' THEN 3
            WHEN 'in_progress' THEN 4
        END,
        r.created_at DESC
");
$openReports = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

// Hole ausstehende Reviews zur Prüfung
$pendingReviews = $reviewSystem->getPendingReviewsForAdmin();

// Hole abgeschlossene Reviews
$stmt = $db->prepare("
    SELECT 
        qr.id,
        qr.report_id,
        qr.question_id,
        qr.reviewer_id,
        qr.status,
        qr.admin_action,
        qr.admin_feedback,
        qr.reviewed_at,
        qr.submitted_at,
        q.question_text,
        r.report_type,
        r.details as report_details,
        u.first_name as reviewer_first_name,
        u.last_name as reviewer_last_name,
        rep.first_name as reporter_first_name,
        rep.last_name as reporter_last_name,
        admin.first_name as admin_first_name,
        admin.last_name as admin_last_name
    FROM question_reviews qr
    JOIN reports r ON qr.report_id = r.id
    JOIN questions q ON qr.question_id = q.id
    LEFT JOIN users u ON qr.reviewer_id = u.id
    LEFT JOIN users rep ON r.user_id = rep.id
    LEFT JOIN users admin ON qr.reviewed_by_admin = admin.id
    WHERE qr.status IN ('approved', 'rejected')
    ORDER BY qr.reviewed_at DESC
    LIMIT 100
");
$stmt->execute();
$completedReviews = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

// Hole alle Fragen-IDs aus den Reports und lade deren Details
$allQuestionIds = array_values(array_unique(array_merge(
    array_column($openReports, 'question_id'),
    array_column($pendingReviews, 'question_id'),
    array_column($completedReviews, 'question_id')
)));

$questionsData = [];
if (!empty($allQuestionIds)) {
    $placeholders = str_repeat('?,', count($allQuestionIds) - 1) . '?';
    $stmt = $db->prepare("
        SELECT q.*
        FROM questions q
        WHERE q.id IN ($placeholders)
    ");
    $stmt->execute($allQuestionIds);
    $questions = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    
    foreach ($questions as $q) {
        // Hole Antworten für diese Frage
        $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT * FROM answers WHERE question_id = ? ORDER BY id");
        $stmt->execute([$q['id']]);
        $q['answers'] = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        $q['created_at'] = date('d.m.Y H:i', strtotime($q['created_at']));
        $q['category_name'] = 'Keine'; // Fallback wenn keine Kategorie vorhanden
        $questionsData[$q['id']] = $q;
    }
}

// Session-Nachrichten
$message = '';
if (isset($_SESSION['review_message'])) {
    $type = $_SESSION['review_message']['type'] ?? 'info';
    $text = $_SESSION['review_message']['text'] ?? '';
    $icon = strpos($type, 'success') !== false ? 'check-circle' : (strpos($type, 'warning') !== false ? 'exclamation-circle' : 'info-circle');
    $message = '<div class="alert alert-' . htmlspecialchars($type) . ' alert-dismissible fade show" role="alert">'
             . '<i class="fas fa-' . $icon . '"></i> ' . htmlspecialchars($text)
             . '<button type="button" class="close" data-dismiss="alert">&times;</button></div>';
    unset($_SESSION['review_message']);
}

    <script src="https://cdn.datatables.net/1.13.6/js/jquery.dataTables.min.js"></script>
    <script src="https://cdn.datatables.net/1.13.6/js/dataTables.bootstrap4.min.js"></script>
    
    <script>
        let currentReviewId = null;
        let currentReviewData = null;
        const csrfToken = '<?= $_SESSION['csrf_token'] ?>';
        const reviewsData = <?= json_encode($pendingReviews ?? []) ?>;
        const questionsData = <?= json_encode($questionsData ?? []) ?>;
        const openReports = <?= json_encode($openReports ?? []) ?>;
        
        $(document).ready(function() {
            $('#openReportsTable, #pendingReviewsTable, #completedReviewsTable').DataTable({
                language: { url: '//cdn.datatables.net/plug-ins/1.13.6/i18n/de-DE.json' },
                order: [[0, 'desc']],
                pageLength: 25,
                columnDefs: [{ targets: -1, orderable: false, searchable: false }]
            });

            // Live-Vorschau aktualisieren
            $('#include_source, #include_reviewer_feedback, #admin_message').on('change keyup', updateApprovePreview);
        });
        
        function showQuestionPreview(questionId) {
            $('#questionPreviewModal').modal('show');
            $('#editQuestionLink').attr('href', 'edit_question.php?id=' + questionId);
            
            // Verwende vorgeladene Daten
            const q = questionsData[questionId];
            
            if (q) {
                const reportTypeLabels = {
                    'suggestion': 'Verbesserungsvorschlag',
                    'typo': 'Rechtschreibfehler',
                    'wrong_answer': 'Falsche Antwort',
                    'wrong_question': 'Falsche Frage'
                };
                
                const statusLabels = {
                    'open': '<span class="badge badge-warning">Offen</span>',
                    'in_pool': '<span class="badge badge-info">Im Pool</span>',
                    'in_progress': '<span class="badge badge-primary">In Bearbeitung</span>',
                    'in_review': '<span class="badge badge-primary">In Review</span>',
                    'resolved': '<span class="badge badge-success">Erledigt</span>',
                    'rejected': '<span class="badge badge-danger">Verworfen</span>'
                };
                
                let html = `
                    <div class="row">
                        <div class="col-md-6">
                            <div class="question-id-badge mb-3">
                                <i class="fas fa-question-circle"></i> Frage-ID: ${questionId}
                            </div>
                            
                            <div class="question-box mb-3">
                                <h6><strong>Frage:</strong></h6>
                                <p>${escapeHtml(q.question_text).replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}</p>
                `;
                
                if (q.explanation) {
                    html += `
                        <hr>
                        <h6><strong>Erklärung:</strong></h6>
                        <p>${escapeHtml(q.explanation).replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}</p>
                    `;
                }
                
                html += `</div><h6><strong>Antworten:</strong></h6>`;
                
                q.answers.forEach(function(answer) {
                    html += `
                        <div class="answer-item ${answer.is_correct ? 'correct' : 'incorrect'} mb-2">
                            <span style="font-size: 18px; margin-right: 8px;">${answer.is_correct ? '✅' : '❌'}</span>
                            <span><strong>${answer.is_correct ? 'RICHTIG' : 'FALSCH'}:</strong> ${escapeHtml(answer.answer_text)}</span>
                        </div>
                    `;
                });
                
                html += `
                            <div class="mt-3">
                                <small class="text-muted">
                                    <i class="fas fa-clock"></i> Erstellt: ${q.created_at}<br>
                                    <i class="fas fa-tag"></i> Kategorie: ${escapeHtml(q.category_name || 'Keine')}
                                </small>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="col-md-6">
                            <h6><i class="fas fa-flag"></i> <strong>Meldungen</strong></h6>
                `;
                
                // Hole Meldungen für diese Frage aus den offenen Reports
                const relatedReports = [];
                openReports.forEach(function(report) {
                    if (report.question_id == questionId) {
                        relatedReports.push(report);
                    }
                });
                
                if (relatedReports.length === 0) {
                    html += '<div class="alert alert-info"><small>Keine Meldungen vorhanden</small></div>';
                } else {
                    relatedReports.forEach(function(report) {
                        html += `
                            <div class="report-item">
                                <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-start mb-2">
                                    <div>
                                        <strong>${reportTypeLabels[report.report_type] || report.report_type}</strong><br>
                                        ${statusLabels[report.status] || report.status}
                                    </div>
                                    <small class="text-muted">#${report.id}</small>
                                </div>
                                <div><strong>Von:</strong> ${escapeHtml(report.first_name + ' ' + report.last_name)}</div>
                                <div><strong>Details:</strong> ${escapeHtml(report.details).replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}</div>
                        `;
                        
                        if (report.feedback) {
                            html += `<div class="mt-2"><strong>Feedback:</strong> ${escapeHtml(report.feedback)}</div>`;
                        }
                        
                        html += `</div>`;
                    });
                }
                
                html += `</div></div>`;
                $('#questionPreviewBody').html(html);
            } else {
                $('#questionPreviewBody').html(`
                    <div class="alert alert-danger">
                        <i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle"></i> Frage nicht gefunden.
                    </div>
                `);
            }
        }
        
        function moveToPool(reportId) {
            if (!confirm('Meldung in den Review-Pool verschieben?\n\nDie Meldung wird dann von einem Reviewer bearbeitet.')) return;
            
            $.post('', { action: 'move_to_pool', report_id: reportId, csrf_token: csrfToken })
            .done(function(data) {
                if (data.success) { alert('✅ ' + data.message); location.reload(); }
                else { alert('❌ Fehler: ' + data.message); }
            })
            .fail(function(xhr, status, error) {
                console.error('Fehlerdetails:', xhr.responseText);
                alert('❌ Netzwerkfehler: ' + error);
            });
        }
        
        function removeFromPool(reportId) {
            if (!confirm('Meldung aus dem Pool entfernen?\n\nDie Meldung wird wieder auf "Offen" gesetzt.')) return;
            
            $.post('', { action: 'remove_from_pool', report_id: reportId, csrf_token: csrfToken })
            .done(function(data) {
                if (data.success) { alert('✅ ' + data.message); location.reload(); }
                else { alert('❌ Fehler: ' + data.message); }
            })
            .fail(function(xhr, status, error) {
                console.error('Fehlerdetails:', xhr.responseText);
                alert('❌ Netzwerkfehler: ' + error);
            });
        }
        
        function showReviewDetails(reviewId) {
            const review = reviewsData.find(r => r.id == reviewId);
            
            if (!review) {
                console.error('Review nicht in Array gefunden. Review-ID:', reviewId);
                alert('⚠️ Review-Daten konnten nicht geladen werden.');
                return;
            }

            currentReviewData = review;
            
            const reviewerName = review.reviewer_first_name + ' ' + review.reviewer_last_name;
            const reporterName = review.reporter_first_name + ' ' + review.reporter_last_name;
            
            let html = `
                <div class="question-id-badge mb-3">
                    <i class="fas fa-question-circle"></i> Frage-ID: ${review.question_id}
                </div>
                <div class="alert alert-warning">
                    <strong><i class="fas fa-flag"></i> Ursprüngliche Meldung:</strong><br>
                    <strong>Von:</strong> ${escapeHtml(reporterName)}<br>
                    <strong>Details:</strong> ${escapeHtml(review.report_details).replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}
                </div>
            `;
            
            if (review.reviewer_note) {
                html += `<div class="info-box"><strong><i class="fas fa-comment"></i> Bemerkung des Reviewers:</strong><br>
                    ${escapeHtml(review.reviewer_note).replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}</div>`;
            }
            
            if (review.reviewer_feedback) {
                html += `<div class="alert alert-info"><strong><i class="fas fa-envelope"></i> Vorgeschlagenes Feedback:</strong><br>
                    ${escapeHtml(review.reviewer_feedback).replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}</div>`;
            }
            
            if (review.source) {
                html += `<div class="source-box"><strong><i class="fas fa-book"></i> Quelle:</strong><br>
                    ${escapeHtml(review.source).replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}`;
                if (review.source_note) {
                    html += `<hr><strong><i class="fas fa-info-circle"></i> Erklärung zur Quelle:</strong><br>
                        ${escapeHtml(review.source_note).replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}`;
                }
                html += `</div>`;
            }
            
            html += `
                <h6 class="mt-4 mb-3"><i class="fas fa-exchange-alt"></i> Vergleich der Versionen:</h6>
                <table class="comparison-table table table-bordered">
                    <thead>
                        <tr>
                            <th class="current-version"><i class="fas fa-file-alt"></i> Aktuelle Version</th>
                            <th class="proposed-version"><i class="fas fa-file-import"></i> Vorgeschlagene Änderung</th>
                        </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                        <tr>
                            <td class="current-version"><strong>Frage:</strong><br>
                                ${escapeHtml(review.current_question).replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}</td>
                            <td class="proposed-version"><strong>Frage:</strong><br>
                                ${escapeHtml(review.proposed_question_text).replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}</td>
                        </tr>
                        <tr>
                            <td class="current-version"><strong>Erklärung:</strong><br>
                                ${review.current_explanation ? escapeHtml(review.current_explanation).replace(/\n/g, '<br>') : '<em class="text-muted">Keine Erklärung</em>'}</td>
                            <td class="proposed-version"><strong>Erklärung:</strong><br>
                                ${review.proposed_explanation ? escapeHtml(review.proposed_explanation).replace(/\n/g, '<br>') : '<em class="text-muted">Keine Erklärung</em>'}</td>
                        </tr>
                        <tr>
                            <td class="current-version"><strong>Antworten:</strong><br>
                                ${review.current_answers.map(a => 
                                    `<div class="answer-badge ${a.is_correct ? 'answer-correct' : 'answer-incorrect'}">
                                        ${a.is_correct ? '✅ RICHTIG' : '❌ FALSCH'}: ${escapeHtml(a.answer_text)}
                                    </div><br>`
                                ).join('')}</td>
                            <td class="proposed-version"><strong>Antworten:</strong><br>
                                ${review.proposed_answers_decoded.map(a => 
                                    `<div class="answer-badge ${a.is_correct ? 'answer-correct' : 'answer-incorrect'}">
                                        ${a.is_correct ? '✅ RICHTIG' : '❌ FALSCH'}: ${escapeHtml(a.answer_text)}
                                    </div><br>`
                                ).join('')}</td>
                        </tr>
                    </tbody>
                </table>
                <div class="text-center mt-4">
                    <button class="btn btn-success btn-lg" onclick="openApproveModal(${reviewId})">
                        <i class="fas fa-check"></i> Genehmigen und E-Mail vorbereiten
                    </button>
                    <button class="btn btn-warning btn-lg" onclick="openQuestionModal(${reviewId})">
                        <i class="fas fa-question"></i> Rückfrage stellen
                    </button>
                    <button class="btn btn-danger btn-lg" onclick="openRejectModal(${reviewId})">
                        <i class="fas fa-times"></i> Ablehnen
                    </button>
                </div>
            `;
            
            $('#reviewModalBody').html(html);
            $('#reviewModal').modal('show');
        }

        function openApproveModal(reviewId) {
            const review = currentReviewData || reviewsData.find(r => r.id == reviewId);
            if (!review) {
                alert('Review-Daten nicht gefunden');
                return;
            }

            // Felder befüllen
            $('#approve_review_id').val(reviewId);
            $('#approve_question_text').val(review.proposed_question_text);
            $('#approve_explanation').val(review.proposed_explanation || '');
            $('#approve_source').val(review.source || '');
            $('#approve_source_note').val(review.source_note || '');
            $('#approve_reviewer_feedback').val(review.reviewer_feedback || '');
            $('#admin_message').val('Vielen Dank für deine Meldung! Die Frage wurde korrigiert.');

            // Antworten-Editor befüllen
            const answersEditor = $('#approve_answers_editor');
            answersEditor.empty();
            
            review.proposed_answers_decoded.forEach((answer, idx) => {
                const answerHtml = `
                    <div class="answer-editor-item">
                        <input type="text" class="form-control" value="${escapeHtml(answer.answer_text)}" data-index="${idx}" required>
                        <input type="checkbox" ${answer.is_correct ? 'checked' : ''} data-index="${idx}">
                        <label class="mb-0">${answer.is_correct ? 'Richtig' : 'Falsch'}</label>
                    </div>
                `;
                answersEditor.append(answerHtml);
            });

            // Checkbox-Label aktualisieren
            answersEditor.find('input[type="checkbox"]').on('change', function() {
                $(this).next('label').text(this.checked ? 'Richtig' : 'Falsch');
            });

            // Modals wechseln
            $('#reviewModal').modal('hide');
            $('#approveModal').modal('show');

            // Vorschau aktualisieren
            updateApprovePreview();
        }

        function updateApprovePreview() {
            const includeSource = $('#include_source').is(':checked');
            const includeReviewerFeedback = $('#include_reviewer_feedback').is(':checked');
            const adminMessage = $('#admin_message').val();
            const source = $('#approve_source').val();
            const sourceNote = $('#approve_source_note').val();
            const reviewerFeedback = $('#approve_reviewer_feedback').val();

            let preview = '<strong>Inhalt der E-Mail an den Melder:</strong><br><br>';
            
            if (adminMessage) {
                preview += `<p>${escapeHtml(adminMessage).replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}</p>`;
            }

            if (includeReviewerFeedback && reviewerFeedback) {
                preview += `<hr><strong>Feedback vom Reviewer:</strong><br>${escapeHtml(reviewerFeedback).replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}<br>`;
            }

            if (includeSource && source) {
                preview += `<hr><strong>Quelle:</strong><br>${escapeHtml(source).replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}`;
                if (sourceNote) {
                    preview += `<br><small>${escapeHtml(sourceNote).replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}</small>`;
                }
            }

            preview += '<hr><p><em>Die korrigierte Frage mit Antworten wird ebenfalls angezeigt.</em></p>';

            $('#approve_preview_content').html(preview);
        }

        function submitApproval() {
            // Sammle Antworten
            const answers = [];
            $('#approve_answers_editor .answer-editor-item').each(function() {
                const text = $(this).find('input[type="text"]').val();
                const isCorrect = $(this).find('input[type="checkbox"]').is(':checked');
                answers.push({ answer_text: text, is_correct: isCorrect });
            });

            if (answers.length < 2) {
                alert('Es müssen mindestens 2 Antworten vorhanden sein!');
                return;
            }

            if (!answers.some(a => a.is_correct)) {
                alert('Mindestens eine Antwort muss als korrekt markiert sein!');
                return;
            }

            if (!confirm('Review jetzt genehmigen und E-Mail senden?\n\nDie Frage wird aktualisiert und der Reviewer erhält +1 Punkt.')) return;

            $('#approveModal').modal('hide');

            $.post('', {
                action: 'approve',
                review_id: $('#approve_review_id').val(),
                final_question_text: $('#approve_question_text').val(),
                final_explanation: $('#approve_explanation').val(),
                final_answers: JSON.stringify(answers),
                admin_message: $('#admin_message').val(),
                include_source: $('#include_source').is(':checked'),
                include_reviewer_feedback: $('#include_reviewer_feedback').is(':checked'),
                send_copy_to_reviewer: $('#send_copy_to_reviewer').is(':checked'),
                source: $('#approve_source').val(),
                source_note: $('#approve_source_note').val(),
                reviewer_feedback: $('#approve_reviewer_feedback').val(),
                csrf_token: csrfToken
            })
            .done(function(data) {
                if (data.success) { 
                    alert('✅ ' + data.message); 
                    location.reload(); 
                } else { 
                    alert('❌ Fehler: ' + data.message); 
                }
            })
            .fail(function(xhr, status, error) {
                console.error('Fehlerdetails:', xhr.responseText);
                alert('❌ Netzwerkfehler: ' + error);
            });
        }
        
        function openRejectModal(reviewId) {
            currentReviewId = reviewId;
            $('#reviewModal').modal('hide');
            $('#rejectFeedback').val('');
            $('#rejectModal').modal('show');
        }
        
        function submitReject() {
            const feedback = $('#rejectFeedback').val().trim();
            if (!feedback) { alert('Bitte gib eine Begründung ein'); return; }
            
            $.post('', { action: 'reject', review_id: currentReviewId, feedback: feedback, csrf_token: csrfToken })
            .done(function(data) {
                if (data.success) { alert('✅ ' + data.message); location.reload(); }
                else { alert('❌ Fehler: ' + data.message); }
            })
            .fail(function(xhr, status, error) {
                console.error('Fehlerdetails:', xhr.responseText);
                alert('❌ Netzwerkfehler: ' + error);
            });
        }
        
        function openQuestionModal(reviewId) {
            currentReviewId = reviewId;
            $('#reviewModal').modal('hide');
            $('#questionText').val('');
            $('#questionModal').modal('show');
        }
        
        function submitQuestion() {
            const question = $('#questionText').val().trim();
            if (!question) { alert('Bitte gib eine Frage ein'); return; }
            
            $.post('', { action: 'question', review_id: currentReviewId, question: question, csrf_token: csrfToken })
            .done(function(data) {
                if (data.success) { alert('✅ ' + data.message); location.reload(); }
                else { alert('❌ Fehler: ' + data.message); }
            })
            .fail(function(xhr, status, error) {
                console.error('Fehlerdetails:', xhr.responseText);
                alert('❌ Netzwerkfehler: ' + error);
            });
        }
        
        function escapeHtml(text) {
            const map = { '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#039;' };
            return String(text).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function(m) { return map[m]; });
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

error_reporting(E_ALL);
ini_set('display_errors', '1');

session_start();

require_once '../config.php';

if (function_exists('checkUserRole')) {
    checkUserRole('admin');
}

if (!isset($pdo) || !$pdo instanceof PDO) {
    try {
        $pdo = new PDO(
            "mysql:host=" . DB_HOST . ";dbname=" . DB_NAME . ";charset=utf8mb4",
            DB_USER,
            DB_PASS,
            [
                PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION,
                PDO::ATTR_DEFAULT_FETCH_MODE => PDO::FETCH_ASSOC,
                PDO::ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES => false
            ]
        );
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        die("❌ Datenbankverbindung fehlgeschlagen: " . $e->getMessage());
    }
}

$question = null;
$error = null;

if (isset($_GET['id']) && is_numeric($_GET['id'])) {
    $questionId = (int)$_GET['id'];
    try {
        $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
            SELECT id, question_text, explanation 
            FROM questions 
            WHERE id = ? AND (deleted_at IS NULL OR deleted_at = '0000-00-00 00:00:00')
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$questionId]);
        $question = $stmt->fetch();

        if ($question) {
            $stmt = $pdo->prepare("
                SELECT answer_text, is_correct 
                FROM answers 
                WHERE question_id = ? 
                ORDER BY id
            ");
            $stmt->execute([$questionId]);
            $question['answers'] = $stmt->fetchAll();
        } else {
            $error = "❌ Frage nicht gefunden.";
        }
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        $error = "Fehler beim Laden der Frage: " . htmlspecialchars($e->getMessage());
    }
}

// Funktion zur sicheren Ausgabe mit HTML-Erhaltung
function displayContent($content) {
    // Erlaube bestimmte HTML-Tags für Formatierung
    $allowed_tags = '<ul><ol><li><br><br/><strong><em><u><span><div><p>';
    $content = strip_tags($content, $allowed_tags);
    return $content;
}

            const input = document.getElementById('id-input');
            if (input) {
                input.focus();
                input.select();
            }

            // Einfache Validierung
            const forms = document.querySelectorAll('form');
            forms.forEach(form => {
                form.addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
                    const input = this.querySelector('input[type="number"]');
                    if (!input.value || parseInt(input.value) < 1) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        alert('Bitte eine gültige Fragen-ID eingeben (mindestens 1).');
                        input.focus();
                        input.select();
                    }
                });
            });

            // Automatisch zur Frage scrollen, wenn sie geladen wird
            <?php if ($question && !$error): ?>
                setTimeout(() => {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }, 100);
            <?php endif; ?>
        });

<?php
session_start();

checkUserRole(ROLE_ADMIN);
require '../vendor/autoload.php'; // Wenn Sie Composer verwenden

use PHPMailer\PHPMailer\PHPMailer;
use PHPMailer\PHPMailer\Exception;

$message = ''; // Variable für die Nachricht

function sendTestEmail($to) {
    $mail = new PHPMailer(true);

    try {
        echo "PHPMailer wird konfiguriert...<br>"; // Debugging-Information

        // Server settings
        $mail->isSMTP();
        $mail->Host       = SMTP_HOST;
        echo "SMTP_HOST: " . SMTP_HOST . "<br>"; // Debugging-Information
        $mail->SMTPAuth   = true;
        $mail->Username   = SMTP_USER;
        echo "SMTP_USER: " . SMTP_USER . "<br>"; // Debugging-Information
        $mail->Password   = SMTP_PASS;
        $mail->SMTPSecure = PHPMailer::ENCRYPTION_SMTPS; // Für SSL verwenden Sie SMTPS
        $mail->Port       = SMTP_PORT;
        echo "SMTP_PORT: " . SMTP_PORT . "<br>"; // Debugging-Information

        // Empfänger
        $mail->setFrom(SMTP_FROM, SMTP_FROM_NAME);
        echo "Von: " . SMTP_FROM . " (" . SMTP_FROM_NAME . ")<br>"; // Debugging-Information
        $mail->addAddress($to);
        echo "An: " . $to . "<br>"; // Debugging-Information

        // Inhalt der E-Mail
        $mail->isHTML(true);
        $mail->Subject = 'Test E-Mail von Quiz App';
        $mail->Body    = 'Dies ist eine Test-E-Mail von der Quiz App. Wenn Sie diese E-Mail erhalten, funktioniert der E-Mail-Versand mit PHPMailer korrekt.';

        // E-Mail senden
        echo "E-Mail wird gesendet...<br>"; // Debugging-Information
        $mail->send();
        echo "E-Mail wurde erfolgreich gesendet!<br>"; // Debugging-Information
        return true;
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        echo "Fehler beim Senden der E-Mail: {$mail->ErrorInfo}<br>"; // Debugging-Information
        return "Mailer Error: {$mail->ErrorInfo}";
    }
}

// Test-E-Mail senden, wenn das Formular abgeschickt wird
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    echo "Formular wurde abgeschickt.<br>"; // Debugging-Information
    $testEmailAddress = $_POST['email']; // E-Mail-Adresse aus dem Formular
    echo "Test-E-Mail-Adresse: " . $testEmailAddress . "<br>"; // Debugging-Information
    $sendResult = sendTestEmail($testEmailAddress);

    if ($sendResult === true) {
        $message = "Test-E-Mail wurde erfolgreich gesendet. Bitte überprüfen Sie Ihren Posteingang (und ggf. den Spam-Ordner) für die E-Mail an: " . $testEmailAddress;
    } else {
        $message = "Fehler beim Senden der Test-E-Mail: " . $sendResult;
    }
}
?>
