```php
<?php
session_start();
require_once '../config.php';

// Sicherstellen, dass der Benutzer Administrator ist
checkUserRole(ROLE_ADMIN);

// Benutzerdaten empfangen
$userId = isset($_POST['user_id']) ? intval($_POST['user_id']) : 0;
$firstName = isset($_POST['first_name']) ? $_POST['first_name'] : '';
$lastName = isset($_POST['last_name']) ? $_POST['last_name'] : '';
$username = isset($_POST['username']) ? $_POST['username'] : '';
$email = isset($_POST['email']) ? $_POST['email'] : '';
$activated = isset($_POST['activated']) ? 1 : 0; // Wenn aktiviert angehakt, wird es auf 1 gesetzt
$collectPoints = isset($_POST['collect_points']) ? 1 : 0;
$receiveEmails = isset($_POST['receive_emails']) ? 1 : 0;
$role = isset($_POST['role']) ? $_POST['role'] : '';
$repeatIntervalCorrect = isset($_POST['repeat_interval_correct']) ? intval($_POST['repeat_interval_correct']) : 7;
$repeatIntervalIncorrect = isset($_POST['repeat_interval_incorrect']) ? intval($_POST['repeat_interval_incorrect']) : 1;

// Kategorien verarbeiten
$categories = isset($_POST['categories']) ? $_POST['categories'] : [];

// Überprüfen, ob die Benutzer-ID vorhanden ist
if ($userId == 0) {
    echo "Fehler: Ungültige Benutzer-ID!";
    exit;
}

try {
    // Beginne mit einer Transaktion, um alle Updates gleichzeitig durchzuführen
    $db->beginTransaction();

    // Benutzerinformationen aktualisieren
    $stmt = $db->prepare("UPDATE users SET 
        first_name = ?, 
        last_name = ?, 
        username = ?, 
        email = ?, 
        activated = ?, 
        collect_points = ?, 
        receive_emails = ?, 
        role = ?, 
        repeat_interval_correct = ?, 
        repeat_interval_incorrect = ? 
        WHERE id = ?");
    $stmt->execute([$firstName, $lastName, $username, $email, $activated, $collectPoints, $receiveEmails, $role, $repeatIntervalCorrect, $repeatIntervalIncorrect, $userId]);

    // Kategorien aktualisieren (nehmen wir an, dass es eine Tabelle 'user_categories' gibt)
    // Zuerst alle alten Kategorien löschen
    $stmt = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM user_categories WHERE user_id = ?");
    $stmt->execute([$userId]);

    // Neue Kategorien speichern
    foreach ($categories as $categoryId) {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO user_categories (user_id, category_id) VALUES (?, ?)");
        $stmt->execute([$userId, $categoryId]);
    }

    // Wenn alles erfolgreich war, Transaktion bestätigen
    $db->commit();

    echo "Benutzerdaten wurden erfolgreich aktualisiert!";
    header("Location: user_management.php"); // Zurück zur Benutzerverwaltung

} catch (PDOException $e) {
    // Falls es zu einem Fehler kommt, Transaktion zurückrollen
    $db->rollBack();
    echo "Fehler beim Speichern der Daten: " . $e->getMessage();
}
?>
```

```php
<?php
session_start();
require_once '../config.php';

checkUserRole(ROLE_ADMIN);

function getAllUsers($db) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->query("SELECT id, first_name, last_name, username, email, role, last_login, logged_out, logged_in, activated FROM users ORDER BY username");
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Fehler beim Abrufen der Benutzer: " . $e->getMessage());
        return [];
    }
}

$users = getAllUsers($db);
$message = '';

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST' && isset($_POST['create_user'])) {
    $username = trim($_POST['username']);
    $first_name = trim($_POST['first_name']);
    $last_name = trim($_POST['last_name']);
    $email = trim($_POST['email']);
    $password = password_hash($_POST['password'], PASSWORD_DEFAULT);
    $role = $_POST['role'];

    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO users (username, first_name, last_name, email, password, role) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)");
        if ($stmt->execute([$username, $first_name, $last_name, $email, $password, $role])) {
            $message = "Benutzer erfolgreich erstellt.";
            $users = getAllUsers($db);
        } else {
            $message = "Fehler beim Erstellen des Benutzers.";
        }
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        $message = "Fehler beim Erstellen des Benutzers: " . $e->getMessage();
    }
}

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST' && isset($_POST['delete'])) {
    $userId = $_POST['user_id'];
    $stmt = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM users WHERE id = ?");
    if ($stmt->execute([$userId])) {
        $message = "Benutzer erfolgreich gelöscht.";
        $users = getAllUsers($db);
    } else {
        $message = "Fehler beim Löschen des Benutzers.";
    }
}

function formatDateTime($dateTime) {
    if ($dateTime) {
        return date("d.m.Y H:i:s", strtotime($dateTime));
    }
    return "N/A";
}

function calculateSessionDuration($lastLogin, $loggedOut) {
    if ($lastLogin && $loggedOut) {
        $start = new DateTime($lastLogin);
        $end = new DateTime($loggedOut);
        $interval = $start->diff($end);
        if ($interval->h > 0) {
            return $interval->h . " Std, " . $interval->i . " Min";
        } else {
            return $interval->i . " Min";
        }
    }
    return "N/A";
}

function getUserStatus($user) {
    if ($user['activated'] == '0') {
        return ['badge' => 'badge-danger', 'text' => 'Gesperrt', 'icon' => 'fa-ban'];
    } elseif ($user['logged_in']) {
        return ['badge' => 'badge-success', 'text' => 'Online', 'icon' => 'fa-circle'];
    } else {
        return ['badge' => 'badge-secondary', 'text' => 'Offline', 'icon' => 'fa-circle'];
    }
}
?>
```

```php
<?php
session_start();
require_once '../config.php';
checkUserRole(ROLE_USER);

header('Content-Type: application/json');
$userId = $_SESSION['user_id'];

// GET /api/quiz.php?action=get_questions
if ($_GET['action'] === 'get_questions') {
    $categoryIds = json_decode($_GET['categories'] ?? '[]');
    $limit = intval($_GET['limit'] ?? 10);
    
    if (empty($categoryIds)) {
        http_response_code(400);
        die(json_encode(['error' => 'Keine Kategorien']));
    }
    
    // Nutze deine getQuestions() Funktion
    $questions = getQuestions($db, $categoryIds, $limit);
    
    // Nur ID und Text zurückgeben (keine Antworten!)
    $safe_questions = array_map(function($q) {
        return ['id' => $q['id'], 'text' => $q['question_text']];
    }, $questions);
    
    echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'questions' => $safe_questions]);
}

// GET /api/quiz.php?action=get_answers&question_id=123
if ($_GET['action'] === 'get_answers') {
    $questionId = intval($_GET['question_id']);
    $answers = getAnswers($db, $questionId);
    
    // Antworten ohne is_correct zurückgeben!
    $safe_answers = array_map(function($a) {
        return ['id' => $a['id'], 'text' => $a['answer_text']];
    }, $answers);
    
    echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'answers' => $safe_answers]);
}

// POST /api/quiz.php - Antwort speichern
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    $data = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true);
    
    $questionId = intval($data['question_id']);
    $answerId = intval($data['answer_id']);
    $rating = intval($data['user_rating'] ?? 3);
    
    // Überprüfe ob Antwort korrekt ist
    $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT is_correct FROM answers WHERE id = ? AND question_id = ?");
    $stmt->execute([$answerId, $questionId]);
    $result = $stmt->fetch();
    
    if (!$result) {
        http_response_code(400);
        die(json_encode(['error' => 'Ungültige Antwort']));
    }
    
    $isCorrect = (bool)$result['is_correct'];
    
    // Statistik aktualisieren
    updateUserStatistics($db, $userId, $questionId, $isCorrect, $rating);
    updateDailyPoints($db, $userId);
    
    echo json_encode([
        'success' => true,
        'is_correct' => $isCorrect,
        'message' => $isCorrect ? 'Richtig!' : 'Leider falsch'
    ]);
}
```

```php
    </div>

    <script>
        // ===== CONFIG =====
        const config = {
            enabled: true,
            type: 'particles', // 'particles', 'perlin', 'disabled'
            particleColor: '#007bff',
            lineColor: '#007bff',
            opacity: 0.3,
            particleCount: 50,
            particleSize: 2,
            particleSpeed: 1,
            connectionRadius: 150,
            lineWidth: 1
        };

        // Canvas Setup
        const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        let particles = [];

        function resizeCanvas() {
            canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
            canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
        }
        resizeCanvas();
        window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas);

        // ===== PARTICLE CLASS =====
        class Particle {
            constructor(x, y, vx, vy) {
                this.x = x || Math.random() * canvas.width;
                this.y = y || Math.random() * canvas.height;
                this.vx = vx || (Math.random() - 0.5) * config.particleSpeed * 2;
                this.vy = vy || (Math.random() - 0.5) * config.particleSpeed * 2;
            }

            update() {
                this.x += this.vx;
                this.y += this.vy;

                // Bounce off walls
                if (this.x < 0 || this.x > canvas.width) this.vx *= -1;
                if (this.y < 0 || this.y > canvas.height) this.vy *= -1;

                this.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.width, this.x));
                this.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.height, this.y));
            }

            draw() {
                ctx.fillStyle = config.particleColor;
                ctx.globalAlpha = config.opacity;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, config.particleSize, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
            }
        }

        // ===== PERLIN NOISE (einfache Implementierung) =====
        function perlin(x, y, z) {
            const xi = Math.floor(x) & 255;
            const yi = Math.floor(y) & 255;
            const zi = Math.floor(z) & 255;

            const xf = x - Math.floor(x);
            const yf = y - Math.floor(y);
            const zf = z - Math.floor(z);

            const u = fade(xf);
            const v = fade(yf);
            const w = fade(zf);

            const p = permutation;
            const aa = p[p[p[xi] + yi] + zi];
            const ab = p[p[p[xi] + yi + 1] + zi];
            const ba = p[p[p[xi + 1] + yi] + zi];
            const bb = p[p[p[xi + 1] + yi + 1] + zi];

            const x1 = lerp(grad(aa, xf, yf, zf), grad(ba, xf - 1, yf, zf), u);
            const x2 = lerp(grad(ab, xf, yf - 1, zf), grad(bb, xf - 1, yf - 1, zf), u);

            return lerp(x1, x2, v) * 0.5 + 0.5;
        }

        function fade(t) {
            return t * t * t * (t * (t * 6 - 15) + 10);
        }

        function lerp(t, a, b) {
            return a + t * (b - a);
        }

        function grad(hash, x, y, z) {
            const h = hash & 15;
            const u = h < 8 ? x : y;
            const v = h < 8 ? y : z;
            return ((h & 1) === 0 ? u : -u) + ((h & 2) === 0 ? v : -v);
        }

        const permutation = Array.from({ length: 256 }, (_, i) => i).sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5);

        // ===== ANIMATION LOOP =====
        function animate() {
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
            ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

            if (config.type === 'disabled') {
                requestAnimationFrame(animate);
                return;
            }

            if (config.type === 'particles') {
                animateParticles();
            } else if (config.type === 'perlin') {
                animatePerlin();
            }

            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
        }

        function animateParticles() {
            // Update and draw particles
            particles.forEach(p => {
                p.update();
                p.draw();
            });

            // Draw connections
            ctx.globalAlpha = config.opacity * 0.5;
            ctx.strokeStyle = config.lineColor;
            ctx.lineWidth = config.lineWidth;

            for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
                for (let j = i + 1; j < particles.length; j++) {
                    const dx = particles[i].x - particles[j].x;
                    const dy = particles[i].y - particles[j].y;
                    const distance = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

                    if (distance < config.connectionRadius) {
                        ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - distance / config.connectionRadius) * config.opacity * 0.5;
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.moveTo(particles[i].x, particles[i].y);
                        ctx.lineTo(particles[j].x, particles[j].y);
                        ctx.stroke();
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        function animatePerlin() {
            const time = Date.now() * 0.0005;
            ctx.globalAlpha = config.opacity;
            ctx.fillStyle = config.particleColor;

            for (let i = 0; i < config.particleCount; i++) {
                const angle = (i / config.particleCount) * Math.PI * 2;
                const noise = perlin(Math.cos(angle) * 5, Math.sin(angle) * 5, time);
                const x = canvas.width / 2 + Math.cos(angle) * noise * 300 + Math.sin(time + i) * 50;
                const y = canvas.height / 2 + Math.sin(angle) * noise * 300 + Math.cos(time + i) * 50;

                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(x, y, config.particleSize, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();

                // Draw connections
                if (i < config.particleCount - 1) {
                    const angle2 = ((i + 1) / config.particleCount) * Math.PI * 2;
                    const noise2 = perlin(Math.cos(angle2) * 5, Math.sin(angle2) * 5, time);
                    const x2 = canvas.width / 2 + Math.cos(angle2) * noise2 * 300 + Math.sin(time + i + 1) * 50;
                    const y2 = canvas.height / 2 + Math.sin(angle2) * noise2 * 300 + Math.cos(time + i + 1) * 50;

                    const dx = x - x2;
                    const dy = y - y2;
                    const distance = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

                    if (distance < config.connectionRadius) {
                        ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - distance / config.connectionRadius) * config.opacity * 0.5;
                        ctx.strokeStyle = config.lineColor;
                        ctx.lineWidth = config.lineWidth;
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.moveTo(x, y);
                        ctx.lineTo(x2, y2);
                        ctx.stroke();
                    }
                    ctx.globalAlpha = config.opacity;
                }
            }
        }

        // ===== EVENT LISTENERS =====
        document.getElementById('bgType').addEventListener('change', (e) => {
            config.type = e.target.value;
            updateParticles();
        });

        document.getElementById('particleColor').addEventListener('change', (e) => {
            config.particleColor = e.target.value;
        });

        document.getElementById('lineColor').addEventListener('change', (e) => {
            config.lineColor = e.target.value;
        });

        document.getElementById('bgOpacity').addEventListener('input', (e) => {
            config.opacity = parseFloat(e.target.value);
            document.getElementById('opacityValue').textContent = config.opacity.toFixed(1);
        });

        document.getElementById('particleCount').addEventListener('input', (e) => {
            config.particleCount = parseInt(e.target.value);
            document.getElementById('countValue').textContent = config.particleCount;
            updateParticles();
        });

        document.getElementById('particleSize').addEventListener('input', (e) => {
            config.particleSize = parseFloat(e.target.value);
            document.getElementById('sizeValue').textContent = config.particleSize.toFixed(1);
        });

        document.getElementById('particleSpeed').addEventListener('input', (e) => {
            config.particleSpeed = parseFloat(e.target.value);
            document.getElementById('speedValue').textContent = config.particleSpeed.toFixed(1);
            updateParticles();
        });

        document.getElementById('connectionRadius').addEventListener('input', (e) => {
            config.connectionRadius = parseInt(e.target.value);
            document.getElementById('radiusValue').textContent = config.connectionRadius;
        });

        document.getElementById('lineWidth').addEventListener('input', (e) => {
            config.lineWidth = parseFloat(e.target.value);
            document.getElementById('lineValue').textContent = config.lineWidth.toFixed(1);
        });

        // ===== HELPER FUNCTIONS =====
        function updateParticles() {
            particles = [];
            for (let i = 0; i < config.particleCount; i++) {
                particles.push(new Particle());
            }
        }

        function applyPreset(preset) {
            const presets = {
                subtle: {
                    type: 'particles',
                    particleColor: '#007bff',
                    lineColor: '#007bff',
                    opacity: 0.15,
                    particleCount: 30,
                    particleSize: 1.5,
                    particleSpeed: 0.5,
                    connectionRadius: 120,
                    lineWidth: 0.8
                },
                medium: {
                    type: 'particles',
                    particleColor: '#007bff',
                    lineColor: '#007bff',
                    opacity: 0.3,
                    particleCount: 50,
                    particleSize: 2,
                    particleSpeed: 1,
                    connectionRadius: 150,
                    lineWidth: 1
                },
                intense: {
                    type: 'perlin',
                    particleColor: '#00d4ff',
                    lineColor: '#0099ff',
                    opacity: 0.5,
                    particleCount: 80,
                    particleSize: 2.5,
                    particleSpeed: 1.5,
                    connectionRadius: 200,
                    lineWidth: 1.5
                },
                dark: {
                    type: 'particles',
                    particleColor: '#666666',
                    lineColor: '#999999',
                    opacity: 0.2,
                    particleCount: 40,
                    particleSize: 2,
                    particleSpeed: 0.7,
                    connectionRadius: 140,
                    lineWidth: 0.8
                }
            };

            Object.assign(config, presets[preset]);
            updateUI();
            updateParticles();
        }

        function updateUI() {
            document.getElementById('bgType').value = config.type;
            document.getElementById('particleColor').value = config.particleColor;
            document.getElementById('lineColor').value = config.lineColor;
            document.getElementById('bgOpacity').value = config.opacity;
            document.getElementById('opacityValue').textContent = config.opacity.toFixed(1);
            document.getElementById('particleCount').value = config.particleCount;
            document.getElementById('countValue').textContent = config.particleCount;
            document.getElementById('particleSize').value = config.particleSize;
            document.getElementById('sizeValue').textContent = config.particleSize.toFixed(1);
            document.getElementById('particleSpeed').value = config.particleSpeed;
            document.getElementById('speedValue').textContent = config.particleSpeed.toFixed(1);
            document.getElementById('connectionRadius').value = config.connectionRadius;
            document.getElementById('radiusValue').textContent = config.connectionRadius;
            document.getElementById('lineWidth').value = config.lineWidth;
            document.getElementById('lineValue').textContent = config.lineWidth.toFixed(1);
        }

        // Initialization
        updateParticles();
        applyPreset('subtle'); // Standard: Subtil
        animate();
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```php
function sendPasswordResetEmail($email, $token, $baseUrl) {
    $mail = new PHPMailer(true);

    try {
        // Server settings
        $mail->isSMTP();
        $mail->Host       = SMTP_HOST;
        $mail->SMTPAuth   = true;
        $mail->Username   = SMTP_USER;
        $mail->Password   = SMTP_PASS;
        $mail->SMTPSecure = PHPMailer::ENCRYPTION_SMTPS; // For SSL
        $mail->Port       = SMTP_PORT;

        // 💡 Hier IPv4 erzwingen:
        $mail->SMTPOptions = [
            'socket' => [
                'bindto' => '0.0.0.0:0'  // zwingt IPv4
            ]
        ];

        // Recipient
        $mail->setFrom(SMTP_FROM, SMTP_FROM_NAME);
        $mail->addAddress($email);

        // Email content
        $mail->isHTML(true);
        $mail->CharSet = 'UTF-8';
        $mail->Subject = "Passwort zurücksetzen - Quiz App";
        $mail->Body    = "
        <!DOCTYPE html>
        <html lang='de'>

            <meta charset='UTF-8'>

                    border-radius: 5px;
                }

                    margin-top: 10px;

        ";

        // Send email
        $mail->send();
        return true;
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        return "Mailer Error: {$mail->ErrorInfo}";
    }
}

// Automatic domain detection
$protocol = isset($_SERVER['HTTPS']) && $_SERVER['HTTPS'] === 'on' ? "https" : "http";
$domain = $_SERVER['HTTP_HOST'];
$baseUrl = $protocol . "://" . $domain;

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    $email = $_POST['email'];

    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$email]);
        $user = $stmt->fetch();

        if ($user) {
            $token = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
            $expiry = date('Y-m-d H:i:s', strtotime('+1 hour'));

            $updateStmt = $db->prepare("UPDATE users SET reset_token = ?, reset_token_expiry = ? WHERE id = ?");
            $updateStmt->execute([$token, $expiry, $user['id']]);

            // Send email
            if (sendPasswordResetEmail($email, $token, $baseUrl) === true) {
                $message = "Ein Link zum Zurücksetzen des Passworts wurde an Ihre E-Mail-Adresse gesendet.";
            } else {
                $message = "Fehler beim Senden der E-Mail.";
            }
        } else {
            $message = "Es wurde kein Konto mit dieser E-Mail-Adresse gefunden.";
        }
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        $message = "Fehler: " . $e->getMessage();
    }
```

## File: global_functions.php

```php
<?php
function updateUserStatistics($conn, $user_id, $question_id, $is_correct) {
    $sql = "INSERT INTO user_statistics (user_id, question_id, correct_count, incorrect_count) 
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?) 
            ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE 
            correct_count = correct_count + ?, 
            incorrect_count = incorrect_count + ?";
    
    $correct_increment = $is_correct ? 1 : 0;
    $incorrect_increment = $is_correct ? 0 : 1;
    
    $stmt = $conn->prepare($sql);
    $stmt->bind_param("iiiiii", $user_id, $question_id, $correct_increment, $incorrect_increment, $correct_increment, $incorrect_increment);
    $stmt->execute();
}
?>
```

```php
function getQuizRanking($db) {
    $query = "
        SELECT 
            u.id,
            u.first_name,
            u.last_name,
            udp.current_points,
            udp.streak
        FROM user_statistics us
        JOIN users u ON u.id = us.user_id
        LEFT JOIN user_daily_points udp ON udp.user_id = us.user_id
        WHERE udp.user_id IS NOT NULL  
          AND u.highscore = 1
          AND udp.streak > 0
        GROUP BY u.id, u.first_name, u.last_name, udp.current_points, udp.streak
        ORDER BY udp.streak DESC
    ";
    $result = $db->query($query);
    $rankingData = [];

    while ($row = $result->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)) {
        $rankingData[] = $row;
    }

    return $rankingData;
}

$rankingData = getQuizRanking($db);
?>

    const rankingData = <?php echo json_encode($rankingData); ?>;
    const rankingBody = document.getElementById('ranking-body');

    function getRankIcon(rank) {
        if (rank === 1) {
            return '<i class="fas fa-crown icon-gold"></i>';
        } else if (rank === 2) {
            return '<i class="fas fa-crown icon-silver"></i>';
        } else if (rank === 3) {
            return '<i class="fas fa-crown icon-bronze"></i>';
        } else {
            return '<i class="fas fa-crown icon-default"></i>';
        }
    }

    rankingData.forEach((user, index) => {
        const rank = index + 1;
        const streakClass = user.streak >= 20
            ? 'streak-high'
            : user.streak >= 10
                ? 'streak-medium'
                : 'streak-low';

        const row = `
            <tr>
                <td>
                    <div class="rank-icon-wrapper">
                        ${getRankIcon(rank)}
                        <span>${rank}.</span>
                    </div>
                </td>
                <td>${user.first_name}</td>
                <td>${user.last_name}</td>
                <td class="${streakClass}">${user.streak}</td>
            </tr>
        `;
        rankingBody.innerHTML += row;
    });
</script>
</body>
```

```php
function getOpenReportsCount($db) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            SELECT COUNT(*) as count 
            FROM reports 
            WHERE status = 'open'
        ");
        $stmt->execute();
        $result = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return $result['count'];
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("getOpenReportsCount Fehler: " . $e->getMessage());
        return 0;
    }
}

// Counter vor der Tabelle anzeigen
```

```php
// Überprüfen, ob Statistiken für den Benutzer vorhanden sind
function hasUserStatistics($db, $userId) {
    $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_statistics WHERE user_id = ?");
    $stmt->execute([$userId]);
    return $stmt->fetchColumn() > 0;
}

$hasStats = hasUserStatistics($db, $_SESSION['user_id']);

// Überprüfen, ob der Benutzer am Highscore-Ranking teilnimmt
function isUserInHighscore($db, $userId) {
    $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT highscore FROM users WHERE id = ?");
    $stmt->execute([$userId]);
    return $stmt->fetchColumn() == 1;
}

// Beispielverwendung
$isInHighscore = isUserInHighscore($db, $_SESSION['user_id']);

// Überprüfung aktiver Meldungen
// TODO: Interval in 14 Tagen in den zentralen Einstellungen hinterlegen - statt created_at nun updated_at verwendet
function hasActiveReports($db, $userId) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            SELECT COUNT(*) 
            FROM reports 
            WHERE user_id = :user_id 
            AND (
                status IN ('open', 'in_progress') 
                OR 
                (status IN ('resolved', 'rejected') AND updated_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 14 DAY)
            )
        ");
        $stmt->execute([':user_id' => $userId]);
        return $stmt->fetchColumn() > 0;
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Aktive Reports Check Fehler: " . $e->getMessage());
        return false;
    }
}

$showReportsButton = hasActiveReports($db, $_SESSION['user_id']);

// Rangberechnung (z. B. Punkte aus DB)

$punkte = $pointsStmt->fetchColumn() ?: 0;
```

```php
<?php
class QuestionReviewSystem {
    private $db;
    
    public function __construct($database) {
        $this->db = $database;
    }
    
    /**
     * Admin: Meldung in den Pool werfen
     * FIXED: Prüft auf existierende Reviews, besseres Error-Handling
     */
    public function moveToPool($reportId, $adminId) {
        try {
            $this->db->beginTransaction();
            
            // Hole Report-Daten
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                SELECT question_id, user_id, report_type, details 
                FROM reports 
                WHERE id = ?
            ");
            $stmt->execute([$reportId]);
            $report = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            
            if (!$report) {
                throw new Exception("Meldung nicht gefunden");
            }
            
            // WICHTIG: Prüfe ob bereits ein Review-Eintrag existiert
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                SELECT id, status, reviewer_id FROM question_reviews WHERE report_id = ?
            ");
            $stmt->execute([$reportId]);
            $existingReview = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            
            if ($existingReview) {
                // Review existiert bereits
                if ($existingReview['status'] === 'pending_approval') {
                    throw new Exception("Dieser Review wartet bereits auf Genehmigung und kann nicht in den Pool verschoben werden");
                }
                
                // Setze Status zurück auf 'pool' und entferne reviewer_id
                $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                    UPDATE question_reviews 
                    SET status = 'pool', 
                        reviewer_id = NULL, 
                        assigned_at = NULL,
                        admin_action = NULL,
                        admin_feedback = NULL
                    WHERE report_id = ?
                ");
                $stmt->execute([$reportId]);
                error_log("moveToPool: Existierendes Review #{$existingReview['id']} zurück in Pool verschoben");
            } else {
                // Erstelle neuen Review-Eintrag
                $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                    INSERT INTO question_reviews 
                    (report_id, question_id, status, created_at) 
                    VALUES (?, ?, 'pool', NOW())
                ");
                $success = $stmt->execute([$reportId, $report['question_id']]);
                
                if (!$success) {
                    throw new Exception("Fehler beim Erstellen des Review-Eintrags: " . implode(', ', $stmt->errorInfo()));
                }
                
                $reviewId = $this->db->lastInsertId();
                error_log("moveToPool: Neues Review #{$reviewId} erstellt für Report #{$reportId}");
            }
            
            // Update Report Status
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                UPDATE reports 
                SET status = 'in_pool', updated_at = NOW() 
                WHERE id = ?
            ");
            $stmt->execute([$reportId]);
            
            // Log-Eintrag
            $this->addAuditLog($adminId, 'report_to_pool', $reportId, 
                "Meldung #{$reportId} in Pool verschoben");
            
            $this->db->commit();
            return ['success' => true, 'message' => 'Meldung erfolgreich in Pool verschoben'];
            
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($this->db->inTransaction()) {
                $this->db->rollBack();
            }
            error_log("moveToPool Fehler: " . $e->getMessage() . " | Report-ID: {$reportId} | Trace: " . $e->getTraceAsString());
            return ['success' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage()];
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * Admin: Meldung aus Pool entfernen (rückgängig machen)
     * FIXED: Löscht Review-Eintrag komplett und setzt Report zurück
     */
    public function removeFromPool($reportId, $adminId) {
        try {
            $this->db->beginTransaction();
            
            // Prüfe ob Report existiert
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                SELECT id, status FROM reports WHERE id = ?
            ");
            $stmt->execute([$reportId]);
            $report = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            
            if (!$report) {
                throw new Exception("Meldung nicht gefunden");
            }
            
            // Hole zugehöriges Review
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                SELECT qr.id, qr.status, qr.reviewer_id
                FROM question_reviews qr
                WHERE qr.report_id = ?
            ");
            $stmt->execute([$reportId]);
            $review = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            
            // Wenn Review existiert, prüfe Status
            if ($review) {
                // Prüfe ob Review in Bearbeitung ist
                if ($review['status'] === 'in_review' && !empty($review['reviewer_id'])) {
                    throw new Exception("Review kann nicht entfernt werden - wird gerade von einem Reviewer bearbeitet");
                }
                
                if ($review['status'] === 'pending_approval') {
                    throw new Exception("Review kann nicht entfernt werden - wartet auf Genehmigung");
                }
                
                // Lösche Review-Eintrag komplett
                $stmt = $this->db->prepare("DELETE FROM question_reviews WHERE id = ?");
                $stmt->execute([$review['id']]);
                error_log("removeFromPool: Review #{$review['id']} wurde gelöscht");
            }
            
            // Setze Report-Status zurück auf 'open'
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                UPDATE reports 
                SET status = 'open', updated_at = NOW() 
                WHERE id = ?
            ");
            $stmt->execute([$reportId]);
            
            // Log-Eintrag
            $this->addAuditLog($adminId, 'report_remove_from_pool', $reportId, 
                "Meldung #{$reportId} aus Pool entfernt");
            
            $this->db->commit();
            return ['success' => true, 'message' => 'Meldung aus Pool entfernt und auf "Offen" zurückgesetzt'];
            
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($this->db->inTransaction()) {
                $this->db->rollBack();
            }
            error_log("removeFromPool Fehler: " . $e->getMessage());
            return ['success' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage()];
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * Hole alle verfügbaren Reviews aus dem Pool (für Reviewer)
     * FIXED: Pool-Reviews werden unabhängig von reviewer_id angezeigt
     */
    public function getPoolReviews($reviewerId = null) {
        $sql = "
            SELECT 
                qr.id,
                qr.report_id,
                qr.question_id,
                qr.reviewer_id,
                qr.status,
                qr.created_at,
                q.question_text,
                q.explanation,
                r.report_type,
                r.details as report_details,
                r.user_id as reporter_id,
                u.first_name as reporter_first_name,
                u.last_name as reporter_last_name
            FROM question_reviews qr
            JOIN reports r ON qr.report_id = r.id
            JOIN questions q ON qr.question_id = q.id
            LEFT JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id
            WHERE qr.status IN ('pool', 'in_review')
        ";
        
        if ($reviewerId) {
            // Eigene Meldungen ausschließen
            // Pool-Reviews (status='pool') sind für ALLE verfügbar, unabhängig von reviewer_id
            // In-Review (status='in_review') nur eigene anzeigen
            $sql .= " AND r.user_id != ? 
                      AND (
                          (qr.status = 'pool')
                          OR (qr.status = 'in_review' AND qr.reviewer_id = ?)
                      )";
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare($sql . " ORDER BY qr.created_at ASC");
            $stmt->execute([$reviewerId, $reviewerId]);
        } else {
            $sql .= " AND qr.status = 'pool'";
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare($sql . " ORDER BY qr.created_at ASC");
            $stmt->execute();
        }
        
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }
    
    /**
     * Reviewer nimmt sich eine Aufgabe
     */
    public function claimReview($reviewId, $reviewerId) {
        try {
            $this->db->beginTransaction();
            
            // Prüfe ob Review verfügbar ist
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                SELECT qr.*, r.user_id as reporter_id
                FROM question_reviews qr
                JOIN reports r ON qr.report_id = r.id
                WHERE qr.id = ? AND qr.status = 'pool'
            ");
            $stmt->execute([$reviewId]);
            $review = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            
            if (!$review) {
                throw new Exception("Review nicht verfügbar oder bereits vergeben");
            }
            
            // Prüfe ob User seine eigene Meldung reviewen will
            if ($review['reporter_id'] == $reviewerId) {
                throw new Exception("Du kannst deine eigene Meldung nicht reviewen");
            }
            
            // Weise Review zu
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                UPDATE question_reviews 
                SET reviewer_id = ?, 
                    status = 'in_review', 
                    assigned_at = NOW() 
                WHERE id = ? AND status = 'pool'
            ");
            $stmt->execute([$reviewerId, $reviewId]);
            
            if ($stmt->rowCount() > 0) {
                // Update Report Status
                $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                    UPDATE reports r
                    JOIN question_reviews qr ON r.id = qr.report_id
                    SET r.status = 'in_review'
                    WHERE qr.id = ?
                ");
                $stmt->execute([$reviewId]);
                
                $this->addAuditLog($reviewerId, 'review_claimed', $reviewId, 
                    "Review #{$reviewId} übernommen");
                
                $this->db->commit();
                
                return ['success' => true, 'message' => 'Review erfolgreich übernommen'];
            }
            
            $this->db->rollBack();
            return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Review wurde bereits von jemand anderem übernommen'];
            
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($this->db->inTransaction()) {
                $this->db->rollBack();
            }
            error_log("claimReview Fehler: " . $e->getMessage());
            return ['success' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage()];
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * Hole Details einer Review-Aufgabe mit Frage und Antworten
     */
    public function getReviewDetails($reviewId, $reviewerId = null) {
        $sql = "
            SELECT 
                qr.*,
                q.question_text,
                q.explanation,
                r.report_type,
                r.details as report_details,
                r.user_id as reporter_id,
                u.first_name as reporter_first_name,
                u.last_name as reporter_last_name
            FROM question_reviews qr
            JOIN reports r ON qr.report_id = r.id
            JOIN questions q ON qr.question_id = q.id
            LEFT JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id
            WHERE qr.id = ?
        ";
        
        if ($reviewerId) {
            $sql .= " AND qr.reviewer_id = ?";
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare($sql);
            $stmt->execute([$reviewId, $reviewerId]);
        } else {
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare($sql);
            $stmt->execute([$reviewId]);
        }
        
        $review = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        
        if ($review) {
            // Hole Antworten
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                SELECT id, answer_text, is_correct 
                FROM answers 
                WHERE question_id = ? 
                ORDER BY id
            ");
            $stmt->execute([$review['question_id']]);
            $review['answers'] = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        }
        
        return $review;
    }
    
    /**
     * Reviewer reicht Änderungen ein
     */
    public function submitReview($reviewId, $reviewerId, $data) {
        try {
            $this->db->beginTransaction();
            
            // Prüfe ob Reviewer berechtigt ist
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                SELECT id FROM question_reviews 
                WHERE id = ? AND reviewer_id = ? AND status = 'in_review'
            ");
            $stmt->execute([$reviewId, $reviewerId]);
            
            if (!$stmt->fetch()) {
                throw new Exception("Nicht berechtigt oder Review nicht in Bearbeitung");
            }
            
            // Speichere Änderungsvorschlag
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                UPDATE question_reviews 
                SET proposed_question_text = ?,
                    proposed_explanation = ?,
                    proposed_answers = ?,
                    reviewer_note = ?,
                    reviewer_feedback = ?,
                    source = ?,
                    source_note = ?,
                    status = 'pending_approval',
                    submitted_at = NOW()
                WHERE id = ?
            ");
            
            $answersJson = json_encode($data['answers'], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
            
            $stmt->execute([
                $data['question_text'],
                $data['explanation'],
                $answersJson,
                $data['reviewer_note'] ?? null,
                $data['reviewer_feedback'] ?? null,
                $data['source'] ?? null,
                $data['source_note'] ?? null,
                $reviewId
            ]);
            
            // Update Report Status
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                UPDATE reports r
                JOIN question_reviews qr ON r.id = qr.report_id
                SET r.status = 'in_progress'
                WHERE qr.id = ?
            ");
            $stmt->execute([$reviewId]);
            
            $this->addAuditLog($reviewerId, 'review_submitted', $reviewId, 
                "Änderungsvorschlag eingereicht");
            
            $this->db->commit();
            
            // Sende Bestätigungs-E-Mail an Reviewer
            $this->sendEmailToReviewer($reviewerId, 'submitted', $reviewId);
            
            return ['success' => true, 'message' => 'Änderungen erfolgreich eingereicht'];
            
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($this->db->inTransaction()) {
                $this->db->rollBack();
            }
            error_log("submitReview Fehler: " . $e->getMessage());
            return ['success' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage()];
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * Admin: Hole alle ausstehenden Reviews
     */
    public function getPendingReviewsForAdmin() {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
            SELECT 
                qr.id,
                qr.report_id,
                qr.question_id,
                qr.reviewer_id,
                qr.proposed_question_text,
                qr.proposed_explanation,
                qr.proposed_answers,
                qr.reviewer_note,
                qr.reviewer_feedback,
                qr.source,
                qr.source_note,
                qr.submitted_at,
                q.question_text as current_question,
                q.explanation as current_explanation,
                r.report_type,
                r.details as report_details,
                u.first_name as reviewer_first_name,
                u.last_name as reviewer_last_name,
                rep.first_name as reporter_first_name,
                rep.last_name as reporter_last_name
            FROM question_reviews qr
            JOIN reports r ON qr.report_id = r.id
            JOIN questions q ON qr.question_id = q.id
            LEFT JOIN users u ON qr.reviewer_id = u.id
            LEFT JOIN users rep ON r.user_id = rep.id
            WHERE qr.status = 'pending_approval'
            ORDER BY qr.submitted_at ASC
        ");
        $stmt->execute();
        $reviews = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        
        // Hole aktuelle Antworten für jede Frage
        foreach ($reviews as &$review) {
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                SELECT id, answer_text, is_correct 
                FROM answers 
                WHERE question_id = ? 
                ORDER BY id
            ");
            $stmt->execute([$review['question_id']]);
            $review['current_answers'] = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            $review['proposed_answers_decoded'] = json_decode($review['proposed_answers'], true);
        }
        
        return $reviews;
    }
    
    /**
     * Admin: Änderungen genehmigen (alte Methode - für Kompatibilität)
     */
    public function approveReview($reviewId, $adminId) {
        try {
            $this->db->beginTransaction();
            
            // Hole Review-Daten
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                SELECT qr.*, r.user_id as reporter_id
                FROM question_reviews qr
                JOIN reports r ON qr.report_id = r.id
                WHERE qr.id = ? AND qr.status = 'pending_approval'
            ");
            $stmt->execute([$reviewId]);
            $review = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            
            if (!$review) {
                throw new Exception("Review nicht gefunden oder Status nicht 'pending_approval'");
            }
            
            // Validiere Daten
            if (empty($review['proposed_question_text'])) {
                throw new Exception("Kein Fragetext vorhanden");
            }
            
            // Update Frage
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                UPDATE questions 
                SET question_text = ?,
                    explanation = ?,
                    updated_at = NOW()
                WHERE id = ?
            ");
            $success = $stmt->execute([
                $review['proposed_question_text'],
                $review['proposed_explanation'],
                $review['question_id']
            ]);
            
            if (!$success) {
                throw new Exception("Fehler beim Update der Frage #{$review['question_id']}");
            }
            
            // Update Antworten
            $proposedAnswers = json_decode($review['proposed_answers'], true);
            
            if (!is_array($proposedAnswers) || empty($proposedAnswers)) {
                throw new Exception("Keine gültigen Antworten vorhanden");
            }
            
            // Lösche alte Antworten
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("DELETE FROM answers WHERE question_id = ?");
            $stmt->execute([$review['question_id']]);
            
            // Füge neue Antworten ein
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                INSERT INTO answers (question_id, answer_text, is_correct) 
                VALUES (?, ?, ?)
            ");
            
            foreach ($proposedAnswers as $answer) {
                if (empty($answer['answer_text'])) {
                    throw new Exception("Leerer Antworttext gefunden");
                }
                
                $stmt->execute([
                    $review['question_id'],
                    $answer['answer_text'],
                    $answer['is_correct'] ? 1 : 0
                ]);
            }
            
            // Update Review Status
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                UPDATE question_reviews 
                SET status = 'approved',
                    admin_action = 'approved',
                    reviewed_by_admin = ?,
                    reviewed_at = NOW()
                WHERE id = ?
            ");
            $stmt->execute([$adminId, $reviewId]);
            
            // Update Report Status
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                UPDATE reports 
                SET status = 'resolved',
                    feedback = ?,
                    updated_at = NOW()
                WHERE id = ?
            ");
            $feedbackText = $review['reviewer_feedback'] ?? 'Ihre Meldung wurde geprüft und die Frage wurde korrigiert.';
            $stmt->execute([$feedbackText, $review['report_id']]);
            
            // *** PUNKTE FÜR REVIEWER GUTSCHREIBEN ***
            $streakResult = $this->grantStreakToReviewer($review['reviewer_id'], $review['submitted_at']);
            
            if (!$streakResult) {
                error_log("Warnung: Punkte-Gutschrift fehlgeschlagen für Reviewer #{$review['reviewer_id']}");
            }
            
            // Log
            $this->addAuditLog($adminId, 'review_approved', $reviewId, 
                "Review genehmigt - Frage #{$review['question_id']} aktualisiert - Reviewer erhält +1 Punkt");
            
            $this->db->commit();
            
            // E-Mail an Reviewer (nach commit)
            $this->sendEmailToReviewer($review['reviewer_id'], 'approved', $reviewId, $review['submitted_at']);
            
            return ['success' => true, 'message' => 'Änderungen übernommen und Reviewer erhält +1 Punkt'];
            
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($this->db->inTransaction()) {
                $this->db->rollBack();
            }
            error_log("Fehler in approveReview(): " . $e->getMessage() . " | Trace: " . $e->getTraceAsString());
            return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Fehler: ' . $e->getMessage()];
        }
    }

    /**
     * Admin: Änderungen genehmigen mit Details (NEUE METHODE)
     * Verwendet editierte Daten und sendet konfigurierbare E-Mail
     */
    public function approveReviewWithDetails($reviewId, $adminId, $data) {
        try {
            $this->db->beginTransaction();
            
            // Hole Review-Daten
            // FIXED: r.report_id → r.id as report_id (Column not found: 1054 Unknown column 'r.report_id')
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                SELECT qr.*, r.user_id as reporter_id, r.id as report_id
                FROM question_reviews qr
                JOIN reports r ON qr.report_id = r.id
                WHERE qr.id = ? AND qr.status = 'pending_approval'
            ");
            $stmt->execute([$reviewId]);
            $review = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            
            if (!$review) {
                throw new Exception("Review nicht gefunden oder Status nicht 'pending_approval'");
            }
            
            // Validiere Daten
            if (empty($data['question_text'])) {
                throw new Exception("Kein Fragetext vorhanden");
            }
            
            // Update Frage mit finalen editierten Daten
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                UPDATE questions 
                SET question_text = ?,
                    explanation = ?,
                    updated_at = NOW()
                WHERE id = ?
            ");
            $success = $stmt->execute([
                $data['question_text'],
                $data['explanation'],
                $review['question_id']
            ]);
            
            if (!$success) {
                throw new Exception("Fehler beim Update der Frage #{$review['question_id']}");
            }
            
            // Update Antworten mit finalen editierten Daten
            if (!is_array($data['answers']) || empty($data['answers'])) {
                throw new Exception("Keine gültigen Antworten vorhanden");
            }
            
            // Lösche alte Antworten
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("DELETE FROM answers WHERE question_id = ?");
            $stmt->execute([$review['question_id']]);
            
            // Füge neue Antworten ein
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                INSERT INTO answers (question_id, answer_text, is_correct) 
                VALUES (?, ?, ?)
            ");
            
            foreach ($data['answers'] as $answer) {
                if (empty($answer['answer_text'])) {
                    throw new Exception("Leerer Antworttext gefunden");
                }
                
                $stmt->execute([
                    $review['question_id'],
                    $answer['answer_text'],
                    $answer['is_correct'] ? 1 : 0
                ]);
            }
            
            // Update Review Status
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                UPDATE question_reviews 
                SET status = 'approved',
                    admin_action = 'approved',
                    reviewed_by_admin = ?,
                    reviewed_at = NOW()
                WHERE id = ?
            ");
            $stmt->execute([$adminId, $reviewId]);
            
            // Update Report Status
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                UPDATE reports 
                SET status = 'resolved',
                    feedback = ?,
                    updated_at = NOW()
                WHERE id = ?
            ");
            $feedbackForReport = $data['admin_message'] ?? 'Ihre Meldung wurde geprüft und die Frage wurde korrigiert.';
            $stmt->execute([$feedbackForReport, $review['report_id']]);
            
            // *** PUNKTE FÜR REVIEWER GUTSCHREIBEN ***
            $streakResult = $this->grantStreakToReviewer($review['reviewer_id'], $review['submitted_at']);
            
            if (!$streakResult) {
                error_log("Warnung: Punkte-Gutschrift fehlgeschlagen für Reviewer #{$review['reviewer_id']}");
            }
            
            // Log
            $this->addAuditLog($adminId, 'review_approved', $reviewId, 
                "Review genehmigt - Frage #{$review['question_id']} aktualisiert - Reviewer erhält +1 Punkt");
            
            $this->db->commit();
            
            // E-Mail an Reviewer (nach commit)
            $this->sendEmailToReviewer($review['reviewer_id'], 'approved', $reviewId, $review['submitted_at']);
            
            // E-Mail an Melder (nach commit)
            $emailData = [
                'admin_message' => $data['admin_message'] ?? '',
                'question_text' => $data['question_text'],
                'explanation' => $data['explanation'],
                'answers' => $data['answers'],
                'include_source' => $data['include_source'] ?? false,
                'include_reviewer_feedback' => $data['include_reviewer_feedback'] ?? false,
                'source' => $data['source'] ?? '',
                'source_note' => $data['source_note'] ?? '',
                'reviewer_feedback' => $data['reviewer_feedback'] ?? ''
            ];
            $this->sendEmailToReporter($review['reporter_id'], $review['report_id'], $review['question_id'], $emailData);
            
            // Kopie an Reviewer senden (falls gewünscht)
            if ($data['send_copy_to_reviewer'] ?? false) {
                $this->sendEmailCopyToReviewer($review['reviewer_id'], $review['report_id'], $review['question_id'], $emailData);
            }
            
            return ['success' => true, 'message' => 'Änderungen übernommen, Reviewer erhält +1 Punkt und E-Mail wurde gesendet'];
            
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($this->db->inTransaction()) {
                $this->db->rollBack();
            }
            error_log("Fehler in approveReviewWithDetails(): " . $e->getMessage() . " | Trace: " . $e->getTraceAsString());
            return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Fehler: ' . $e->getMessage()];
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * Admin: Änderungen ablehnen
     */
    public function rejectReview($reviewId, $adminId, $feedback) {
        try {
            $this->db->beginTransaction();
            
            // Hole Review-Daten
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                SELECT qr.*, r.user_id as reporter_id
                FROM question_reviews qr
                JOIN reports r ON qr.report_id = r.id
                WHERE qr.id = ?
            ");
            $stmt->execute([$reviewId]);
            $review = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            
            if (!$review) {
                throw new Exception("Review nicht gefunden");
            }
            
            // Update Review
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                UPDATE question_reviews 
                SET status = 'rejected',
                    admin_action = 'rejected',
                    admin_feedback = ?,
                    reviewed_by_admin = ?,
                    reviewed_at = NOW()
                WHERE id = ?
            ");
            $stmt->execute([$feedback, $adminId, $reviewId]);
            
            // Update Report
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                UPDATE reports 
                SET status = 'rejected',
                    feedback = ?,
                    updated_at = NOW()
                WHERE id = ?
            ");
            $stmt->execute([$feedback, $review['report_id']]);
            
            // Log
            $this->addAuditLog($adminId, 'review_rejected', $reviewId, 
                "Review abgelehnt: " . substr($feedback, 0, 100));
            
            $this->db->commit();
            
            // E-Mails nach commit
            $this->sendEmailToReviewer($review['reviewer_id'], 'rejected', $reviewId, null, $feedback);
            
            return ['success' => true, 'message' => 'Review abgelehnt'];
            
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($this->db->inTransaction()) {
                $this->db->rollBack();
            }
            error_log("rejectReview Fehler: " . $e->getMessage());
            return ['success' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage()];
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * Admin: Rückfrage an Reviewer
     */
    public function sendQuestionToReviewer($reviewId, $adminId, $question) {
        try {
            $this->db->beginTransaction();
            
            // Hole Reviewer ID zuerst
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("SELECT reviewer_id FROM question_reviews WHERE id = ?");
            $stmt->execute([$reviewId]);
            $reviewerId = $stmt->fetchColumn();
            
            if (!$reviewerId) {
                throw new Exception("Kein Reviewer für dieses Review gefunden");
            }
            
            // Update Review
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                UPDATE question_reviews 
                SET admin_action = 'question',
                    admin_feedback = ?,
                    reviewed_by_admin = ?,
                    status = 'in_review'
                WHERE id = ?
            ");
            $stmt->execute([$question, $adminId, $reviewId]);
            
            // Log-Eintrag
            $this->addAuditLog($adminId, 'review_question', $reviewId, 
                "Rückfrage gestellt");
            
            $this->db->commit();
            
            // E-Mail an Reviewer (nach commit)
            $this->sendEmailToReviewer($reviewerId, 'question', $reviewId, null, $question);
            
            return ['success' => true, 'message' => 'Rückfrage gesendet'];
            
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($this->db->inTransaction()) {
                $this->db->rollBack();
            }
            error_log("sendQuestionToReviewer Fehler: " . $e->getMessage());
            return ['success' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage()];
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * Gewähre dem Reviewer einen Punkt für erfolgreiches Review
     */
    private function grantStreakToReviewer($reviewerId, $submittedAt) {
        try {
            // Prüfe ob Eintrag existiert
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                SELECT user_id, streak, last_answered 
                FROM user_daily_points 
                WHERE user_id = ?
            ");
            $stmt->execute([$reviewerId]);
            $pointsData = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            
            if ($pointsData) {
                // Update existierenden Eintrag - nur Streak erhöhen
                $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                    UPDATE user_daily_points 
                    SET streak = streak + 1
                    WHERE user_id = ?
                ");
                $stmt->execute([$reviewerId]);
            } else {
                // Erstelle neuen Eintrag
                $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                    INSERT INTO user_daily_points (user_id, streak, last_answered, current_points)
                    VALUES (?, 1, NOW(), 0)
                ");
                $stmt->execute([$reviewerId]);
            }
            
            error_log("Punkt erfolgreich gutgeschrieben für Reviewer #{$reviewerId}: +1 Punkt");
            return true;
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            error_log("Fehler beim Punkt-Grant für Reviewer #{$reviewerId}: " . $e->getMessage());
            return false;
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * E-Mail an Reviewer senden
     */
    private function sendEmailToReviewer($reviewerId, $action, $reviewId, $submittedAt = null, $message = null) {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare("SELECT email, username, first_name, last_name, receive_emails FROM users WHERE id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$reviewerId]);
        $user = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        
        if (!$user || !$user['email'] || !$user['receive_emails']) return;
        
        $fullName = trim($user['first_name'] . ' ' . $user['last_name']) ?: $user['username'];
        $subject = '';
        $bodyHtml = '';
        $bodyText = '';
        
        switch ($action) {
            case 'submitted':
                $subject = '✅ Dein Review wurde eingereicht';
                $bodyText = "Hallo {$fullName},\n\n";
                $bodyText .= "dein Änderungsvorschlag für Review #{$reviewId} wurde erfolgreich eingereicht.\n\n";
                $bodyText .= "Sobald der Admin dein Review genehmigt, erhältst du +1 Punkt.\n\n";
                $bodyText .= "Vielen Dank für deine Unterstützung!\n";
                break;
                
            case 'approved':
                $subject = '🎉 Dein Review wurde genehmigt!';
                $bodyText = "Hallo {$fullName},\n\n";
                $bodyText .= "großartige Neuigkeiten! Dein Änderungsvorschlag für Review #{$reviewId} wurde vom Admin genehmigt und die Frage wurde aktualisiert.\n\n";
                $bodyText .= "✨ Du erhältst +1 Punkt für deine erfolgreiche Korrektur!\n\n";
                $bodyText .= "Danke, dass du zur Qualität unserer Quiz-App beiträgst!\n";
                break;
                
            case 'rejected':
                $subject = '❌ Dein Review wurde abgelehnt';
                $bodyText = "Hallo {$fullName},\n\n";
                $bodyText .= "dein Änderungsvorschlag für Review #{$reviewId} wurde vom Admin leider abgelehnt.\n\n";
                if ($message) {
                    $bodyText .= "Begründung:\n{$message}\n\n";
                }
                $bodyText .= "Lass dich nicht entmutigen - beim nächsten Mal klappt es bestimmt!\n";
                break;
                
            case 'question':
                $subject = '❓ Rückfrage zu deinem Review';
                $bodyText = "Hallo {$fullName},\n\n";
                $bodyText .= "der Admin hat eine Rückfrage zu deinem Review #{$reviewId}:\n\n";
                $bodyText .= "{$message}\n\n";
                $bodyText .= "Bitte überarbeite deine Änderungen entsprechend und reiche sie erneut ein.\n\n";
                $bodyText .= "Sobald dein überarbeitetes Review genehmigt wird, erhältst du natürlich deinen Punkt!\n";
                break;
        }
        
        $bodyText .= "\nViele Grüße\nDein Quiz-Team";
        
        // HTML-Version
        $bodyHtml = "<!DOCTYPE html>
        <html lang='de'>
        <head><meta charset='UTF-8'><style>
            body { font-family: Arial; line-height: 1.6; color: #333; }
            .container { max-width: 600px; margin: auto; padding: 20px; }
            .header { background: #28a745; color: white; padding: 20px; text-align: center; }
            .content { background: #f9f9f9; padding: 20px; border-radius: 5px; }
            .box { background: #e9ecef; padding: 10px; border-radius: 3px; white-space: pre-wrap; }
            .points { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%); color: white; padding: 15px; border-radius: 5px; text-align: center; margin: 15px 0; }
        </style></head>
        <body><div class='container'>
        <div class='header'><h2>{$subject}</h2></div>
        <div class='content'>";
        
        $bodyHtml .= nl2br(htmlspecialchars($bodyText));
        
        if ($action === 'approved') {
            $bodyHtml .= "<div class='points'><h3 style='margin:0;'>⭐ +1 Punkt erhalten!</h3></div>";
        }
        
        $bodyHtml .= "</div>
        <div class='footer'><p style='font-size:12px; color:#888;'>Diese Nachricht wurde automatisch generiert.</p></div>
        </div></body></html>";
        
        // PHPMailer verwenden
        require_once __DIR__ . '/../../vendor/autoload.php';
        
        $mail = new \PHPMailer\PHPMailer\PHPMailer(true);
        
        try {
            // SMTP-Konfiguration
            $mail->isSMTP();
            $mail->Host       = SMTP_HOST;
            $mail->SMTPAuth   = true;
            $mail->Username   = SMTP_USER;
            $mail->Password   = SMTP_PASS;
            $mail->SMTPSecure = \PHPMailer\PHPMailer\PHPMailer::ENCRYPTION_SMTPS;
            $mail->Port       = SMTP_PORT;
            $mail->CharSet    = 'UTF-8';
            
            // IPv4 erzwingen
            $mail->SMTPOptions = [
                'socket' => [
                    'bindto' => '0.0.0.0:0'
                ]
            ];
            
            // Header
            $mail->setFrom(SMTP_FROM, SMTP_FROM_NAME);
            $mail->addAddress($user['email'], $fullName);
            $mail->addReplyTo(SMTP_FROM, SMTP_FROM_NAME);
            
            // E-Mail-Inhalt
            $mail->isHTML(true);
            $mail->Subject = $subject;
            $mail->Body = $bodyHtml;
            $mail->AltBody = $bodyText;
            
            $mail->send();
            error_log("E-Mail an Reviewer #{$reviewerId} gesendet: {$subject}");
            
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            error_log("Fehler beim E-Mail-Versand an Reviewer #{$reviewerId}: " . $mail->ErrorInfo);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Log-Eintrag in log_entries erstellen
     */
    private function addAuditLog($userId, $action, $entityId, $details) {
        try {
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                INSERT INTO log_entries 
                (user_id, type, action, entity_type, entity_id, details, created_at) 
                VALUES (?, 'audit', ?, 'review', ?, ?, NOW())
            ");
            $stmt->execute([
                $userId,
                $action,
                $entityId,
                $details
            ]);
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            error_log("Fehler beim Log-Eintrag: " . $e->getMessage());
            // Nicht durchreichen, damit der Hauptprozess weiterläuft
        }
    }
```

```php
<?php
session_start();
require_once '../../config.php';

// Installiere web-push: composer require web-push-libs/web-push
// Generiere Keys: web-push generate-vapid-keys

header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');

if (!isset($_SESSION['user_id'])) {
    http_response_code(401);
    die(json_encode(['error' => 'Nicht angemeldet']));
}

$userId = $_SESSION['user_id'];

// ===== POST /api/push.php?action=subscribe =====
// Client schickt seine Push-Subscription
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST' && $_GET['action'] === 'subscribe') {
    try {
        $data = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true);
        $subscription = $data['subscription'] ?? null;

        if (!$subscription || !isset($subscription['endpoint'])) {
            http_response_code(400);
            die(json_encode(['error' => 'Ungültige Subscription']));
        }

        // Speichere Subscription in DB
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            INSERT INTO push_subscriptions (user_id, endpoint, auth, p256dh, created_at)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, NOW())
            ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE updated_at = NOW()
        ");
        
        $stmt->execute([
            $userId,
            $subscription['endpoint'],
            $subscription['keys']['auth'] ?? '',
            $subscription['keys']['p256dh'] ?? ''
        ]);

        http_response_code(200);
```

```php
        $stmt = $db->prepare("

            GROUP BY q.id
            ORDER BY RAND()
```

```php
<?php
session_start();
require_once '../../config.php';

header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');

if (!isset($_SESSION['user_id'])) {
    http_response_code(401);
    die(json_encode(['error' => 'Nicht angemeldet']));
}

$userId = $_SESSION['user_id'];

// ===== POST /api/sync.php - Batch Sync für offline gespeicherte Antworten =====
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    try {
        $data = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true);
        $answers = $data['answers'] ?? [];

        if (!is_array($answers) || empty($answers)) {
            http_response_code(400);
            die(json_encode(['error' => 'Keine Antworten zum Synchronisieren']));
        }

        $synced = 0;
        $failed = 0;
        $errors = [];

        // Starte Transaktion
        $db->beginTransaction();

        foreach ($answers as $answer) {
            try {
                $questionId = intval($answer['question_id'] ?? 0);
                $answerId = intval($answer['answer_id'] ?? 0);
                $userRating = max(0, min(5, intval($answer['user_rating'] ?? 3)));

                if ($questionId <= 0 || $answerId <= 0) {
                    throw new Exception('Ungültige Parameter');
                }

                // Validiere Antwort
                $stmt = $db->prepare("
                    SELECT a.id, a.is_correct
                    FROM answers a
                    JOIN questions q ON a.question_id = q.id
                    JOIN question_categories qc ON q.id = qc.question_id
                    JOIN user_categories uc ON qc.category_id = uc.category_id
                    WHERE a.id = ?
                    AND a.question_id = ?
                    AND uc.user_id = ?
                ");
                $stmt->execute([$answerId, $questionId, $userId]);
                $result = $stmt->fetch();

                if (!$result) {
                    throw new Exception('Keine Berechtigung oder ungültige Antwort');
                }

                $isCorrect = (bool)$result['is_correct'];

                // Statistik updaten
                updateUserStatistics($db, $userId, $questionId, $isCorrect, $userRating);
                updateDailyPoints($db, $userId);

                $synced++;

            } catch (Exception $e) {
                $failed++;
                $errors[] = [
                    'question_id' => $answer['question_id'] ?? null,
                    'error' => $e->getMessage()
                ];
            }
        }

        $db->commit();

        http_response_code(200);
        die(json_encode([
            'success' => true,
            'synced' => $synced,
            'failed' => $failed,
            'errors' => $errors,
            'message' => "$synced Antworten synchronisiert"
        ]));

    } catch (Exception $e) {
        $db->rollBack();
        error_log('Sync Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
        http_response_code(500);
        die(json_encode(['error' => 'Synchronisierungsfehler']));
    }
}

// ===== GET /api/sync.php?action=get_pending - Unsynchronisierte Antworten abrufen =====
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'GET' && $_GET['action'] === 'get_pending') {
    try {

        http_response_code(200);
        die(json_encode([
            'message' => 'Verwende IndexedDB für lokale Daten. Sende PUT-Request zum Synchronisieren.'
        ]));

    } catch (Exception $e) {
        http_response_code(500);
        die(json_encode(['error' => 'Server-Fehler']));
    }
}

http_response_code(404);
die(json_encode(['error' => 'Endpoint nicht gefunden']));
```

```php
    if ($settings === null) {

        $settings = $stmt->fetch();
    }
    return $settings;

// Status-Farben
function getStatusBadge($status) {
    $statusMap = [
        'pending' => 'warning',
        'approved' => 'success',
        'rejected' => 'danger'
    ];
    return '<span class="badge badge-'.$statusMap[$status].'">'.ucfirst($status).'</span>';
}

// HTML Escape Helper
function e($string) {
    return htmlspecialchars($string, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
}

set_exception_handler(function($e) {
    error_log("Critical error: ".$e->getMessage());
    die("Ein kritischer Fehler ist aufgetreten");
});

function generateCsrfToken() {
    if (empty($_SESSION['csrf_token'])) {
        $_SESSION['csrf_token'] = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
    }
    return $_SESSION['csrf_token'];
}

function validateCsrfToken($token) {
    return hash_equals($_SESSION['csrf_token'] ?? '', $token);
}
```

```php
<?php
/**
 * Cronjob: Zentrale Verwaltung von Cronjobs mit zeitbasierten Ausführungen
 * Diese Datei wird nur über die Konsole aufgerufen
 */

// Sicherstellen, dass das Skript nur über die Konsole ausgeführt wird
if (php_sapi_name() !== 'cli') {
    http_response_code(403);
    die('CLI access only');
}

require __DIR__ . '/../../config.php'; // Datenbankkonfiguration
$db = new PDO(
    'mysql:host=' . DB_HOST . ';dbname=' . DB_NAME . ';charset=utf8mb4',
    DB_USER,
    DB_PASS,
    [
        PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION,
        PDO::ATTR_DEFAULT_FETCH_MODE => PDO::FETCH_ASSOC
    ]
);

// Ermitteln des Pfads zum aktuellen Verzeichnis
$scriptDirectory = __DIR__; // Das Verzeichnis, in dem sich diese Datei befindet

echo "Starte Cronjob-Verwaltung aus dem Verzeichnis: $scriptDirectory\n";

// Die Cron-Zeitpläne direkt im Code definieren
$cronSchedules = [
    'watcher.php' => '0 12 * * *',             // 12:00 Uhr jeden Tag
    'htmltags_for_pdf.php' => '30 22 * * *',    // 22:30 Uhr jeden Tag
    'trim_db.php' => '0 22 * * *',              // 22:00 Uhr jeden Tag
    'send_reminders.php' => '*/15 * * * *',     // Alle 15 Minuten
    'delete_token.php' => '0 */5 * * *',        // Alle 5 Stunden
    'cleanup_sessions.php' => '*/5 * * * *',    // Alle 5 Minuten
];

echo "Überprüfe Cronjobs mit den folgenden Zeitplänen:\n";
print_r($cronSchedules);

// Die Scripte ausführen
foreach ($cronSchedules as $script => $schedule) {
    $scriptPath = $scriptDirectory . '/' . $script;

    echo "Überprüfe Cronjob für: $script mit Zeitplan: $schedule\n";

    // Prüfe, ob das Skript bereits ausgeführt wurde
    $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT last_run FROM cron_jobs WHERE script_name = ?");
    $stmt->execute([$script]);
    $result = $stmt->fetch();

    // Wenn das Skript nicht in der Tabelle existiert, füge es hinzu
    if (!$result) {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO cron_jobs (script_name, last_run, schedule) VALUES (?, NOW(), ?)");
        $stmt->execute([$script, $schedule]);
        $lastRun = null; // Setze auf null, um das Skript sofort auszuführen
    } else {
        $lastRun = $result['last_run'];
    }

    // Wenn es Zeit ist, das Skript auszuführen
    if (shouldRunScript($lastRun, $schedule)) {
        if (file_exists($scriptPath)) {
            echo "Führe $script aus...\n";
            exec("php $scriptPath", $output, $return_var);

            if ($return_var === 0) {
                echo "[OK] $script erfolgreich ausgeführt.\n";

                // Aktualisiere die letzte Ausführungszeit
                $stmt = $db->prepare("UPDATE cron_jobs SET last_run = NOW() WHERE script_name = ?");
                $stmt->execute([$script]);
            } else {
                echo "[ERROR] Fehler beim Ausführen von $script. Rückgabewert: $return_var\n";
                echo "Ausgabe:\n" . implode("\n", $output) . "\n";
            }
        } else {
            echo "[ERROR] Das Skript $script existiert nicht im Verzeichnis.\n";
        }
    } else {
        echo "[INFO] $script muss noch nicht ausgeführt werden. Letzte Ausführung: $lastRun\n";
    }

    echo "\n";
}

/**
 * Funktion zur Überprüfung, ob das Skript ausgeführt werden muss
 * Hier wird die Logik zur Überprüfung des Zeitplans implementiert
 *
 * @param string|null $lastRun Zeit der letzten Ausführung des Skripts
 * @param string $schedule Der Zeitplan im Cron-Format
 * @return bool True, wenn das Skript ausgeführt werden muss, sonst False
 */
function shouldRunScript($lastRun, $schedule)
{
    if (!$lastRun) {
        // Wenn das Skript noch nie ausgeführt wurde, führe es sofort aus
        return true;
    }

    // Berechne die Zeit, nach der das Skript ausgeführt werden muss
    $nextRun = new DateTime($lastRun);

    // Hier erweitern wir die Logik je nach Cron-Zeitplan
    if (strpos($schedule, '*/5') !== false) {
        $nextRun->modify('+5 minutes');
    }
    if (strpos($schedule, '30 22') !== false) {
        $nextRun->modify('+1 day');  // Beispiel für täglich um 22:30 Uhr
    }

    // Weitere Logik für unterschiedliche Zeitpläne nach Bedarf hinzufügen

    $now = new DateTime();
    return $now >= $nextRun;
}
```

```php
<?php
require_once __DIR__.'/../config.php';

// Logging einrichten
$logFile = __DIR__.'/scan.log';
ini_set('error_log', $logFile);
file_put_contents($logFile, "[" . date('Y-m-d H:i:s') . "] Scan gestartet\n", FILE_APPEND);

// Performance-Optimierungen
ini_set('memory_limit', '256M');
gc_enable();

try {
    $db->exec("SET SESSION wait_timeout = 28800"); // 8 Stunden
    $db->exec("SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED");

    // Scan-Logik
    $total = $db->query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM questions")->fetchColumn();
    $batchSize = 100;
    $batches = ceil($total / $batchSize);
    
    file_put_contents($logFile, "Verarbeite $total Fragen in $batches Batches\n", FILE_APPEND);

    for ($i = 0; $i < $batches; $i++) {
        $offset = $i * $batchSize;
        
        $db->beginTransaction();
        
        // Dubletten-Check mit Progress-Logging
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            INSERT IGNORE INTO question_duplicate_checks
            SELECT q1.id, q2.id, 1
            FROM questions q1
            JOIN questions q2 
                ON q1.id < q2.id
                AND q1.soundex_text = q2.soundex_text
            WHERE q1.deleted_at IS NULL
                AND q2.deleted_at IS NULL
                AND q1.id BETWEEN ? AND ?
            ORDER BY q1.id
        ");
        
        $startId = $offset + 1;
        $endId = $offset + $batchSize;
        $stmt->execute([$startId, $endId]);
        
        $db->commit();
        
        // Fortschritt loggen
        $progress = round(($i / $batches) * 100, 2);
        file_put_contents(
            $logFile, 
            "Batch $i/$batches ($progress%) abgeschlossen\n", 
            FILE_APPEND
        );
        
        // CPU-Entlastung
        sleep(5); // 5 Sekunden Pause zwischen Batches
        gc_collect_cycles();
    }

    // Alte Dubletten aufräumen
    $db->exec("
        DELETE FROM question_duplicate_checks 
        WHERE processed_at < NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
    ");

    file_put_contents($logFile, "[" . date('Y-m-d H:i:s') . "] Scan erfolgreich\n", FILE_APPEND);

} catch (Exception $e) {
    file_put_contents(
        $logFile, 
        "FEHLER: " . $e->getMessage() . "\n" . $e->getTraceAsString() . "\n",
        FILE_APPEND
    );
}
```
