```php
    $stmt = $db->prepare("
        UPDATE users 
        SET reset_token = NULL, 
            reset_token_expiry = NULL 
        WHERE reset_token_expiry < NOW()
    ");
    $stmt->execute();
    $resetCount = $stmt->rowCount();

    // Optional: Nicht aktivierte Accounts nach 7 Tagen löschen
    if (defined('CLEANUP_INACTIVE_ACCOUNTS') && CLEANUP_INACTIVE_ACCOUNTS) {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            DELETE FROM users 
            WHERE activated = 0 
            AND created_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
        ");
        $stmt->execute();
        $inactiveCount = $stmt->rowCount();
    }

    $db->commit();

    // Logging
    $logMessage .= "Bereinigung abgeschlossen. ";
    $logMessage .= "Activation-Tokens gelöscht: $activationCount, ";
    $logMessage .= "Reset-Tokens gelöscht: $resetCount";
    
    if (isset($inactiveCount)) {
        $logMessage .= ", Inaktive Accounts gelöscht: $inactiveCount";
    }

} catch (PDOException $e) {
    $db->rollBack();
    $logMessage .= "FEHLER: " . $e->getMessage();
} finally {
    // file_put_contents($logFile, $logMessage . PHP_EOL, FILE_APPEND);
}
```

```php
<?php
// Überprüfen, ob das Skript von der Kommandozeile (CLI) aufgerufen wird
if (php_sapi_name() !== 'cli') {
    die("Dieses Skript kann nur von der Kommandozeile aus aufgerufen werden.");
}

// Absoluter Pfad zur config.php Datei
require __DIR__ . '/../../config.php';

// Funktion, um echte Zeilenumbrüche vor <ul> und <li> zu setzen
function format_html_list($text) {
    // Prüfen, ob Text HTML-Tags enthält
    if (strip_tags($text) == $text) {
        // Wenn keine HTML-Tags vorhanden sind, überspringen
        echo "Keine HTML-Tags in diesem Text: " . $text . "\n";
        return null;  // Keine Änderung vornehmen
    }

    // Vor jedem <ul> und <li> Umbrüche hinzufügen, aber nur, wenn noch nicht vorhanden
    if (strpos($text, "<ul>") !== false && strpos($text, "\n<ul>") === false) {
        $text = preg_replace('/<ul>/', "\n<ul>", $text);
    }
    if (strpos($text, "<li>") !== false && strpos($text, "\n<li>") === false) {
        $text = preg_replace('/<li>/', "\n<li>", $text);
    }

    // Entfernen von leeren Zeilen (zusätzliche Zeilenumbrüche, die durch vorherige Ersetzungen entstanden sind)
    $text = preg_replace('/\n+/', "\n", $text);

    return $text;
}

try {
    // Verbindung zur Datenbank herstellen
    $db = new PDO("mysql:host=" . DB_HOST . ";dbname=" . DB_NAME, DB_USER, DB_PASS);
    $db->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);

    // Variable für den Modus, ob alle Datensätze oder nur eine spezifische ID bearbeitet werden soll
    $use_automatic_mode = true; // true für Automatik (alle Datensätze), false für ID

    // Testweise: ID angeben, wenn der ID-Modus aktiv ist
    $id = 123; // Beispiel-ID, hier kannst du die ID setzen, wenn du nur einen Datensatz bearbeiten möchtest

    // SQL-Abfrage, um entweder alle Datensätze oder nur eine bestimmte ID zu holen
    if ($use_automatic_mode) {
        // Automatischer Modus: Alle Datensätze abfragen
        $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT id, question_text FROM questions");
    } else {
        // ID-Modus: Nur den spezifischen Datensatz abfragen
        $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT id, question_text FROM questions WHERE id = :id");
        $stmt->bindParam(':id', $id, PDO::PARAM_INT);
    }

    $stmt->execute();

    // Alle Datensätze durchgehen (oder nur der angegebene Datensatz im ID-Modus)
    while ($row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)) {
        // Formatieren des HTML-Inhalts mit echten Zeilenumbrüchen
        $formatted_text = format_html_list($row['question_text']);

        // Falls Text formatiert wurde, aktualisieren
        if ($formatted_text !== null) {
            // Die formatierte Version in der Datenbank speichern
            $update_stmt = $db->prepare("UPDATE questions SET question_text = :formatted_text WHERE id = :id");
            $update_stmt->bindParam(':formatted_text', $formatted_text, PDO::PARAM_STR);
            $update_stmt->bindParam(':id', $row['id'], PDO::PARAM_INT);
            $update_stmt->execute();

            echo "Daten für ID {$row['id']} wurden erfolgreich formatiert und aktualisiert.\n";
        }
    }

} catch (PDOException $e) {
    // Fehlerbehandlung
    error_log("Fehler: " . $e->getMessage());
    echo "Fehler: " . $e->getMessage() . "\n";
}
?>
```

```php
            $bodyHtml .= "<div class='section'>
                <div class='section-title'>✅ Antworten:</div>";
            
            foreach ($answers as $answer) {
                $isCorrect = $answer['is_correct'];
                $class = $isCorrect ? 'correct' : 'incorrect';
                $icon = $isCorrect ? '✅' : '❌';
                $label = $isCorrect ? 'RICHTIG' : 'FALSCH';
                
                $bodyHtml .= "<div class='answer $class'>
                    <span class='answer-icon'>$icon</span>
                    <span><strong>$label:</strong> " . $answer['answer_text'] . "</span>
                </div>";
            }
            
            $bodyHtml .= "</div>";
        }

        $bodyHtml .= "<p style='margin-top: 30px;'>Vielen Dank für deine Mithilfe bei der Verbesserung unserer Quiz-App! 🙏</p>
            </div>
            <div class='footer'>
                <p>Diese Nachricht wurde automatisch generiert.<br>
                Viele Grüße, dein Quiz-Team</p>
            </div>
        </div>
        </body>
        </html>";

        // Text-Version
        $bodyText = "Hallo $empfaengerName,\n\n";
        $bodyText .= "der Status deiner Meldung #$reportId wurde auf $statusText gesetzt.\n\n";
        
        if (!empty(trim($feedbackText))) {
            $bodyText .= "Feedback vom Admin:\n" . $feedbackText . "\n\n";
        }
        
        $bodyText .= "Die Frage:\n" . strip_tags($questionText) . "\n\n";
        
        if (!empty($explanationText) && $explanationText !== 'Keine Erklärung vorhanden') {
            $bodyText .= "Erklärung:\n" . $explanationText . "\n\n";
        }
        
        if (!empty($answers)) {
            $bodyText .= "Antworten:\n";
            foreach ($answers as $answer) {
                $bodyText .= ($answer['is_correct'] ? '✅ RICHTIG' : '❌ FALSCH') . ': ' . $answer['answer_text'] . "\n";
            }
            $bodyText .= "\n";
        }
        
        $bodyText .= "Vielen Dank für deine Mithilfe bei der Verbesserung unserer Quiz-App!\n\n";
        $bodyText .= "Viele Grüße\nDein Quiz-Team";

        $mail->isHTML(true);
        $mail->Body = $bodyHtml;
        $mail->AltBody = $bodyText;

        $mail->send();
        return true;

    } catch (Exception $e) {
        error_log("[MAIL ERROR] $empfaengerEmail: " . $mail->ErrorInfo);
        return false;
    }
}
```

```php
function sendEmailToAdmins($subject, $body) {
    global $db;
    try {
        $stmt = $db->query("SELECT email FROM users WHERE role = 'admin'");
        $admins = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_COLUMN);
        if (!$admins) {
            error_log("[MAIL] Keine Admins gefunden.");
            return;
        }

        $mail = new PHPMailer(true);
        $mail->isSMTP();
        $mail->Host       = SMTP_HOST;
        $mail->SMTPAuth   = true;
        $mail->Username   = SMTP_USER;
        $mail->Password   = SMTP_PASS;
        $mail->SMTPSecure = PHPMailer::ENCRYPTION_SMTPS;
        $mail->Port       = SMTP_PORT;
        $mail->CharSet    = 'UTF-8';
        $mail->setFrom(SMTP_FROM, SMTP_FROM_NAME);

        foreach ($admins as $email) {
            $mail->addAddress($email);
        }

        $mail->isHTML(true);
        $mail->Subject = $subject;
        $mail->Body    = $body;

        $mail->send();
        error_log("[MAIL OK] Report '{$subject}' gesendet an Admins.");
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        error_log("[MAIL ERROR] " . $e->getMessage());
    }
}

// ============================================================
// ✉️ Neue Frage-Einreichungen abrufen (noch nicht versendet)
// ============================================================
try {
    $stmt = $db->query("
        SELECT 
            qs.id AS submission_id,
            qs.user_id,
            u.username,
            u.email,
            q.id AS question_id,
            q.question_text,
            q.explanation,
            qc.category_id,
            c.name AS category_name,
            a.answer_text,
            a.is_correct
        FROM question_submissions qs
        INNER JOIN users u ON qs.user_id = u.id
        INNER JOIN questions q ON qs.question_id = q.id
        LEFT JOIN question_categories qc ON q.id = qc.question_id
        LEFT JOIN categories c ON qc.category_id = c.id
        LEFT JOIN answers a ON q.id = a.question_id
        WHERE qs.email_sent = 0
        ORDER BY qs.user_id, q.id, a.id
    ");

    $rows = $stmt->fetchAll();
    if (!$rows) {
        echo "[INFO] Keine neuen Einreichungen zum Versenden.\n";
        exit;
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 📦 Daten strukturieren
    // ============================================================
    $users = [];
    foreach ($rows as $r) {
        $uid = $r['user_id'];
        $qid = $r['question_id'];

        if (!isset($users[$uid])) {
            $users[$uid] = [
                'username' => $r['username'],
                'email' => $r['email'],
                'questions' => []
            ];
        }

        if (!isset($users[$uid]['questions'][$qid])) {
            $users[$uid]['questions'][$qid] = [
                'question_text' => $r['question_text'],
                'explanation' => $r['explanation'],
                'categories' => [],
                'answers' => [],
                'submission_ids' => []
            ];
        }

        if (!empty($r['category_name'])) {
            $users[$uid]['questions'][$qid]['categories'][$r['category_id']] = $r['category_name'];
        }

        $users[$uid]['questions'][$qid]['answers'][] = [
            'answer_text' => $r['answer_text'],
            'is_correct' => $r['is_correct']
        ];

        $users[$uid]['questions'][$qid]['submission_ids'][] = $r['submission_id'];
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 📧 HTML-E-Mail bauen & senden
    // ============================================================
    foreach ($users as $uid => $user) {
        $content = "<p><strong>Nutzer:</strong> {$user['username']}<br>
                    <strong>E-Mail:</strong> <a href='mailto:{$user['email']}'>{$user['email']}</a></p>";

        foreach ($user['questions'] as $qid => $q) {
            $categories = !empty($q['categories']) 
                ? implode(', ', array_unique($q['categories'])) 
                : 'Keine Kategorie';

            $content .= "<div class='question-card'>";
            $content .= "<h3>❓ {$q['question_text']}</h3>";
            $content .= "<p><strong>Kategorien:</strong> {$categories}</p>";

            if (!empty($q['explanation'])) {
                $content .= "<p><em>{$q['explanation']}</em></p>";
            }

            $content .= "<ul>";
            foreach ($q['answers'] as $a) {
                $icon = $a['is_correct'] ? '✅' : '•';
                $cls = $a['is_correct'] ? 'correct' : '';
                $content .= "<li class='{$cls}'>{$icon} {$a['answer_text']}</li>";
            }
            $content .= "</ul></div>";
        }

        $html = wrapEmailTemplate("[Neue Einreichungen] {$user['username']}", $content);
        sendEmailToAdmins("[Neue Einreichungen] {$user['username']} ({$user['email']})", $html);

        // Nach erfolgreichem Versand: Markieren
        $ids = array_unique(array_merge(...array_column($user['questions'], 'submission_ids')));
        $update = $db->prepare("UPDATE question_submissions SET email_sent = 1 WHERE id IN (" . implode(',', $ids) . ")");
        $update->execute();
    }

    echo "[OK] Alle neuen Einreichungen verarbeitet und markiert.\n";
} catch (PDOException $e) {
    error_log("[DB ERROR] " . $e->getMessage());
    echo "[ERROR] DB-Fehler: " . $e->getMessage() . "\n";
    exit(1);

function wrapEmailTemplate($title, $contentHtml) {
    $style = "
        body { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background:#f7f9fb; color:#333; margin:0; padding:0; }
        .wrapper { max-width:700px; margin:20px auto; background:#fff; border-radius:8px;
                box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); overflow:hidden; }
        .header { background:#0d6efd; color:#fff; padding:18px 25px; }
        .header h1 { margin:0; font-size:20px; }
        .content { padding:25px; line-height:1.6; }
        .question-card { border:1px solid #e0e6ef; border-radius:6px; padding:15px 20px; margin-bottom:20px; }
        .question-card h3 { margin-top:0; color:#0d6efd; }
        ul { list-style:none; padding-left:0; margin:0; }
        li.correct { color:#198754; font-weight:bold; }
        .footer { background:#f0f4f8; padding:15px 25px; font-size:13px; color:#666; text-align:center; }
        a { color:#0d6efd; text-decoration:none; }
    ";

    return "
    <html>
    <head><meta charset='UTF-8'><style>{$style}</style></head>
    <body>
        <div class='wrapper'>
            <div class='header'><h1>{$title}</h1></div>
            <div class='content'>{$contentHtml}</div>
            <div class='footer'>Diese Nachricht wurde automatisch vom Quiz-Watcher gesendet.</div>
        </div>
    </body>
    </html>";
}
```

```php
// Überprüfen, ob das Skript von der Kommandozeile (CLI) aufgerufen wird
if (php_sapi_name() !== 'cli') {
    die("Dieses Skript kann nur von der Kommandozeile aus aufgerufen werden.");
}

// Absoluter Pfad zur config.php Datei
require __DIR__ . '/../../config.php';

// Funktion um führende und endende Leerzeichen in einem Textstring zu entfernen
// Diese werden beispielsweise nicht bei der Eingabe abgefangen oder beim Import.

try {
    // Verbindung zur Datenbank herstellen
    $db = new PDO("mysql:host=" . DB_HOST . ";dbname=" . DB_NAME, DB_USER, DB_PASS);
    $db->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);

    // TRIM answers
    $update_stmt = $db->prepare("UPDATE answers SET answer_text = TRIM(answer_text)");
    $update_stmt->execute();
    echo "Trim answer_text abgeschlossen\n";

    // TRIM questions
    $update_stmt = $db->prepare("UPDATE questions SET question_text = TRIM(question_text), explanation = TRIM(explanation)");
    $update_stmt->execute();
    echo "Trim question_text und explanation abgeschlossen\n";

    // TRIM categories
    $update_stmt = $db->prepare("UPDATE categories SET name = TRIM(name)");
    $update_stmt->execute();
    echo "Trim categories abgeschlossen\n";

} catch (PDOException $e) {
    // Fehlerbehandlung
    error_log("Fehler bei der Verarbeitung: " . $e->getMessage());
    echo "Fehler: " . $e->getMessage() . "\n";
}

?>
```

```php
function updateMedianForAllUsers($db) {

        $medianTime = calculateMedianAnswerTime($db, $userId);

        if ($medianTime !== null) {
```

```php
    $stmt = $db->query("

    // Mehr als 5 Antworten
    $stmt = $db->query("

        FROM answers
        GROUP BY question_id
        HAVING answer_count > 5
    ");
    $tooManyAnswers = $stmt->fetchAll();

    // Keine richtige Antwort
    $stmt = $db->query("

        FROM answers
        WHERE question_id NOT IN (

        )
    ");
    $noCorrect = $stmt->fetchAll();

        $html .= "<h4>Mehrfache richtige Antworten</h4><ul>";
        foreach ($multiCorrect as $q) {
            $html .= "<li>Frage ID {$q['question_id']} – {$q['count_correct']}x is_correct = 1</li>";
        }
        $html .= "</ul>";
    }
    if ($tooManyAnswers) {
        $html .= "<h4>Mehr als 5 Antworten</h4><ul>";
        foreach ($tooManyAnswers as $q) {
            $html .= "<li>Frage ID {$q['question_id']} – {$q['answer_count']} Antworten</li>";

        $html .= "</ul>";
    }
    if ($noCorrect) {

            $html .= "<li>Frage ID {$q['question_id']}</li>";
        }
        $html .= "</ul>";
    }

try {
    $stmt = $db->query("

        FROM user_daily_points
        WHERE last_answered IS NOT NULL
    ");
    $users = $stmt->fetchAll();

    $now = new DateTime();
    $resetCount = 0;
    $resetUserIds = [];

    foreach ($users as $u) {
        $last = new DateTime($u['last_answered']);
        if ($now->getTimestamp() - $last->getTimestamp() > 86400) {
            $update = $db->prepare("
                UPDATE user_daily_points
                SET current_points = 0,
                    streak = 0,
                    email_sent_12h = 0,
                    email_sent_2h = 0,
                    email_sent_reset_warning = 0
                WHERE user_id = :user_id
                AND (current_points != 0 OR streak != 0)
            ");
            $update->execute(['user_id' => $u['user_id']]);
            if ($update->rowCount() > 0) {
                $resetCount++;
                $resetUserIds[] = $u['user_id'];
            }
        }
    }

    $html = "<h3>Punkte und Streak Reset</h3><p>{$resetCount} Nutzer zurückgesetzt.</p>";
    if ($resetCount > 0) {
        $html .= "<ul>";
        foreach ($resetUserIds as $id) {
            $html .= "<li>User ID {$id}</li>";
        }
        $html .= "</ul>";
    }
    $report[] = $html;

    echo "[" . date('Y-m-d H:i:s') . "] Watcher: {$resetCount} Nutzer zurückgesetzt.\n";
} catch (PDOException $e) {
    $errorReport[] = "[Watcher Reset] " . $e->getMessage();
}

   📨 5. Abschluss-Mail mit gesamtem Report
============================================================ */
$subject = "[Watcher Report] " . date('Y-m-d H:i');

if (!empty($report)) {
```

```php
                $_SESSION['user_id'] = $user['id'];
                $_SESSION['username'] = $user['username'];
                $_SESSION['user_role'] = $user['role'];
                $_SESSION['user_ip'] = $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'];
                $_SESSION['user_agent'] = $_SERVER['HTTP_USER_AGENT'];

                // Letzten Login aktualisieren
                $update_stmt = $db->prepare("UPDATE users SET last_login = NOW(), logged_in = 1 WHERE id = ?");
                $update_stmt->execute([$user['id']]);

                $db->commit();
                header('Location: index.php');
                exit();
            }
        } else {
            $message = 'Ungültige Anmeldedaten';
            $db->rollBack();
        }
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        // Transaktion zurückrollen
        if (isset($db) && $db->inTransaction()) $db->rollBack();
        error_log("Datenbankfehler: " . $e->getMessage());
        $message = 'Bitte haben Sie einen Moment Geduld...';
        header("Refresh: 1"); // Auto-Retry
    }
}
?>
```

```php
<?php
ini_set('display_errors', 1);
ini_set('display_startup_errors', 1);

        DB_USER,
        DB_PASS
    );
    $db->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);
    $db->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES, false);
} catch (PDOException $e) {
    die("<div class='alert alert-danger'>Datenbankverbindung fehlgeschlagen: " . htmlspecialchars($e->getMessage()) . "</div>");
}

// Berechtigungsprüfung
checkUserRole(ROLE_ADMIN);

$reviewSystem = new QuestionReviewSystem($db);

// CSRF-Token Handling
if (empty($_SESSION['csrf_token'])) {
    $_SESSION['csrf_token'] = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
}

// Funktionen
function getReportsByStatus($db, $statuses) {
    try {
        $placeholders = str_repeat('?,', count($statuses) - 1) . '?';
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            SELECT r.id, r.question_id, r.user_id, r.report_type,
                   r.details, r.created_at, r.status, r.feedback,
                   u.first_name, u.last_name,
                   qr.id as review_id, qr.status as review_status, qr.reviewer_id,
                   rev.first_name as reviewer_first_name, rev.last_name as reviewer_last_name
            FROM reports r
            LEFT JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id
            LEFT JOIN question_reviews qr ON r.id = qr.report_id
            LEFT JOIN users rev ON qr.reviewer_id = rev.id
            WHERE r.status IN ($placeholders)
            ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
        ");
        $stmt->execute($statuses);
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("getReportsByStatus Fehler: " . $e->getMessage());
        return [];
    }
}

function updateReportStatus($db, $reportId, $status, $feedback) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            UPDATE reports
            SET status = :status,
                feedback = :feedback
            WHERE id = :id
        ");
        $stmt->execute([
            ':status' => $status,
            ':feedback' => trim($feedback),
            ':id' => $reportId
        ]);
        return $stmt->rowCount() > 0;
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("UpdateReportStatus Fehler ID $reportId: " . $e->getMessage());
        return false;
    }
}

// POST-Handler
$message = '';
$validStatuses = ['open', 'in_pool', 'in_progress', 'resolved', 'rejected'];

// Handler für Fragen-Vorschau
if (isset($_GET['action']) && $_GET['action'] === 'get_question') {
    if (!isset($_GET['csrf_token']) || !hash_equals($_SESSION['csrf_token'], $_GET['csrf_token'])) {
        die(json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Ungültige Anfrage']));
    }
    
    header('Content-Type: application/json');
    
    $questionId = filter_input(INPUT_GET, 'question_id', FILTER_VALIDATE_INT);
    if (!$questionId) {
        die(json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Ungültige Fragen-ID']));
    }
    
    try {
        // Hole Frage
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            SELECT q.id, q.question_text, q.explanation, q.created_at, q.updated_at
            FROM questions q
            WHERE q.id = ?
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$questionId]);
        $question = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        
        if (!$question) {
            die(json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Frage nicht gefunden']));
        }
        
        // Hole alle Kategorien für diese Frage
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            SELECT c.id, c.name
            FROM question_categories qc
            JOIN categories c ON qc.category_id = c.id
            WHERE qc.question_id = ?
            ORDER BY c.name
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$questionId]);
        $question['categories'] = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        
        // Hole Antworten
        $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT answer_text, is_correct FROM answers WHERE question_id = ? ORDER BY id");
        $stmt->execute([$questionId]);
        $question['answers'] = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        
        // Hole alle Meldungen zu dieser Frage
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            SELECT r.id, r.report_type, r.details, r.status, r.feedback, r.created_at,
                   u.first_name, u.last_name
            FROM reports r
            LEFT JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id
            WHERE r.question_id = ?
            ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$questionId]);
        $question['reports'] = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        
        // Hole Log-Einträge für diese Frage (über Reviews)
        try {
            $stmt = $db->prepare("
                SELECT l.action, l.details, l.created_at, u.first_name, u.last_name
                FROM log_entries l
                LEFT JOIN users u ON l.user_id = u.id
                LEFT JOIN question_reviews qr ON l.entity_type = 'review' AND l.entity_id = qr.id
                LEFT JOIN reports r ON qr.report_id = r.id
                WHERE r.question_id = ?
                ORDER BY l.created_at DESC
                LIMIT 20
            ");
            $stmt->execute([$questionId]);
            $question['logs'] = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        } catch (PDOException $e) {
            error_log("Log-Abfrage Fehler für Frage $questionId: " . $e->getMessage());
            $question['logs'] = [];
        }
        
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'question' => $question]);
        exit;
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        error_log("get_question Fehler: " . $e->getMessage() . " | Trace: " . $e->getTraceAsString());
        die(json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Datenbankfehler: ' . $e->getMessage()]));
    }
}

// Handler für Review-Aktionen (approve, reject, question)
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST' && isset($_POST['review_action'])) {
    if (!isset($_POST['csrf_token']) || !hash_equals($_SESSION['csrf_token'], $_POST['csrf_token'])) {
        http_response_code(403);
        die(json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Ungültige Anfrage (CSRF-Token fehlt oder ungültig)']));
    }
    
    header('Content-Type: application/json');
    
    try {
        switch ($_POST['review_action']) {
            case 'approve':
                $result = $reviewSystem->approveReview($_POST['review_id'], $_SESSION['user_id']);
                echo json_encode($result);
                exit;
                
            case 'reject':
                $result = $reviewSystem->rejectReview(
                    $_POST['review_id'], 
                    $_SESSION['user_id'], 
                    $_POST['feedback']
                );
                echo json_encode($result);
                exit;
                
            case 'question':
                $result = $reviewSystem->sendQuestionToReviewer(
                    $_POST['review_id'], 
                    $_SESSION['user_id'], 
                    $_POST['question']
                );
                echo json_encode($result);
                exit;
                
            default:
                throw new Exception('Unbekannte Review-Aktion: ' . $_POST['review_action']);
        }
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        http_response_code(500);
        error_log("Review-Aktion Fehler: " . $e->getMessage());
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Serverfehler: ' . $e->getMessage()]);
        exit;
    }
}

// Handler für "In Pool verschieben"
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST' && isset($_POST['move_to_pool'])) {
    if (!isset($_POST['csrf_token']) || !hash_equals($_SESSION['csrf_token'], $_POST['csrf_token'])) {
        die("Ungültige Anfrage");
    }

    $reportId = filter_input(INPUT_POST, 'report_id', FILTER_VALIDATE_INT);
    
    if (!$reportId) {
        $message = '<div class="alert alert-danger">Ungültige Report-ID</div>';
    } else {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT status FROM reports WHERE id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$reportId]);
        $report = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        
        if (!$report) {
            $_SESSION['message'] = ['type' => 'danger', 'text' => 'Meldung nicht gefunden'];
        } elseif ($report['status'] !== 'open') {
            $_SESSION['message'] = ['type' => 'warning', 'text' => 'Nur offene Meldungen können in den Pool verschoben werden'];
        } else {
            if (updateReportStatus($db, $reportId, 'in_pool', '')) {
                $_SESSION['message'] = ['type' => 'success', 'text' => 'Meldung erfolgreich in den Pool verschoben'];
            } else {
                $_SESSION['message'] = ['type' => 'danger', 'text' => 'Fehler beim Verschieben in den Pool'];
            }
        }
        header("Location: " . htmlspecialchars($_SERVER['PHP_SELF']));
        exit;
    }
}

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST' && isset($_POST['update_status'])) {
    if (!isset($_POST['csrf_token']) || !hash_equals($_SESSION['csrf_token'], $_POST['csrf_token'])) {
        die("Ungültige Anfrage");
    }

    $reportId = filter_input(INPUT_POST, 'report_id', FILTER_VALIDATE_INT);
    $status = filter_input(INPUT_POST, 'status', FILTER_SANITIZE_SPECIAL_CHARS);
    $feedback = filter_input(INPUT_POST, 'feedback', FILTER_SANITIZE_SPECIAL_CHARS);

    if (!$reportId || !in_array($status, $validStatuses)) {
        $message = '<div class="alert alert-danger">Ungültige Eingabewerte</div>';
    } else {
        if (updateReportStatus($db, $reportId, $status, $feedback)) {
            // E-Mail nur senden, wenn Feedback vorhanden ist und Status 'resolved' oder 'rejected' ist
            if (!empty(trim($feedback)) && ($status === 'resolved' || $status === 'rejected')) {
                $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT u.email, u.first_name, u.last_name FROM reports r LEFT JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.id = :report_id");
                $stmt->execute([':report_id' => $reportId]);
                $reportUserData = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

                if ($reportUserData && isset($reportUserData['email'])) {
                    $empfaengerEmail = $reportUserData['email'];
                    $empfaengerName = $reportUserData['first_name'] . ' ' . $reportUserData['last_name'];

                    if (sendReportFeedbackEmail($empfaengerEmail, $empfaengerName, $reportId, trim($feedback), $status)) {
                        $_SESSION['message'] = ['type' => 'success', 'text' => 'Status aktualisiert und E-Mail gesendet'];
                    } else {
                        $_SESSION['message'] = ['type' => 'warning', 'text' => 'Status aktualisiert, aber E-Mail-Versand fehlgeschlagen'];
                        error_log("Fehler beim Senden der Feedback-E-Mail für Report ID $reportId an " . $empfaengerEmail);
                    }
                } else {
                    $_SESSION['message'] = ['type' => 'warning', 'text' => 'Status aktualisiert, aber E-Mail-Adresse nicht gefunden'];
                    error_log("E-Mail-Adresse für Report ID $reportId nicht gefunden.");
                }
            } else {
                $_SESSION['message'] = ['type' => 'success', 'text' => 'Status erfolgreich aktualisiert'];
            }
            header("Location: " . htmlspecialchars($_SERVER['PHP_SELF']));
            exit;
        } else {
            $message = '<div class="alert alert-danger">Aktualisierung fehlgeschlagen</div>';
        }
    }
}

// Session-Nachrichten
if (isset($_SESSION['message'])) {
    $message = '<div class="alert alert-' . htmlspecialchars($_SESSION['message']['type']) . ' alert-dismissible fade show" role="alert">'
             . '<i class="fas fa-' . (strpos($_SESSION['message']['type'], 'success') !== false ? 'check-circle' : (strpos($_SESSION['message']['type'], 'warning') !== false ? 'exclamation-circle' : 'times-circle')) . '"></i> '
             . htmlspecialchars($_SESSION['message']['text'])
             . '<button type="button" class="close" data-dismiss="alert">&times;</button></div>';
    unset($_SESSION['message']);
}

// Lade Reports nach Status
$openReports = getReportsByStatus($db, ['open']);
$poolReports = getReportsByStatus($db, ['in_pool', 'in_review', 'in_progress']);
$resolvedReports = getReportsByStatus($db, ['resolved']);
$rejectedReports = getReportsByStatus($db, ['rejected']);

// Hole alle pending Reviews für Modals

                        <i class="fas fa-times"></i> Ablehnen
                    </button>
                </div>

        </div>

    <div class="modal fade" id="questionModal" tabindex="-1">
        <div class="modal-dialog">
            <div class="modal-content">
                <div class="modal-header">
                    <h5 class="modal-title"><i class="fas fa-question-circle text-warning"></i> Rückfrage an Reviewer</h5>
                    <button type="button" class="close" data-dismiss="modal">&times;</button>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-body">
                    <p>Stelle eine Frage oder fordere Anpassungen an:</p>
                    <textarea id="questionText" class="form-control" rows="5" placeholder="Deine Frage oder Anmerkung..."></textarea>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-footer">
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" data-dismiss="modal">Abbrechen</button>
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-warning" onclick="submitQuestion()">
                        <i class="fas fa-paper-plane"></i> Rückfrage senden
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    
    <script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.6.0.min.js"></script>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@4.6.2/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
    <script src="https://cdn.datatables.net/1.13.6/js/jquery.dataTables.min.js"></script>
    <script src="https://cdn.datatables.net/1.13.6/js/dataTables.bootstrap4.min.js"></script>
    <script>
    let currentReviewId = null;
    const csrfToken = '<?= $_SESSION['csrf_token'] ?>';
    const reviewsData = <?= json_encode($pendingReviews) ?>;
    
    $(document).ready(function() {
        $('.report-table').DataTable({
            language: { url: '//cdn.datatables.net/plug-ins/1.13.6/i18n/de-DE.json' },
            columnDefs: [{ targets: -1, orderable: false, searchable: false }],
            pageLength: 25,
            order: [[0, 'desc']]
        });
    });
    
    function showReviewDetails(reviewId) {
        const review = reviewsData.find(r => r.id == reviewId);
        if (!review) {
            alert('Review-Daten nicht gefunden');
            return;
        }
        
        const reviewerName = review.reviewer_first_name + ' ' + review.reviewer_last_name;
        const reporterName = review.reporter_first_name + ' ' + review.reporter_last_name;
        
        let html = `
            <div class="question-id-badge mb-3">
                <i class="fas fa-question-circle"></i> Frage-ID: ${review.question_id}
            </div>
            <div class="alert alert-warning">
                <strong><i class="fas fa-flag"></i> Ursprüngliche Meldung:</strong><br>
                <strong>Von:</strong> ${escapeHtml(reporterName)}<br>
                <strong>Details:</strong> ${escapeHtml(review.report_details).replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}
            </div>
        `;
        
        if (review.reviewer_note) {
            html += `<div class="info-box"><strong><i class="fas fa-comment"></i> Bemerkung des Reviewers:</strong><br>
                ${escapeHtml(review.reviewer_note).replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}</div>`;
        }
        
        if (review.reviewer_feedback) {
            html += `<div class="alert alert-info"><strong><i class="fas fa-envelope"></i> Vorgeschlagenes Feedback an Melder:</strong><br>
                ${escapeHtml(review.reviewer_feedback).replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}</div>`;
        }
        
        if (review.source) {
            html += `<div class="source-box"><strong><i class="fas fa-book"></i> Quelle:</strong><br>
                ${escapeHtml(review.source).replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}`;
            if (review.source_note) {
                html += `<hr><strong><i class="fas fa-info-circle"></i> Erklärung zur Quelle:</strong><br>
                    ${escapeHtml(review.source_note).replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}`;
            }
            html += `</div>`;
        }
        
        html += `
            <h6 class="mt-4 mb-3"><i class="fas fa-exchange-alt"></i> Vergleich der Versionen:</h6>
            <table class="comparison-table table table-bordered">
                <thead>
                    <tr>
                        <th class="current-version"><i class="fas fa-file-alt"></i> Aktuelle Version</th>
                        <th class="proposed-version"><i class="fas fa-file-import"></i> Vorgeschlagene Änderung</th>
                    </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                    <tr>
                        <td class="current-version"><strong>Frage:</strong><br>
                            ${escapeHtml(review.current_question).replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}</td>
                        <td class="proposed-version"><strong>Frage:</strong><br>
                            ${escapeHtml(review.proposed_question_text).replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}</td>
                    </tr>
                    <tr>
                        <td class="current-version"><strong>Erklärung:</strong><br>
                            ${review.current_explanation ? escapeHtml(review.current_explanation).replace(/\n/g, '<br>') : '<em class="text-muted">Keine Erklärung</em>'}</td>
                        <td class="proposed-version"><strong>Erklärung:</strong><br>
                            ${review.proposed_explanation ? escapeHtml(review.proposed_explanation).replace(/\n/g, '<br>') : '<em class="text-muted">Keine Erklärung</em>'}</td>
                    </tr>
                    <tr>
                        <td class="current-version"><strong>Antworten:</strong><br>
                            ${review.current_answers.map(a => 
                                `<div class="answer-badge ${a.is_correct ? 'answer-correct' : 'answer-incorrect'}">
                                    ${a.is_correct ? '✅ RICHTIG' : '❌ FALSCH'}: ${escapeHtml(a.answer_text)}
                                </div><br>`
                            ).join('')}</td>
                        <td class="proposed-version"><strong>Antworten:</strong><br>
                            ${review.proposed_answers_decoded.map(a => 
                                `<div class="answer-badge ${a.is_correct ? 'answer-correct' : 'answer-incorrect'}">
                                    ${a.is_correct ? '✅ RICHTIG' : '❌ FALSCH'}: ${escapeHtml(a.answer_text)}
                                </div><br>`
                            ).join('')}</td>
                    </tr>
                </tbody>
            </table>
            <div class="text-center mt-4">
                <button class="btn btn-success btn-lg" onclick="approveReview(${reviewId})">
                    <i class="fas fa-check"></i> Genehmigen & Übernehmen
                </button>
                <button class="btn btn-warning btn-lg" onclick="openQuestionModal(${reviewId})">
                    <i class="fas fa-question"></i> Rückfrage stellen
                </button>
                <button class="btn btn-danger btn-lg" onclick="openRejectModal(${reviewId})">
                    <i class="fas fa-times"></i> Ablehnen
                </button>
            </div>
        `;
        
        $('#reviewModalBody').html(html);
        $('#reviewModal').modal('show');
    }
    
    function approveReview(reviewId) {
        if (!confirm('Änderungen genehmigen und Frage aktualisieren?\n\n✓ Die Frage wird übernommen\n✓ Der Reviewer erhält +1 Punkt')) return;
        
        $('#reviewModal').modal('hide');
        
        $.post('', { review_action: 'approve', review_id: reviewId, csrf_token: csrfToken })
        .done(function(data) {
            if (data.success) { alert('✅ ' + data.message); location.reload(); }
            else { alert('❌ Fehler: ' + data.message); }
        })
        .fail(function(xhr, status, error) {
            console.error('Fehlerdetails:', xhr.responseText);
            alert('❌ Netzwerkfehler: ' + error);
        });
    }
    
    function openRejectModal(reviewId) {
        currentReviewId = reviewId;
        $('#reviewModal').modal('hide');
        $('#rejectFeedback').val('');
        $('#rejectModal').modal('show');
    }
    
    function submitReject() {
        const feedback = $('#rejectFeedback').val().trim();
        if (!feedback) { alert('Bitte gib eine Begründung ein'); return; }
        
        $.post('', { review_action: 'reject', review_id: currentReviewId, feedback: feedback, csrf_token: csrfToken })
        .done(function(data) {
            if (data.success) { alert('✅ ' + data.message); location.reload(); }
            else { alert('❌ Fehler: ' + data.message); }
        })
        .fail(function(xhr, status, error) {
            console.error('Fehlerdetails:', xhr.responseText);
            alert('❌ Netzwerkfehler: ' + error);
        });
    }
    
    function openQuestionModal(reviewId) {
        currentReviewId = reviewId;
        $('#reviewModal').modal('hide');
        $('#questionText').val('');
        $('#questionModal').modal('show');
    }
    
    function submitQuestion() {
        const question = $('#questionText').val().trim();
        if (!question) { alert('Bitte gib eine Frage ein'); return; }
        
        $.post('', { review_action: 'question', review_id: currentReviewId, question: question, csrf_token: csrfToken })
        .done(function(data) {
            if (data.success) { alert('✅ ' + data.message); location.reload(); }
            else { alert('❌ Fehler: ' + data.message); }
        })
        .fail(function(xhr, status, error) {
            console.error('Fehlerdetails:', xhr.responseText);
            alert('❌ Netzwerkfehler: ' + error);
        });
    }
    
    function escapeHtml(text) {
        const map = { '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#039;' };
        return String(text).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function(m) { return map[m]; });
    }
    
    function showQuestionPreview(questionId) {
        $('#questionPreviewBody').html('<div class="text-center"><i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin fa-2x"></i><br>Laden...</div>');
        $('#editQuestionLink').attr('href', 'edit_question.php?id=' + questionId);
        $('#questionPreviewModal').modal('show');
        
        const reportTypeLabels = {
            'suggestion': 'Verbesserungsvorschlag',
            'typo': 'Rechtschreibfehler',
            'wrong_answer': 'Falsche Antwort',
            'wrong_question': 'Falsche Frage'
        };
        
        const statusLabels = {
            'open': '<span class="badge badge-warning">Offen</span>',
            'in_pool': '<span class="badge badge-info">Im Pool</span>',
            'in_progress': '<span class="badge badge-primary">In Bearbeitung</span>',
            'in_review': '<span class="badge badge-primary">In Review</span>',
            'resolved': '<span class="badge badge-success">Erledigt</span>',
            'rejected': '<span class="badge badge-danger">Verworfen</span>'
        };
        
        $.get('', { action: 'get_question', question_id: questionId, csrf_token: csrfToken })
        .done(function(data) {
            if (data.success) {
                const q = data.question;
                let html = `
                    <div class="row">
                        <div class="col-md-6">
                            <div class="question-id-badge mb-3">
                                <i class="fas fa-question-circle"></i> Frage-ID: ${questionId}
                            </div>
                `;
                
                if (q.categories && q.categories.length > 0) {
                    html += `<div class="mb-3">`;
                    q.categories.forEach(function(cat) {
                        html += `<span class="category-badge"><i class="fas fa-folder"></i> ${escapeHtml(cat.name)}</span>`;
                    });
                    html += `</div>`;
                }
                
                html += `
                            <div class="question-box">
                                <h6><strong>Frage:</strong></h6>
                                <p>${escapeHtml(q.question_text).replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}</p>
                `;
                
                if (q.explanation) {
                    html += `
                        <hr>
                        <h6><strong>Erklärung:</strong></h6>
                        <p>${escapeHtml(q.explanation).replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}</p>
                    `;
                }
                
                html += `</div><h6 class="mt-3"><strong>Antworten:</strong></h6>`;
                
                q.answers.forEach(function(answer) {
                    html += `
                        <div class="answer-item ${answer.is_correct ? 'correct' : 'incorrect'}">
                            <span style="font-size: 20px;">${answer.is_correct ? '✅' : '❌'}</span>
                            <span><strong>${answer.is_correct ? 'RICHTIG' : 'FALSCH'}:</strong> ${escapeHtml(answer.answer_text)}</span>
                        </div>
                    `;
                });
                
                html += `
                            <div class="mt-3">
                                <small class="text-muted">
                                    <i class="fas fa-clock"></i> Erstellt: ${formatDate(q.created_at)}<br>
                                    <i class="fas fa-edit"></i> Aktualisiert: ${formatDate(q.updated_at)}
                                </small>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="col-md-6">
                            <h6><i class="fas fa-flag"></i> Meldungen (${q.reports.length})</h6>
                `;
                
                if (q.reports.length === 0) {
                    html += '<div class="alert alert-info"><small>Keine Meldungen vorhanden</small></div>';
                } else {
                    q.reports.forEach(function(report) {
                        html += `
                            <div class="report-item">
                                <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-start mb-2">
                                    <div>
                                        <strong>${reportTypeLabels[report.report_type] || report.report_type}</strong>
                                        ${statusLabels[report.status] || report.status}
                                    </div>
                                    <small class="text-muted">#${report.id}</small>
                                </div>
                                <div><strong>Von:</strong> ${escapeHtml(report.first_name + ' ' + report.last_name)}</div>
                                <div><strong>Details:</strong> ${escapeHtml(report.details).replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}</div>
                        `;
                        
                        if (report.feedback) {
                            html += `<div class="mt-2"><strong>Feedback:</strong> ${escapeHtml(report.feedback)}</div>`;
                        }
                        
                        html += `<small class="text-muted">${formatDate(report.created_at)}</small></div>`;
                    });
                }
                
                html += `<h6 class="mt-4"><i class="fas fa-history"></i> Aktivitätsverlauf</h6>`;
                
                if (q.logs.length === 0) {
                    html += '<div class="alert alert-info"><small>Keine Aktivitäten vorhanden</small></div>';
                } else {
                    q.logs.forEach(function(log) {
                        const userName = log.first_name && log.last_name ? escapeHtml(log.first_name + ' ' + log.last_name) : 'System';
                        html += `<div class="log-item"><small><strong>${formatDate(log.created_at)}</strong> · ${userName} · ${escapeHtml(log.details || log.action)}</small></div>`;
                    });
                }
                
                html += `</div></div>`;
                $('#questionPreviewBody').html(html);
            } else {
                $('#questionPreviewBody').html('<div class="alert alert-danger">Fehler beim Laden: ' + escapeHtml(data.message) + '</div>');
            }
        })
        .fail(function() {
            $('#questionPreviewBody').html('<div class="alert alert-danger">Netzwerkfehler beim Laden der Frage</div>');
        });
    }
    
    function formatDate(dateStr) {
        if (!dateStr) return '-';
        const d = new Date(dateStr);
        return d.toLocaleDateString('de-DE') + ' ' + d.toLocaleTimeString('de-DE', {hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit'});
    }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

<?php
function renderReportTable($reports, $tableId, $csrfToken) {
    $icons = [
        'suggestion' => 'fas fa-lightbulb',
        'typo' => 'fas fa-font',
        'wrong_answer' => 'fas fa-times-circle',
        'wrong_question' => 'fas fa-question-circle'
    ];
    
    $descriptions = [
        'suggestion' => 'Verbesserungsvorschlag',
        'typo' => 'Rechtschreibfehler',
        'wrong_answer' => 'Falsche Antwort',
        'wrong_question' => 'Falsche Frage'
    ];
    
    $iconColors = [
        'suggestion' => 'text-warning',
```

```php
function isPasswordStrong($password) {
    return (strlen($password) >= 12 &&
            preg_match('/[A-Z]/', $password) &&
            preg_match('/[a-z]/', $password) &&
            preg_match('/[0-9]/', $password) &&

    <script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        const passwordInput = document.getElementById('new_password');
        const confirmPasswordInput = document.getElementById('confirm_password');
        const submitButton = document.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
        const strengthMeter = document.querySelector('#password-strength-meter .progress-bar');

        function checkPasswordStrength(password) {
            let strength = 0;
            if (password.length >= 12) strength += 1;
            if (/[A-Z]/.test(password)) strength += 1;
            if (/[a-z]/.test(password)) strength += 1;
            if (/[0-9]/.test(password)) strength += 1;
            if (/[^A-Za-z0-9]/.test(password)) strength += 1;
            return strength;
        }

        function updatePasswordStrength() {
            const password = passwordInput.value;
            const strength = checkPasswordStrength(password);
            
            strengthMeter.style.width = `${strength * 20}%`;
            
            if (strength < 3) {
                strengthMeter.className = 'progress-bar bg-danger';
            } else if (strength < 5) {
                strengthMeter.className = 'progress-bar bg-warning';
            } else {
                strengthMeter.className = 'progress-bar bg-success';
            }

            submitButton.disabled = strength < 5 || password !== confirmPasswordInput.value;
        }

        passwordInput.addEventListener('input', updatePasswordStrength);
        confirmPasswordInput.addEventListener('input', updatePasswordStrength);
    });
    </script>
```

```php
<?php
require_once 'config.php';

// Funktion zum Erstellen einer neuen Frage
function createQuestion($db, $questionText, $explanation, $categoryIds, $answers) {
    $db->beginTransaction();
    
    try {
        // Frage einfügen
        $stmt = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO questions (question_text, explanation) VALUES (?, ?)");
        $stmt->execute([$questionText, $explanation]);
        $questionId = $db->lastInsertId();
        
        // Kategorien zuordnen
        $stmt = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO question_categories (question_id, category_id) VALUES (?, ?)");
        foreach ($categoryIds as $categoryId) {
            $stmt->execute([$questionId, $categoryId]);
        }
        
        // Antworten einfügen
        $stmt = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO answers (question_id, answer_text, is_correct) VALUES (?, ?, ?)");
        foreach ($answers as $answer) {
            $stmt->execute([$questionId, $answer['text'], $answer['isCorrect']]);
        }
        
        $db->commit();
        return true;
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        $db->rollBack();
        error_log("Fehler beim Erstellen der Frage: " . $e->getMessage());
        return false;
    }
}

// Funktion zum Abrufen zufälliger Fragen aus bestimmten Kategorien
function getRandomQuestions($db, $categoryIds, $limit) {
    $placeholders = implode(',', array_fill(0, count($categoryIds), '?'));
    
    try {
        $sql = "
            SELECT DISTINCT q.id, q.question_text, q.explanation,
                   GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT qc.category_id ORDER BY qc.category_id ASC SEPARATOR ',') AS category_ids,
                   GROUP_CONCAT(a.id, ':::', a.answer_text, ':::', a.is_correct SEPARATOR '|||') as answers
            FROM questions q
            JOIN question_categories qc ON q.id = qc.question_id
            JOIN answers a ON q.id = a.question_id
            WHERE qc.category_id IN ($placeholders)
            GROUP BY q.id
            ORDER BY RAND()
            LIMIT ?
        ";
        
        $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
        $params = array_merge($categoryIds, [$limit]);
        $stmt->execute($params);
        
        $questions = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        
        // Antworten aufbereiten
        foreach ($questions as &$question) {
            $answersRaw = explode('|||', $question['answers']);
            $question['answers'] = [];
            foreach ($answersRaw as $answerRaw) {
                list($id, $text, $isCorrect) = explode(':::', $answerRaw);
                $question['answers'][] = [
                    'id' => $id,
                    'text' => $text,
                    'isCorrect' => $isCorrect
                ];
            }
            unset($question['answers']); // Entfernen des ursprünglichen String-Formats
        }
        
        return $questions;
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        error_log("Fehler beim Abrufen zufälliger Fragen: " . $e->getMessage());
        return [];
    }
}

// Funktion zum Aktualisieren einer bestehenden Frage
function updateQuestion($db, $questionId, $questionText, $explanation, $categoryIds, $answers) {
    $db->beginTransaction();
    
    try {
        // Frage aktualisieren
        $stmt = $db->prepare("UPDATE questions SET question_text = ?, explanation = ? WHERE id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$questionText, $explanation, $questionId]);
        
        // Bestehende Kategorie-Zuordnungen löschen und neue einfügen
        $stmt = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM question_categories WHERE question_id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$questionId]);
        
        $stmt = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO question_categories (question_id, category_id) VALUES (?, ?)");
        foreach ($categoryIds as $categoryId) {
            $stmt->execute([$questionId, $categoryId]);
        }
        
        // Bestehende Antworten löschen und neue einfügen
        $stmt = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM answers WHERE question_id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$questionId]);
        
        $stmt = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO answers (question_id, answer_text, is_correct) VALUES (?, ?, ?)");
        foreach ($answers as $answer) {
            $stmt->execute([$questionId, $answer['text'], $answer['isCorrect']]);
        }
        
        $db->commit();
        return true;
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        $db->rollBack();
        error_log("Fehler beim Aktualisieren der Frage: " . $e->getMessage());
        return false;
    }
}

// Funktion zum Löschen einer Frage
function deleteQuestion($db, $questionId) {
    $db->beginTransaction();
    
    try {
        // Zugehörige Einträge in question_categories löschen
        $stmt = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM question_categories WHERE question_id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$questionId]);
        
        // Zugehörige Antworten löschen
        $stmt = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM answers WHERE question_id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$questionId]);
        
        // Frage löschen
        $stmt = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM questions WHERE id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$questionId]);
        
        $db->commit();
        return true;
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        $db->rollBack();
        error_log("Fehler beim Löschen der Frage: " . $e->getMessage());
        return false;
    }
}
```

```php
// Funktion zum Abrufen der Kategorien, auf die der Benutzer Zugriff hat
function getCategories($db, $userId) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            SELECT DISTINCT c.*
            FROM categories c
            INNER JOIN user_categories uc ON c.id = uc.category_id
            WHERE uc.user_id = ?
            ORDER BY c.name
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$userId]);
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Fehler beim Abrufen der Kategorien: " . $e->getMessage());
        return [];
    }
}

// optimierte Version mit SM2-Unterstützung
function getQuestions($db, $category_ids, $limit) {
    $user_id = $_SESSION['user_id'];
    $placeholders = implode(',', array_fill(0, count($category_ids), '?'));

    $questions = [];
    $used_question_ids = [];

    // Neue und unbeantwortete Fragen
    $sql_new = "SELECT q.id, q.question_text,
                       0 as correct_count,
                       0 as incorrect_count,
                       0 as view_count,
                       '1970-01-01' as last_shown
                FROM questions q
                JOIN question_categories qc ON q.id = qc.question_id
                LEFT JOIN user_statistics us ON q.id = us.question_id AND us.user_id = ?
                WHERE qc.category_id IN ($placeholders)
                AND us.id IS NULL
                AND q.deleted_at IS NULL
                ORDER BY RAND()";

    $stmt = $db->prepare($sql_new);
    $params = array_merge([$user_id], $category_ids);
    $stmt->execute($params);
    $new_questions = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

    foreach ($new_questions as $question) {
        if (count($questions) < $limit && !in_array($question['id'], $used_question_ids)) {
            $questions[] = $question;
            $used_question_ids[] = $question['id'];
        }
    }

    // SM2: Wiederholungsfragen, die fällig sind (next_due_date <= heute)
    if (count($questions) < $limit) {
        $sql_sm2 = "SELECT q.id, q.question_text,
                           us.correct_count,
                           us.incorrect_count,
                           us.view_count,
                           us.last_shown,
                           us.repetition,
                           us.easiness_factor,
                           us.`interval`,
                           us.next_due_date
                    FROM questions q
                    JOIN question_categories qc ON q.id = qc.question_id
                    JOIN user_statistics us ON q.id = us.question_id AND us.user_id = ?
                    WHERE qc.category_id IN ($placeholders)
                    AND q.deleted_at IS NULL
                    AND us.next_due_date <= CURDATE()
                    ORDER BY 
                        (us.incorrect_count - us.correct_count) DESC,
                        us.view_count ASC,
                        us.next_due_date ASC,
                        RAND()";

        $stmt = $db->prepare($sql_sm2);
        $params = array_merge([$user_id], $category_ids);
        $stmt->execute($params);
        $repeat_questions = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        foreach ($repeat_questions as $question) {
            if (count($questions) < $limit && !in_array($question['id'], $used_question_ids)) {
                $questions[] = $question;
                $used_question_ids[] = $question['id'];
            }
        }
    }

    // Fallback: sonstige Fragen aus Kategorien
    if (count($questions) < $limit) {
        $sql_all = "SELECT q.id, q.question_text,
                           COALESCE(us.correct_count, 0) as correct_count,
                           COALESCE(us.incorrect_count, 0) as incorrect_count,
                           COALESCE(us.view_count, 0) as view_count,
                           COALESCE(us.last_shown, '1970-01-01') as last_shown
                    FROM questions q
                    JOIN question_categories qc ON q.id = qc.question_id
                    LEFT JOIN user_statistics us ON q.id = us.question_id AND us.user_id = ?
                    WHERE qc.category_id IN ($placeholders)
                    AND q.deleted_at IS NULL
                    ORDER BY RAND()";

        $stmt = $db->prepare($sql_all);
        $params = array_merge([$user_id], $category_ids);
        $stmt->execute($params);
        $all_questions = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        foreach ($all_questions as $question) {
            if (count($questions) < $limit && !in_array($question['id'], $used_question_ids)) {
                $questions[] = $question;
                $used_question_ids[] = $question['id'];
            }
        }
    }

    shuffle($questions); // Zufällige Reihenfolge
    return array_slice($questions, 0, $limit);
}

// Hilfefunktion zum Abrufen des Wiederholungsintervalls
function getRepeatIntervalForUser($db, $user_id, $type) {
    $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT repeat_interval_$type FROM users WHERE id = :user_id");
    $stmt->execute([':user_id' => $user_id]);
    $user_setting = $stmt->fetchColumn();
    if ($user_setting) {
        return $user_setting;
    } else {
        // Falls keine benutzerspezifischen Einstellungen vorhanden sind, globale Einstellungen verwenden
        $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT value FROM settings WHERE name = ?");
        $stmt->execute(["repeat_interval_$type"]);
        $setting = $stmt->fetchColumn();
        return $setting ? intval($setting) : ($type === 'correct' ? 7 : 1); // Standardwerte falls nicht gesetzt
    }
}

// Funktion zum Abrufen von Antworten für eine Frage
function getAnswers($db, $questionId) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT id, answer_text, is_correct FROM answers WHERE question_id = ? ORDER BY RAND()");
        $stmt->execute([$questionId]);
        $answers = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        // Mischen Sie die Antworten nur, wenn sie noch nicht in der Session gespeichert sind
        if (!isset($_SESSION['shuffled_answers'][$questionId])) {
            shuffle($answers);
            $_SESSION['shuffled_answers'][$questionId] = $answers;
        } else {
            $answers = $_SESSION['shuffled_answers'][$questionId];
        }

        return $answers;
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Fehler beim Abrufen der Antworten: " . $e->getMessage());
        return [];
    }
}

// Funktion zum Abrufen der Gesamtzahl aktiver (nicht gelöschter) Fragen mit Tausendertrennzeichen
function getTotalQuestions($db) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM questions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL");
        $stmt->execute();
        $result = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        $count = (int)$result['total'];

        // Zahl formatiert mit deutschem Tausendertrennzeichen (Punkt)
        return number_format($count, 0, ',', '.');
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Fehler beim Abrufen der Gesamtzahl der Fragen: " . $e->getMessage());
        return "0";
    }
}

// Nun mit SM2
function updateUserStatistics($db, $user_id, $question_id, $is_correct, $user_rating = null) {
    
    // Bewertung aus POST holen, falls vorhanden
    // $user_rating = isset($_POST['user_rating']) ? (int)$_POST['user_rating'] : null;
    
    // Hole bestehende Statistik (falls vorhanden)
    $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT * FROM user_statistics WHERE user_id = ? AND question_id = ?");
    $stmt->execute([$user_id, $question_id]);
    $stats = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

    // Standardwerte, falls kein Eintrag existiert
    $correct_count = $is_correct ? 1 : 0;
    $incorrect_count = $is_correct ? 0 : 1;
    $view_count = 1;
    $repetition = 0;
    $ef = 2.5;
    $interval = 1;

    if ($stats) {
        $correct_count += $stats['correct_count'];
        $incorrect_count += $stats['incorrect_count'];
        $view_count = $stats['view_count'] + 1;
        $repetition = $stats['repetition'];
        $ef = $stats['easiness_factor'];
        $interval = $stats['interval'];
    }

    if ($user_rating === null) {
        $user_rating = $is_correct ? 4 : 2; // Default-Rating basierend auf Korrektheit
    }
    
    $quality = max(0, min(5, $user_rating)); // Begrenzung auf SM2-Bereich (0–5)


    if ($quality >= 3) {
        $repetition++;
        if ($repetition == 1) {
            $interval = 1;
        } elseif ($repetition == 2) {
            $interval = 6;
        } else {
            $interval = round($interval * $ef);
        }
    } else {
        $repetition = 0;
        $interval = 1;
    }

    // EF (easiness factor) nach SM2 anpassen
    $ef = $ef + (0.1 - (5 - $quality) * (0.08 + (5 - $quality) * 0.02));
    if ($ef < 1.3) $ef = 1.3;

    // Nächster Fälligkeitstermin berechnen
    $next_due_date = (new DateTime())->modify("+$interval days")->format("Y-m-d");

    if ($stats) {

        $update_stmt = $db->prepare("UPDATE user_statistics
            SET correct_count = ?, incorrect_count = ?, view_count = ?, last_shown = NOW(),
                repetition = ?, easiness_factor = ?, `interval` = ?, next_due_date = ?, user_rating = ?
            WHERE user_id = ? AND question_id = ?");
        $update_stmt->execute([
            $correct_count, $incorrect_count, $view_count,
            $repetition, $ef, $interval, $next_due_date,
            $user_rating,
            $user_id, $question_id
        ]);

    } else {

        $insert_stmt = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO user_statistics 
            (user_id, question_id, correct_count, incorrect_count, view_count, last_shown,
            repetition, easiness_factor, `interval`, next_due_date, user_rating)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, NOW(), ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)");
        $insert_stmt->execute([
            $user_id, $question_id,
            $correct_count, $incorrect_count, $view_count,
            $repetition, $ef, $interval, $next_due_date,
            $user_rating
        ]);
    }
}

// Todo: Settings Resetintervall aus DB berücksichtigen

function updateDailyPoints($db, $user_id, $questions_answered = 1) {
    // Prüfe, ob letzte Antwort älter als 24 Stunden ist
    $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT last_answered FROM user_daily_points WHERE user_id = ?");
    $stmt->execute([$user_id]);
    $lastAnswered = $stmt->fetchColumn();

    $now = new DateTime();
    if ($lastAnswered) {
        $lastAnsweredTime = new DateTime($lastAnswered);
        $interval = $now->diff($lastAnsweredTime);
        if ($interval->h + ($interval->days * 24) >= 24) {
            // Zurücksetzen der Punkte und Streak
            $resetStmt = $db->prepare("UPDATE user_daily_points SET current_points = 0, streak = 0 WHERE user_id = ?");
            $resetStmt->execute([$user_id]);
        }
    } else {
        // Neuer Eintrag für den Benutzer
        $insertStmt = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO user_daily_points (user_id, last_answered) VALUES (?, NOW())");
        $insertStmt->execute([$user_id]);
    }

    // Aktuelle Punkte erhöhen - wenn weniger als 10 Fragen beantwortet werden. Man war ja dann aktiv. Also wird keine Mail versendet
    // current_points werden bei jeder Frage erhöht, wenn man 10 Fragen beantwortet hat, egal wann erhält man einen Streak
    $updateStmt = $db->prepare("
        UPDATE user_daily_points 
        SET current_points = current_points + ?, 
            last_answered = NOW(),
            email_sent_12h = 0,
            email_sent_2h = 0,
            email_sent_reset_warning = 0 
        WHERE user_id = ?
    ");
    
    $updateStmt->execute([$questions_answered, $user_id]);

    // Prüfen, ob 10 Punkte erreicht wurden
    $pointsStmt = $db->prepare("SELECT current_points FROM user_daily_points WHERE user_id = ?");
    $pointsStmt->execute([$user_id]);
    $currentPoints = $pointsStmt->fetchColumn();

    if ($currentPoints >= 10) {
        // Belohnung vergeben (Beispiel: Streak erhöhen)
        $streakStmt = $db->prepare("UPDATE user_daily_points SET streak = streak + 1 WHERE user_id = ?");
        $streakStmt->execute([$user_id]);
        // Punkte zurücksetzen
        $resetStmt = $db->prepare("UPDATE user_daily_points SET current_points = 0 WHERE user_id = ?");
        $resetStmt->execute([$user_id]);
    }
}

$categories = getCategories($db, $userId);

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST' && isset($_POST['start_quiz'])) {
    $selectedCategories = isset($_POST['categories']) ? $_POST['categories'] : [];
    $questionCount = isset($_POST['question_count']) ? intval($_POST['question_count']) : 10;
    // Validierung
    if ($questionCount < 1 || $questionCount > 50) {
        $questionCount = 10; // Auf Standardwert zurücksetzen
    }

    if (empty($selectedCategories)) {
        $error = "Bitte wählen Sie mindestens eine Kategorie aus.";
    } else {
        $userCategories = array_column($categories, 'id');
        $invalidCategories = array_diff($selectedCategories, $userCategories);

        if (!empty($invalidCategories)) {
            $error = "Sie haben keine Berechtigung für einige der ausgewählten Kategorien.";
        } else {
            $questions = getQuestions($db, $selectedCategories, $questionCount);
            if (empty($questions)) {
                $error = "Keine Fragen für die ausgewählten Kategorien gefunden.";
            } else {
                $_SESSION['quiz_questions'] = $questions;
                $_SESSION['current_question'] = 0;
                $_SESSION['correct_answers'] = 0;
                $_SESSION['user_answers'] = [];
                $_SESSION['shuffled_answers'] = [];
                $_SESSION['quiz_started'] = true;
            }
        }
    }
}

$currentQuestion = null;

if (isset($_SESSION['quiz_questions']) && isset($_SESSION['current_question'])) {

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST' && isset($_POST['submit_answer'])) {
    $selectedAnswerId = $_POST['answer'];
    $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT is_correct FROM answers WHERE id = ?");
    $stmt->execute([$selectedAnswerId]);
    $result = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    $isCorrect = $result['is_correct'];

    // Prüfung der Lesezeit
    $timeSpent = microtime(true) - ($_SESSION['question_start_time'] ?? microtime(true));
    $minReadTime = 5; // z.B. 5 Sekunden Mindest-Lesezeit

    if ($timeSpent < $minReadTime) {
        // Aktion bei zu kurzer Lesezeit
        error_log("User $userId hat Frage {$currentQuestion['id']} zu schnell beantwortet ($timeSpent s)");
        // Optional: Admin benachrichtigen, Punkte nicht vergeben, etc.
    }

    $_SESSION['user_answers'][] = [
        'question_id' => $currentQuestion['id'],
        'answer_id' => $selectedAnswerId,
        'is_correct' => $isCorrect,
        'time_spent' => $timeSpent
    ];

//     if ($isCorrect) {
//         $_SESSION['correct_answers']++;
//    }
// Fehlerbehebung, Ausführung erst nach Update Daily-Points

    // Richtige Antwort abrufen
    $stmtCorrect = $db->prepare("SELECT id FROM answers WHERE question_id = ? AND is_correct = 1");
    $stmtCorrect->execute([$currentQuestion['id']]);
    $correctAnswerId = $stmtCorrect->fetchColumn();

    $_SESSION['show_result'] = true;
    $_SESSION['selected_answer_id'] = $selectedAnswerId;
    $_SESSION['correct_answer_id'] = $correctAnswerId;

    // updateUserStatistics($db, $userId, $currentQuestion['id'], $isCorrect, $user_rating);
    // updateDailyPoints($db, $userId);

    // Kein automatisches Weiterleiten zur nächsten Frage
    header("Location: quiz.php");
    exit();
}

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST' && isset($_POST['next_question'])) {

    // 1. Aktuelle Frage vor dem Inkrementieren holen
    $currentQuestionIndex = $_SESSION['current_question'];
    $totalQuestions = count($_SESSION['quiz_questions'] ?? []);


    // Prüfen, ob die aktuelle Frage überhaupt noch existiert
    if ($currentQuestionIndex < $totalQuestions) {
    
    // 2. Benutzerbewertung aus POST holen
    $user_rating = isset($_POST['user_rating']) ? (int)$_POST['user_rating'] : null;

    // 3. Daten der gerade beantworteten Frage holen
    $currentQuestionId = $_SESSION['quiz_questions'][$currentQuestionIndex]['id'];
    $isCorrect = $_SESSION['user_answers'][$currentQuestionIndex]['is_correct'] ?? false;
    
    // 4. Statistiken aktualisieren
    updateUserStatistics($db, $userId, $currentQuestionId, $isCorrect, $user_rating);
    updateDailyPoints($db, $userId);

    if ($isCorrect) {
        $_SESSION['correct_answers']++;
    }

    }

    // 5. zur nächsten Frage springen
    $_SESSION['current_question']++;
    $_SESSION['show_result'] = false;
    header("Location: quiz.php");
    exit();
}

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST' && isset($_POST['restart_quiz'])) {

    // Alle quizbezogenen Sessionvariablen zurücksetzen
    $quizVariables = ['quiz_questions', 'current_question', 'correct_answers', 'user_answers', 'show_result', 'quiz_started', 'shuffled_answers', 'confetti'];
    foreach ($quizVariables as $var) {
        if (isset($_SESSION[$var])) {
            unset($_SESSION[$var]);
        }
    }
    header("Location: quiz.php");
    exit();
}

// Animation Feuerwerk
$firework = "<script>
window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas, false);
window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', onLoad, false);

window.requestAnimationFrame = 
    window.requestAnimationFrame       || 
    window.webkitRequestAnimationFrame || 
    window.mozRequestAnimationFrame    || 
    window.oRequestAnimationFrame      || 
    window.msRequestAnimationFrame     || 
    function (callback) {
        window.setTimeout(callback, 1000/60);
    };

var canvas, ctx, w, h, particles = [], probability = 0.04,
    xPoint, yPoint;

function onLoad() {
    canvas = document.getElementById('canvas');
    ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    resizeCanvas();
    
    window.requestAnimationFrame(updateWorld);
}

function resizeCanvas() {
    if (!!canvas) {
        w = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
        h = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
    }
}

function updateWorld() {
    update();
    paint();
    window.requestAnimationFrame(updateWorld);
}

function update() {
    if (particles.length < 500 && Math.random() < probability) {
        createFirework();
    }
    var alive = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
        if (particles[i].move()) {
            alive.push(particles[i]);
        }
    }
    particles = alive;
}

function paint() {
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.2)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
    for (var i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
        particles[i].draw(ctx);
    }
}

function createFirework() {
    xPoint = Math.random() * (w - 200) + 100;
    yPoint = Math.random() * (h - 200) + 100;
    var nFire = Math.random() * 50 + 100;
    var c = 'rgb(' + (~~(Math.random() * 200 + 55)) + ',' +
                 (~~(Math.random() * 200 + 55)) + ',' +
                 (~~(Math.random() * 200 + 55)) + ')';
    for (var i = 0; i < nFire; i++) {
        var particle = new Particle();
        particle.color = c;
        var vy = Math.sqrt(25 - particle.vx * particle.vx);
        if (Math.abs(particle.vy) > vy) {
            particle.vy = particle.vy > 0 ? vy : -vy;
        }
        particles.push(particle);
    }
}

function Particle() {
    this.w = this.h = Math.random() * 4 + 1;

    this.x = xPoint - this.w / 2;
    this.y = yPoint - this.h / 2;

    this.vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 10;
    this.vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 10;

    this.alpha = Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.5;

    this.color;
}

Particle.prototype = {
    gravity: 0.05,
    move: function () {
        this.x += this.vx;
        this.vy += this.gravity;
        this.y += this.vy;
        this.alpha -= 0.01;
        if (this.x <= -this.w || this.x >= screen.width ||
            this.y >= screen.height ||
            this.alpha <= 0) {
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    },
    draw: function (c) {
        c.save();
        c.beginPath();
        
        c.translate(this.x + this.w / 2, this.y + this.h / 2);
        c.arc(0, 0, this.w, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        c.fillStyle = this.color;
        c.globalAlpha = this.alpha;
        
        c.closePath();
        c.fill();
        c.restore();
    }
}
</script>";
```
