```php
<script>
(function() {
    // --- Konfiguration ---
    const MIN_ANSWER_TIME = 3;      // Sekunden Mindest-Lesezeit
    const BASE_PENALTY = 10;        // Basis-Sperrzeit in Sekunden
    const MAX_PENALTY = 90;         // Max. Sperrzeit
    const PENALTY_GROWTH = 1.5;     // Multiplikator für kumulative Strafzeit
    const RAPID_CLICK_WINDOW = 5;   // Zeitfenster für Mustererkennung (Sekunden)
    const RAPID_CLICK_THRESHOLD = 3; // Anzahl Klicks für "Schummel-Muster"

    // --- Witzige Meldungen ---
    const CHEAT_MESSAGES = [
        'Haha, zu schnell! Du musst {time} Sekunden warten. Versuch\'s danach nochmal — diesmal ehrlich lesen! 😏',
        'Netter Versuch! {time} Sekunden Pause zum Nachdenken. 🤔',
        'Entspann dich mal! {time} Sekunden Zeit, die Frage wirklich zu lesen. 📚',
        'Speedrun? Nicht hier! {time} Sekunden Timeout. ⏱️',
        'Die Buttons sind nicht auf der Flucht! {time} Sekunden Denkpause. 🧠'
    ];

    const PATTERN_MESSAGES = [
        'Whoa! Wild am Klicken? {time} Sekunden zum Runterkommen! 🎯',
        'Button-Smashing funktioniert hier nicht! {time} Sekunden Pause. 🎮',
        'Klick-Festival erkannt! {time} Sekunden zum Entspannen. 🎪'
    ];

    // --- Witzige Button-Aktionen ---
    const BUTTON_ANIMATIONS = {
        shake: (btn) => {
            btn.style.animation = 'shake 0.5s';
            setTimeout(() => btn.style.animation = '', 500);
        },
        runAway: (btn) => {
            const originalPos = btn.style.position;
            btn.style.position = 'relative';
            const randomX = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 100;
            const randomY = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 50;
            btn.style.transform = `translate(${randomX}px, ${randomY}px)`;
            setTimeout(() => {
                btn.style.transform = '';
                btn.style.position = originalPos;
            }, 500);
        },
        spin: (btn) => {
            btn.style.transition = 'transform 0.5s';
            btn.style.transform = 'rotate(360deg)';
            setTimeout(() => {
                btn.style.transform = '';
                btn.style.transition = '';
            }, 500);
        },
        grow: (btn) => {
            btn.style.transition = 'transform 0.3s';
            btn.style.transform = 'scale(1.2)';
            setTimeout(() => {
                btn.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
                setTimeout(() => btn.style.transition = '', 300);
            }, 150);
        }
    };

    // CSS für Shake-Animation hinzufügen
    const style = document.createElement('style');
    style.textContent = `
        @keyframes shake {
            0%, 100% { transform: translateX(0); }
            10%, 30%, 50%, 70%, 90% { transform: translateX(-10px); }
            20%, 40%, 60%, 80% { transform: translateX(10px); }
        }
        .quiz-disabled-btn {
            cursor: not-allowed !important;
            opacity: 0.6 !important;
            filter: grayscale(50%);
        }
    `;
    document.head.appendChild(style);

    // --- Hilfsfunktionen ---
    function safeToast(msg, type = 'error') {
        if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
            showToast(msg, type === 'success' ? 'success' : 'error');
        } else {
            alert(msg);
        }
    }

    function randomMessage(messages, time) {
        const msg = messages[Math.floor(Math.random() * messages.length)];
        return msg.replace('{time}', time);
    }

    function randomAnimation(btn) {
        const animations = Object.values(BUTTON_ANIMATIONS);
        const randomAnim = animations[Math.floor(Math.random() * animations.length)];
        randomAnim(btn);
    }

    // Frage-ID aus DOM holen
    const qidElem = document.querySelector('.qid');
    const questionId = qidElem ? qidElem.textContent.trim() : 'global';

    // Schlüssel für sessionStorage
    const storageKey = 'quiz_penalty_attempts_' + questionId;
    const clickHistoryKey = 'quiz_click_history_' + questionId;

    // Buttons & Form
    const form = document.querySelector('form[method="post"][action=""]');
    if (!form) return;

    const buttons = Array.from(form.querySelectorAll('.btn-answer'));
    if (!buttons.length) return;

    // Timer starten
    let questionStartTime = Date.now();
    let totalTimePaused = 0; // Gesamte Sperrzeit akkumulieren

    // Sperrstatus
    let submitLocked = false;
    let currentInterval = null;

    // --- Storage-Funktionen ---
    function getAttempts() {
        const v = sessionStorage.getItem(storageKey);
        return v ? parseInt(v, 10) : 0;
    }

    function setAttempts(n) {
        sessionStorage.setItem(storageKey, String(n));
    }

    function resetAttempts() {
        sessionStorage.removeItem(storageKey);
        sessionStorage.removeItem(clickHistoryKey);
    }

    function getClickHistory() {
        const v = sessionStorage.getItem(clickHistoryKey);
        return v ? JSON.parse(v) : [];
    }

    function addClickToHistory(timestamp) {
        let history = getClickHistory();
        history.push(timestamp);
        // Nur letzte 10 Klicks behalten
        if (history.length > 10) history = history.slice(-10);
        sessionStorage.setItem(clickHistoryKey, JSON.stringify(history));
        return history;
    }

    function detectRapidClicking(history) {
        if (history.length < RAPID_CLICK_THRESHOLD) return false;
        
        const recentClicks = history.slice(-RAPID_CLICK_THRESHOLD);
        const timeSpan = (recentClicks[recentClicks.length - 1] - recentClicks[0]) / 1000;
        
        return timeSpan < RAPID_CLICK_WINDOW;
    }

    // --- Sperrzeit berechnen ---
    function calcPenaltySeconds(attempts) {
        if (attempts <= 0) return BASE_PENALTY;
        return Math.min(MAX_PENALTY, Math.round(BASE_PENALTY * Math.pow(PENALTY_GROWTH, attempts)));
    }

    // --- Sperre starten ---
    function startPenalty(clickedBtn, penaltySeconds, isPattern = false) {
        submitLocked = true;
        const penaltyStartTime = Date.now();
        
        // Alle Buttons witzig reagieren lassen
        buttons.forEach((b, i) => {
            b.disabled = true;
            b.classList.add('quiz-disabled-btn');
            
            // Verschiedene Animationen mit leichter Verzögerung
            setTimeout(() => randomAnimation(b), i * 100);
        });

        const originalText = clickedBtn.textContent;
        let remaining = penaltySeconds;
        clickedBtn.textContent = `⏳ Warte... ${remaining}s`;

        currentInterval = setInterval(() => {
            remaining--;
            
            // Emoji wechselt während Countdown
            const emoji = remaining % 2 === 0 ? '⏳' : '⌛';
            clickedBtn.textContent = `${emoji} Warte... ${remaining}s`;
            
            // Kleine Animation alle 3 Sekunden
            if (remaining % 3 === 0 && remaining > 0) {
                randomAnimation(clickedBtn);
            }
            
            if (remaining <= 0) {
                clearInterval(currentInterval);
                currentInterval = null;
                
                // Sperrzeit zur Gesamtpause addieren
                const actualPenaltyTime = (Date.now() - penaltyStartTime) / 1000;
                totalTimePaused += actualPenaltyTime;
                
                buttons.forEach(b => {
                    b.disabled = false;
                    b.classList.remove('quiz-disabled-btn');
                    BUTTON_ANIMATIONS.grow(b); // Buttons "erwachen"
                });
                
                clickedBtn.textContent = originalText;
                submitLocked = false;
                // NICHT den Timer zurücksetzen - User konnte ja weiterlesen!
            }
        }, 1000);
    }

    // --- Klickhandler ---
    buttons.forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            // Wenn gesperrt -> witzige Reaktion
            if (submitLocked) {
                e.preventDefault();
                randomAnimation(this);
                safeToast('Geduld! Die Buttons brauchen auch eine Pause! 🎯', 'error');
                return false;
            }

            const now = Date.now();
            const timeSpent = (now - questionStartTime) / 1000;
            
            // Echte Lesezeit = Gesamtzeit minus Sperrzeit
            const actualReadingTime = timeSpent - totalTimePaused;

            // Klick zur Historie hinzufügen
            const clickHistory = addClickToHistory(now);
            
            // Mustererkennung: Schnelle Klick-Serie
            const isRapidClicking = detectRapidClicking(clickHistory);

            // Zu schnell oder Muster erkannt
            if (actualReadingTime < MIN_ANSWER_TIME || isRapidClicking) {
                e.preventDefault();

                let attempts = getAttempts();
                attempts++;
                setAttempts(attempts);

                const penalty = calcPenaltySeconds(attempts - 1);
                
                // Muster-Erkennung hat Priorität (ist "schlimmer")
                let message;
                if (isRapidClicking) {
                    message = randomMessage(PATTERN_MESSAGES, penalty);
                    // Extra-Animation bei Muster-Erkennung
                    buttons.forEach(b => BUTTON_ANIMATIONS.shake(b));
                } else {
                    message = randomMessage(CHEAT_MESSAGES, penalty);
                }

                safeToast(message, 'error');
                startPenalty(this, penalty, isRapidClicking);
                return false;
            }

            // Alles OK: Zeit mitschicken (echte Lesezeit ohne Pausen)
            const hidden = document.createElement('input');
            hidden.type = 'hidden';
            hidden.name = 'time_spent';
            hidden.value = Math.round(actualReadingTime);
            form.appendChild(hidden);

            resetAttempts();
            // Formular wird normal abgeschickt
        });

        // Hover-Effekt: Buttons "weichen aus" wenn gesperrt
        btn.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() {
            if (submitLocked && Math.random() > 0.5) {
                BUTTON_ANIMATIONS.runAway(this);
            }
        });
    });

    // --- Formular-Submit absichern ---
    form.addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
        if (submitLocked) {
            e.preventDefault();
            safeToast('Noch nicht! Die Buttons laden noch... 🔄', 'error');
            return false;
        }

        const timeSpent = (Date.now() - questionStartTime) / 1000;
        const actualReadingTime = timeSpent - totalTimePaused;
        
        if (actualReadingTime < MIN_ANSWER_TIME) {
            e.preventDefault();
            
            const fakeBtn = buttons[0];
            let attempts = getAttempts();
            attempts++;
            setAttempts(attempts);
            
            const penalty = calcPenaltySeconds(attempts - 1);
            safeToast(randomMessage(CHEAT_MESSAGES, penalty), 'error');
            startPenalty(fakeBtn, penalty);
            return false;
        }
    });

    // Cleanup bei Page-Unload
    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', function() {
        if (currentInterval) {
            clearInterval(currentInterval);
        }
    });
})();
</script>

    <script>

$(document).ready(function() {
    // Meldebutton Handler
    $('.report-btn').click(function() {
        const questionId = $(this).data('question-id');
        $('#modalQuestionId').val(questionId);
        $('#reportModal').modal('show');
    });

    // Formular absenden
    $('#reportForm').submit(function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        
        const $form = $(this);
        const formData = $form.serializeArray();
        const jsonData = {};
        
        $.each(formData, function(_, field) {
            jsonData[field.name] = field.value;
        });

        $.ajax({
            url: 'lib/php/handler_questionreport.php',
            type: 'POST',
            contentType: 'application/json',
            data: JSON.stringify(jsonData),
            dataType: 'json',
            success: function(response) {
                if (response.status === 'success') {
                    showToast(response.message, 'success');
                    $('#reportModal').modal('hide');
                    $form.trigger('reset');
                } else {
                    showToast(response.message || 'Unbekannter Fehler', 'error'); // 'danger' zu 'error' ändern
                }
            },
            error: function(xhr) {
                let response = {};
                try {
                    response = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error("Couldn't parse response", e);
                }
                
                showToast(
                    response.message || 
                    xhr.responseText || 
                    `Serverfehler (${xhr.status})`, 
                    'error' // Typ auf 'error' setzen
                );
            }
        });
    });

    // Toast-Funktion überarbeitet
    function showToast(message, type = 'success') {
        // Container sicherstellen
        let $container = $('.toast-system');
        if ($container.length === 0) {
            $('body').append('<div class="toast-system"></div>');
            $container = $('.toast-system');
        }

        // Toast erstellen
        const toast = $(`
            <div class="toast">
                <i class="toast-icon fas ${type === 'success' ? 'fa-check-circle' : 'fa-exclamation-triangle'}"></i>
                <span class="toast-message">${message}</span>
            </div>
        `);


        // Farben setzen
        if(type === 'success') {
            toast.css('border-left-color', '#10B981');
            toast.find('.toast-icon').css('color', '#10B981');
        } else {
            toast.css('border-left-color', '#EF4444');
            toast.find('.toast-icon').css('color', '#EF4444');
        }

        // Zum Container hinzufügen
        $container.append(toast);

        // Animation
        setTimeout(() => toast.addClass('show'), 50);

        // Automatisches Schließen
        const autoClose = setTimeout(() => {
            toast.remove();
        }, type === 'success' ? 3000 : 5000);

        // Manuelles Schließen
        toast.find('.toast-close').click(() => {
            clearTimeout(autoClose);
            toast.remove();
        });
    }
});
</script>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    const slider = document.getElementById("user_rating");
    const feedback = document.getElementById("rating_feedback");

    const ratingTexts = {
        0: "völlig geraten",
        1: "kaum einen Plan gehabt",
        2: "halb geraten",
        3: "geahnt aber unsicher",
        4: "ziemlich sicher",
        5: "sehr sicher"
    };

    const ratingColors = {
        0: "#dc3545", // rot
        1: "#e4606d",
        2: "#fd7e14", // orange
        3: "#ffc107", // gelb
        4: "#28a745", // grün
        5: "#20c997"  // türkis
    };

    function updateFeedback(value) {
        feedback.textContent = ratingTexts[value] || "Unbekannt";
        feedback.style.color = ratingColors[value] || "#6c757d";
    }

    // Initial anzeigen
    updateFeedback(slider.value);

    // Beim Verschieben des Sliders
    slider.addEventListener("input", function () {
        updateFeedback(this.value);
    });

    // Absicherung beim Absenden (optional)
    const form = slider.closest("form");
    if (form) {
        form.addEventListener("submit", function (e) {
            if (slider.value < 2 && document.body.classList.contains("question-correct")) {
                const confirmLowRating = confirm("Du hast die Frage richtig beantwortet, aber eine sehr niedrige Bewertung gewählt. Möchtest du das wirklich?");
                if (!confirmLowRating) {
                    e.preventDefault(); // Senden abbrechen
                }
            }
        });
    }
});
</script>

<script>
// ===== CANVAS ANIMATION WITH GROWTH & INTERACTIVE EFFECTS =====
const config = <?php echo json_encode($backgroundConfig); ?>;

const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
let particles = [];
let mouseX = window.innerWidth / 2;
let mouseY = window.innerHeight / 2;
let maxParticles = 300;
let growthCounter = 0;

function resizeCanvas() {
    canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
    canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
}
resizeCanvas();
window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas);

// Track mouse
document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
    mouseX = e.clientX;
    mouseY = e.clientY;
});

// Touch events
document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
    const touch = e.touches[0];
    mouseX = touch.clientX;
    mouseY = touch.clientY;
    createTouchParticles(touch.clientX, touch.clientY);
});

document.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
    const touch = e.touches[0];
    mouseX = touch.clientX;
    mouseY = touch.clientY;
});

// ===== PARTICLE CLASS =====
class Particle {
    constructor(x, y, vx, vy) {
        this.x = x || Math.random() * canvas.width;
        this.y = y || Math.random() * canvas.height;
        this.vx = vx || (Math.random() - 0.5) * config.particleSpeed * 2;
        this.vy = vy || (Math.random() - 0.5) * config.particleSpeed * 2;
        this.originalVx = this.vx;
        this.originalVy = this.vy;
    }

    update() {
        // Sanfte, konstante Bewegung + schwache Maus-Anziehung
        const dx = mouseX - this.x;
        const dy = mouseY - this.y;
        const distance = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
        const attraction = 0.003; // Sehr schwach

        // Konstante eigene Bewegung beibehalten
        this.x += this.vx * 0.5;
        this.y += this.vy * 0.5;

        // Sehr schwache Maus-Anziehung
        if (distance < 400) {
            this.x += (dx / distance) * attraction;
            this.y += (dy / distance) * attraction;
        }

        // Bounce off walls
        if (this.x < 0 || this.x > canvas.width) this.vx *= -1;
        if (this.y < 0 || this.y > canvas.height) this.vy *= -1;

        this.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.width, this.x));
        this.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.height, this.y));
    }

    draw() {
        ctx.fillStyle = config.particleColor;
        ctx.globalAlpha = config.opacity;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, config.particleSize, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
    }
}

// ===== CREATE PARTICLES AT TOUCH POINT =====
function createTouchParticles(x, y) {
    const count = Math.min(10, maxParticles - particles.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const angle = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / count;
        const speed = 2;
        const vx = Math.cos(angle) * speed;
        const vy = Math.sin(angle) * speed;
        particles.push(new Particle(x, y, vx, vy));
    }
}

// ===== PERLIN NOISE =====
function perlin(x, y, z) {
    const xi = Math.floor(x) & 255;
    const yi = Math.floor(y) & 255;
    const zi = Math.floor(z) & 255;

    const xf = x - Math.floor(x);
    const yf = y - Math.floor(y);
    const zf = z - Math.floor(z);

    const u = fade(xf);
    const v = fade(yf);
    const w = fade(zf);

    const p = permutation;
    const aa = p[p[p[xi] + yi] + zi];
    const ab = p[p[p[xi] + yi + 1] + zi];
    const ba = p[p[p[xi + 1] + yi] + zi];
    const bb = p[p[p[xi + 1] + yi + 1] + zi];

    const x1 = lerp(grad(aa, xf, yf, zf), grad(ba, xf - 1, yf, zf), u);
    const x2 = lerp(grad(ab, xf, yf - 1, zf), grad(bb, xf - 1, yf - 1, zf), u);

    return lerp(x1, x2, v) * 0.5 + 0.5;
}

function fade(t) {
    return t * t * t * (t * (t * 6 - 15) + 10);
}

function lerp(t, a, b) {
    return a + t * (b - a);
}

function grad(hash, x, y, z) {
    const h = hash & 15;
    const u = h < 8 ? x : y;
    const v = h < 8 ? y : z;
    return ((h & 1) === 0 ? u : -u) + ((h & 2) === 0 ? v : -v);
}

const permutation = (() => {
    const p = Array.from({ length: 256 }, (_, i) => i).sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5);
    return [...p, ...p];
})();

// ===== ANIMATION LOOP =====
function animate() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    if (config.type === 'disabled') {
        requestAnimationFrame(animate);
        return;
    }

    // Partikel wachsen lassen
    growthCounter++;
    if (growthCounter > 60 && particles.length < maxParticles) { // Alle ~1 Sekunde
        particles.push(new Particle());
        growthCounter = 0;
    }

    if (config.type === 'particles') {
        animateParticles();
    } else if (config.type === 'perlin') {
        animatePerlin();
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
}

function animateParticles() {
    particles.forEach(p => {
        p.update();
        p.draw();
    });

    ctx.globalAlpha = config.opacity * 0.5;
    ctx.strokeStyle = config.lineColor;
    ctx.lineWidth = config.lineWidth;

    for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
        for (let j = i + 1; j < particles.length; j++) {
            const dx = particles[i].x - particles[j].x;
            const dy = particles[i].y - particles[j].y;
            const distance = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

            if (distance < config.connectionRadius) {
                ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - distance / config.connectionRadius) * config.opacity * 0.5;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(particles[i].x, particles[i].y);
                ctx.lineTo(particles[j].x, particles[j].y);
                ctx.stroke();
            }
        }
    }
}

function animatePerlin() {
    const time = Date.now() * 0.00008;
    ctx.globalAlpha = config.opacity;
    ctx.fillStyle = config.particleColor;

    // Perlin-basierte Partikel
    for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(particles.length, config.particleCount); i++) {
        particles[i].update();
        particles[i].draw();
    }

    // Verbindungslinien
    ctx.globalAlpha = config.opacity * 0.3;
    ctx.strokeStyle = config.lineColor;
    ctx.lineWidth = config.lineWidth;

    for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(particles.length - 1, config.particleCount - 1); i++) {
        const dx = particles[i].x - particles[i + 1].x;
        const dy = particles[i].y - particles[i + 1].y;
        const distance = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

        if (distance < config.connectionRadius) {
            ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - distance / config.connectionRadius) * config.opacity * 0.3;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(particles[i].x, particles[i].y);
            ctx.lineTo(particles[i + 1].x, particles[i + 1].y);
            ctx.stroke();
        }
    }
}

// ===== INITIALIZATION =====
function updateParticles() {
    particles = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < config.particleCount; i++) {
        particles.push(new Particle());
    }
}

updateParticles();
animate();
</script>
```

```php
function getQuestionDetails($db, $questionId) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            SELECT q.question_text, a.id as answer_id, a.answer_text, a.is_correct, q.explanation
            FROM questions q
            JOIN answers a ON q.id = a.question_id
            WHERE q.id = ?
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$questionId]);
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Fehler beim Abrufen der Fragedetails: " . $e->getMessage());
        return [];
    }
}

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {
    // Meldebutton Handler für Ergebnisse (delegiertes Event)
    $(document).on('click', '.report-btn-results', function() {
        const questionId = $(this).data('question-id');
        $('#modalQuestionIdResults').val(questionId);
        $('#reportModal').modal('show');
    });

    // Formular absenden für Ergebnisse
    $('#reportFormResults').submit(function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();

        const $form = $(this);
        const formData = $form.serializeArray();
        const jsonData = {};

        $.each(formData, function(_, field) {
            jsonData[field.name] = field.value;
        });

        $.ajax({
            url: 'lib/php/handler_questionreport.php',
            type: 'POST',
            contentType: 'application/json',
            data: JSON.stringify(jsonData),
            dataType: 'json',
            success: function(response) {
                if (response.status === 'success') {
                    showToast(response.message, 'success');
                    $('#reportModal').modal('hide');
                    $form.trigger('reset');
                } else {
                    showToast(response.message || 'Unbekannter Fehler', 'error');
                }
            },
            error: function(xhr) {
                let response = {};
                try {
                    response = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error("Couldn't parse response", e);
                }

                showToast(
                    response.message ||
                    xhr.responseText ||
                    `Serverfehler (${xhr.status})`,
                    'error'
                );
            }
        });
    });

    // Toast-Funktion (kann einmal global definiert werden, wenn du sie in mehreren Dateien nutzt)
    function showToast(message, type = 'success') {
        let $container = $('.toast-system');
        if ($container.length === 0) {
            $('body').append('<div class="toast-system"></div>');
            $container = $('.toast-system');
        }

        const toast = $(`
            <div class="toast">
                <i class="toast-icon fas ${type === 'success' ? 'fa-check-circle' : 'fa-exclamation-triangle'}"></i>
                <span class="toast-message">${message}</span>
            </div>
        `);

        if(type === 'success') {
            toast.css('border-left-color', '#10B981');
            toast.find('.toast-icon').css('color', '#10B981');
        } else {
            toast.css('border-left-color', '#EF4444');
            toast.find('.toast-icon').css('color', '#EF4444');
        }

        $container.append(toast);
        setTimeout(() => toast.addClass('show'), 50);
        const autoClose = setTimeout(() => {
            toast.remove();
        }, type === 'success' ? 3000 : 5000);
        toast.find('.toast-close').click(() => {
            clearTimeout(autoClose);
            toast.remove();
        });
    }
});
</script>
```

```php
// Formularverarbeitung
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] == 'POST') {
    // CSRF-Validierung
    if (!isset($_POST['csrf_token']) || !hash_equals($_SESSION['csrf_token'], $_POST['csrf_token'])) {
        die("Ungültige Anfrage");
    }

    // Input filtern
    $username = trim($_POST['username']);
    $email = filter_var(trim($_POST['email']), FILTER_SANITIZE_EMAIL);
    $first_name = trim($_POST['first_name']);
    $last_name = trim($_POST['last_name']);
    $password = $_POST['password'];
    $confirm_password = $_POST['confirm_password'];

    // Validierung
    $validationError = false;

    // Benutzername (erlaubt: A-Z, 0-9, -, _, .)
    if (!preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.]{3,50}$/', $username)) {
        $error = "Benutzername ungültig (nur A-Z, 0-9, -, _, .)";
        $validationError = true;
    }

    // Namen (Unicode-fähig)
    if (!preg_match('/^[\p{L} \-]{2,50}$/u', $first_name)) {
        $error = "Vorname enthält ungültige Zeichen";
        $validationError = true;
    }

    if (!preg_match('/^[\p{L} \-]{2,50}$/u', $last_name)) {
        $error = "Nachname enthält ungültige Zeichen";
        $validationError = true;
    }

    // E-Mail
    if (!filter_var($email, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL)) {
        $error = "Ungültige E-Mail-Adresse";
        $validationError = true;
    }

    // Passwort
    if (!preg_match('/^(?=.*[a-z])(?=.*[A-Z])(?=.*\d)(?=.*[\W_]).{12,}$/', $password)) {
        $error = "Passwort erfüllt nicht die Anforderungen";
        $validationError = true;
    }

    if ($password !== $confirm_password) {
        $error = "Passwörter stimmen nicht überein";
        $validationError = true;
    }

    if (!$validationError) {
        try {
            // Rate-Limiting
            $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users 
                                 WHERE registration_ip = ? 
                                 AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR");
            $stmt->execute([$_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR']]);
            if ($stmt->fetchColumn() >= 3) {
                $error = "Zu viele Registrierungen von dieser IP";
                throw new Exception('Rate limit exceeded');
            }

            // Existenzprüfung
            $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT id FROM users WHERE username = ? OR email = ?");
            $stmt->execute([$username, $email]);
            
            if ($stmt->rowCount() > 0) {
                $error = "Benutzername oder E-Mail bereits vergeben";
            } else {
                // Passwort hashen
                $options = [
                    'memory_cost' => 1<<17,
                    'time_cost' => 4,
                    'threads' => 3
                ];
                $hashed_password = password_hash($password, PASSWORD_ARGON2ID, $options);

                // User erstellen
                $stmt = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO users 
                    (username, email, password, first_name, last_name, role, registration_ip)
                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)");
                
                $result = $stmt->execute([
                    $username,
                    $email,
                    $hashed_password,
                    $first_name,
                    $last_name,
                    'user',
                    $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR']
                ]);

                if ($result) {
                    // Aktivierungstoken
                    $activation_token = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
                    $user_id = $db->lastInsertId();
                    
                    $update_stmt = $db->prepare("UPDATE users SET 
                        activation_token = ?,
                        activation_expires = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
                        WHERE id = ?");
                    $update_stmt->execute([$activation_token, $user_id]);

                    // PHPMailer
                    $mail = new PHPMailer\PHPMailer\PHPMailer(true);

                    try {
                        // SMTP Einstellungen
                        $mail->isSMTP();
                        $mail->Host       = SMTP_HOST;
                        $mail->SMTPAuth   = true;
                        $mail->Username   = SMTP_USER;
                        $mail->Password   = SMTP_PASS;
                        $mail->SMTPSecure = PHPMailer\PHPMailer\PHPMailer::ENCRYPTION_SMTPS;
                        $mail->Port       = SMTP_PORT;

                        // 💡 Hier IPv4 erzwingen:
                        $mail->SMTPOptions = [
                            'socket' => [
                                'bindto' => '0.0.0.0:0'  // zwingt IPv4
                            ]
                        ];

                        // Empfänger
                        $mail->setFrom(SMTP_FROM, SMTP_FROM_NAME);
                        $mail->addAddress($email, $first_name . ' ' . $last_name);

                        // Inhalt
                        $mail->isHTML(true);
                        $mail->CharSet = 'UTF-8';
                        $mail->Subject = 'Aktivierung Ihres Kontos - ' . SMTP_FROM_NAME;
                        $activation_link = 'https://'.$_SERVER['HTTP_HOST'].'/activate.php?token='.$activation_token;
                        $mail->Body = "
                        <!DOCTYPE html>
        <html lang='de'>
        <head>
            <meta charset='UTF-8'>
            <meta name='viewport' content='width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0'>
            <title>Passwort zurücksetzen - Quiz App</title>

                body {

                }

                    margin-top: 10px;
                    display: block;
                    color: #007bff;
                    text-decoration: underline;
                }
            </style>
        </head>
        <body>
            <div class='container'>
                <div class='header'>
                    <h1>Registrierung erfolgreich!</h1>
                </div>
                <div class='content'>
                    <p>Hallo $first_name $last_name,</p>
                    <p>Sie haben sich erfolgreich registriert, bitte bestätigen Sie Ihre E-Mailadresse indem Sie den folgenden Link anklicken.</p>
                    <p style='text-align: center;'>
                        <a href='$activation_link' class='button'>E-Mailadresse jetzt bestätigen</a>
                    </p>
                    <p>Falls der Button nicht funktioniert, können Sie den folgenden Link kopieren und in Ihren Browser einfügen:</p>
                    <p style='text-align: center;'>
                        <a href='$activation_link' class='link'>$activation_link</a>
                    </p>
                    <p>Bitte beachten Sie, dass dieser Link nur für eine Stunde gültig ist.</p>
                    <p>Wenn Sie diese Anfrage nicht gestellt haben, können Sie diese E-Mail ignorieren.</p>

                </div>
            </div>
        </body>
        </html>";

                        $mail->AltBody = "Aktivierungslink: ".$activation_link;

                        $mail->send();
                        
                        $success = "Registrierung erfolgreich! Bitte prüfen Sie Ihre E-Mails.";

                    } catch (Exception $e) {
                        error_log("Mail Error: ".$mail->ErrorInfo);
                        
                        // User bei Fehler löschen
                        $db->prepare("DELETE FROM users WHERE id = ?")->execute([$user_id]);
                        
                        $error = "E-Mail Versand fehlgeschlagen. Bitte versuchen Sie es später.";
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (PDOException $e) {
            error_log("Registration Error: " . $e->getMessage());
            $error = "Datenbankfehler. Bitte versuchen Sie es später erneut.";
        }
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        const updateStrengthMeter = () => {
            const password = document.getElementById('passwordInput').value;
            let strength = 0;
            
            if (password.length >= 12) strength += 25;
            if (password.length >= 16) strength += 15;
            if (/[A-Z]/.test(password)) strength += 15;
            if (/[a-z]/.test(password)) strength += 15;
            if (/[0-9]/.test(password)) strength += 15;
            if (/[\W_]/.test(password)) strength += 15;
            
            const meter = document.getElementById('passwordStrength');
            meter.style.width = Math.min(strength, 100) + '%';
            meter.style.backgroundColor = 
                strength < 50 ? '#dc3545' : 
                strength < 75 ? '#ffc107' : '#28a745';
        };

        document.getElementById('passwordInput').addEventListener('input', updateStrengthMeter);
    });
    </script>
```

```php
function getUserReports($db, $userId) {
    try {
        // SQL-Abfrage mit LEFT JOIN, um Berichte, Fragen und Antworten zu verknüpfen
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            SELECT r.id AS report_id, r.question_id, r.details, r.status, 
                   r.feedback, r.created_at, q.question_text,
                   a.answer_text, a.is_correct
            FROM reports r
            LEFT JOIN questions q ON r.question_id = q.id
            LEFT JOIN answers a ON q.id = a.question_id
            WHERE r.user_id = :user_id
            ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
        ");
        $stmt->execute([':user_id' => $userId]);

        // Alle Ergebnisse abrufen
        $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        // Daten strukturieren: Gruppierung der Antworten nach question_id
        $reports = [];
        foreach ($rows as $row) {
            $questionId = $row['question_id'];

            // Wenn die Frage noch nicht existiert, initialisiere sie
            if (!isset($reports[$questionId])) {
                $reports[$questionId] = [
                    'report_id' => $row['report_id'],
                    'question_id' => $row['question_id'],
                    'details' => $row['details'],
                    'status' => $row['status'],
                    'feedback' => $row['feedback'],
                    'created_at' => $row['created_at'],
                    'question_text' => $row['question_text'],
                    'answers' => [] // Platz für die Antworten
                ];
            }

            // Füge die Antwort hinzu (falls vorhanden)
            if (!empty($row['answer_text'])) {
                $reports[$questionId]['answers'][] = [
                    'answer_text' => $row['answer_text'],
                    'is_correct' => (bool)$row['is_correct'] // Konvertiere is_correct zu einem booleschen Wert
                ];
            }
        }

        // Rückgabe der strukturierten Berichte
        return array_values($reports); // Umstrukturierung in eine numerisch indizierte Liste
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Datenbankfehler: " . $e->getMessage());
        return [];
    }
}

<script>
$(document).ready(function () {

    // Debug
    $('.question-preview').on('click', function() {
        console.log('Question preview clicked');
        console.log('Question data:', $(this).data('question'));
        console.log('Answers data:', $(this).data('answers'));
        console.log('Raw answers data:', button.attr('data-answers'));
        console.log('Parsed answers data:', button.data('answers'));
        console.log('Question data:', question);
        console.log('Answers data:', answers);
        console.log('Answers data type:', typeof answers);
    });


    // Detail Modal Handler
    $('#detailModal').on('show.bs.modal', function (event) {
        const button = $(event.relatedTarget);
        const details = button.data('details');
        $(this).find('#fullDetails').text(details); // Das bleibt so, wenn du Details als reinen Text anzeigen möchtest
    });

    // Feedback Modal Handler
    $('#feedbackModal').on('show.bs.modal', function (event) {
        const button = $(event.relatedTarget);
        const feedback = button.data('feedback');

        // HTML-Entities dekodieren und Zeilenumbrüche korrekt behandeln
        var decodedFeedback = html_entity_decode(feedback);
        var formattedFeedback = nl2br(decodedFeedback);

        // Den dekodierten und formatierten Text ins Modal einfügen
        $(this).find('#fullFeedback').html(formattedFeedback); // Verwende .html() statt .text() zum Rendern von HTML-Inhalt
    });

// Question Modal Handler
    $('#questionModal').on('show.bs.modal', function (event) {
        const button = $(event.relatedTarget);

        // Frage und Antworten aus den data-* Attributen holen
        const question = button.data('question');
        const answers = button.data('answers'); // Kein JSON.parse mehr nötig, da jQuery dies automatisch macht

        // Frage anzeigen
        var decodedQuestion = html_entity_decode(question);
        $(this).find('#fullQuestion').html(decodedQuestion); // .html() rendert HTML-Tags

        // Antworten anzeigen
        let answerHtml = '';
        
        // Sicherstellen, dass answers existiert und ein Array ist
        if (answers && Array.isArray(answers)) {
            answers.forEach(answer => {
                const icon = answer.is_correct
                    ? '<span class="text-success">&#10004;</span>'
                    : '<span class="text-danger">&#10008;</span>';

                // Sicherstellen, dass answer_text existiert
                const answerText = answer.answer_text ? html_entity_decode(answer.answer_text) : '';
                answerHtml += `<li>${icon} ${answerText}</li>`;
            });
        } else {
            answerHtml = '<li>Keine Antworten vorhanden</li>';
        }

        $('#answerList').html(answerHtml); // Antworten ins Modal einfügen
    });
});

// Funktion zum Dekodieren von HTML-Entities
function html_entity_decode(str) {
    var doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(str, "text/html");
    return doc.documentElement.textContent;
}

// Funktion für Zeilenumbrüche in <br /> umwandeln
function nl2br(str) {
    return str.replace(/\n/g, "<br />");
}
</script>


</body>
</html>

```

```php
session_start();
require_once 'config.php';
// Überprüfen, ob der Benutzer angemeldet ist
checkUserRole(ROLE_USER);

if (isset($_SESSION['user_id']) && isset($_POST['confirm_reset'])) {
    $user_id = $_SESSION['user_id'];
    
    // Löschen der User-Statistik
    $sql = "DELETE FROM user_statistics WHERE user_id = ?";
    $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
    $stmt->execute([$user_id]);

    // Löschen der Tages- und Serienpunkte (Streak)
    $sql = "DELETE FROM user_daily_points WHERE user_id = ?";
    $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
    $stmt->execute([$user_id]);
    
    // Feedback für den Benutzer
    $_SESSION['message'] = "Ihre Statistik wurde erfolgreich zurückgesetzt.";
    header("Location: index.php");
    exit();
} else {
    // Wenn der Benutzer direkt auf diese Seite zugreift, ohne zu bestätigen
    header("Location: reset.php");
    exit();
}
?>
```

```php
<?php
/**
 * Reviewer Interface
 * Pfad: /review/index.php
 */
session_start();
require_once '../config.php';
require_once '../lib/php/QuestionReviewSystem.php';

// Prüfe Berechtigung (editor, manager oder admin können reviewen)
if (!isset($_SESSION['user_id']) || !in_array($_SESSION['user_role'], ['editor', 'manager', 'admin'])) {
    header('Location: ../index.php');
    exit;
}

$reviewSystem = new QuestionReviewSystem($db);
$userId = $_SESSION['user_id'];

// Hole vollständigen Namen
$stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT first_name, last_name FROM users WHERE id = ?");
$stmt->execute([$userId]);
$userInfo = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
$userName = trim($userInfo['first_name'] . ' ' . $userInfo['last_name']) ?: 'Reviewer';

// CSRF-Token
if (empty($_SESSION['csrf_token'])) {
    $_SESSION['csrf_token'] = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
}

// Handle AJAX-Requests
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST' && isset($_POST['action'])) {
    // CSRF-Validierung
    if (!isset($_POST['csrf_token']) || !hash_equals($_SESSION['csrf_token'], $_POST['csrf_token'])) {
        http_response_code(403);
        die(json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Ungültige Anfrage (CSRF-Token fehlt oder ungültig)']));
    }
    
    header('Content-Type: application/json');
    
    try {
        switch ($_POST['action']) {
            case 'claim':
                $result = $reviewSystem->claimReview($_POST['review_id'], $userId);
                echo json_encode($result);
                exit;
                
            case 'submit':
                $data = [
                    'question_text' => $_POST['question_text'],
                    'explanation' => $_POST['explanation'],
                    'answers' => json_decode($_POST['answers'], true),
                    'reviewer_note' => $_POST['reviewer_note'] ?? '',
                    'reviewer_feedback' => $_POST['reviewer_feedback'] ?? '',
                    'source' => $_POST['source'] ?? '',
                    'source_note' => $_POST['source_note'] ?? ''
                ];
                $result = $reviewSystem->submitReview($_POST['review_id'], $userId, $data);
                echo json_encode($result);
                exit;
                
            default:
                throw new Exception('Unbekannte Aktion: ' . $_POST['action']);
        }
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        http_response_code(500);
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Serverfehler: ' . $e->getMessage()]);
        exit;
    }
}

// Hole verfügbare Reviews
$availableReviews = $reviewSystem->getPoolReviews($userId);

// Hole meine Reviews in Bearbeitung
$myReviews = array_filter($availableReviews, function($r) use ($userId) {
    return $r['reviewer_id'] == $userId && $r['status'] == 'in_review';
});

// Hole Pool-Reviews
$poolReviews = array_filter($availableReviews, function($r) {
    return $r['status'] == 'pool';
});

// Session-Nachricht
$message = '';
if (isset($_SESSION['review_message'])) {
    $type = $_SESSION['review_message']['type'] ?? 'info';
    $text = $_SESSION['review_message']['text'] ?? '';
    $message = '<div class="alert alert-' . htmlspecialchars($type) . ' alert-dismissible fade show" role="alert">'
             . htmlspecialchars($text)
             . '<button type="button" class="close" data-dismiss="alert">&times;</button></div>';
    unset($_SESSION['review_message']);
}

// Deutsche Übersetzungen
$reportTypeLabels = [
    'suggestion' => 'Verbesserungsvorschlag',
    'typo' => 'Rechtschreibfehler',
    'wrong_answer' => 'Falsche Antwort',
    'wrong_question' => 'Falsche Frage'
];

$statusIcons = [

    'wrong_answer' => '<i class="fas fa-times-circle text-danger"></i>',
    'wrong_question' => '<i class="fas fa-question-circle text-muted"></i>'
];

    <script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.6.0.min.js"></script>

    <script>
        const csrfToken = '<?= $_SESSION['csrf_token'] ?>';
        
        function claimReview(reviewId) {
            if (!confirm('Diese Review-Aufgabe übernehmen?\n\nDu kannst dann die Frage bearbeiten und bei Genehmigung erhältst du +1 Punkt.')) return;
            
            $.post('', {
                action: 'claim',
                review_id: reviewId,
                csrf_token: csrfToken
            })
            .done(function(data) {
                if (data.success) {
                    alert('✅ ' + data.message);
                    location.reload();
                } else {
                    alert('❌ Fehler: ' + data.message);
                }
            })
            .fail(function(xhr, status, error) {
                alert('❌ Netzwerkfehler: ' + error + '\nStatus: ' + xhr.status + '\nAntwort: ' + xhr.responseText);
            });
        }
        
        function submitReview(event, reviewId) {
            event.preventDefault();
            
            const form = event.target;
            const formData = new FormData(form);
            
            // Sammle Antworten
            const answerTexts = formData.getAll('answer_text[]');
            const correctIndices = formData.getAll('is_correct[]').map(Number);
            
            if (answerTexts.length < 2) {
                alert('Es müssen mindestens 2 Antworten vorhanden sein!');
                return;
            }
            
            if (correctIndices.length === 0) {
                alert('Mindestens eine Antwort muss als korrekt markiert sein!');
                return;
            }
            
            const answers = answerTexts.map((text, idx) => ({
                answer_text: text,
                is_correct: correctIndices.includes(idx)
            }));
            
            // Sende Daten
            $.post('', {
                action: 'submit',
                review_id: reviewId,
                question_text: formData.get('question_text'),
                explanation: formData.get('explanation'),
                reviewer_note: formData.get('reviewer_note'),
                reviewer_feedback: formData.get('reviewer_feedback'),
                source: formData.get('source'),
                source_note: formData.get('source_note'),
                answers: JSON.stringify(answers),
                csrf_token: csrfToken
            })
            .done(function(data) {
                if (data.success) {
                    alert('✅ ' + data.message + '\n\n🎉 Sobald der Admin dein Review genehmigt, erhältst du +1 Punkt!\nDeine Aktivität wird zurückdatiert.');
                    location.reload();
                } else {
                    alert('❌ Fehler: ' + data.message);
                }
            })
            .fail(function(xhr, status, error) {
                alert('❌ Netzwerkfehler: ' + error + '\nStatus: ' + xhr.status + '\nAntwort: ' + xhr.responseText);
            });
        }
        
        function addAnswer(reviewId) {
            const container = $('#answers-' + reviewId);
            const newAnswer = $('<div class="answer-editor-item"></div>');
            newAnswer.html(`
                <input type="text" name="answer_text[]" class="form-control" placeholder="Antworttext" required>
                <input type="checkbox" name="is_correct[]" value="${container.children().length}" title="Richtige Antwort">
                <label class="mb-0">Falsch</label>
                <button type="button" class="btn btn-danger btn-sm" onclick="removeAnswer(this)">
                    <i class="fas fa-trash"></i>
                </button>
            `);
            container.append(newAnswer);
            
            // Event-Listener für Checkbox
            newAnswer.find('input[type="checkbox"]').on('change', function() {
                $(this).next('label').text(this.checked ? 'Richtig' : 'Falsch');
            });
        }
        
        function removeAnswer(button) {
            const container = $(button).closest('.answer-editor');
            if (container.children().length <= 2) {
                alert('Es müssen mindestens 2 Antworten vorhanden sein!');
                return;
            }
            $(button).closest('.answer-editor-item').remove();
            
            // Aktualisiere Checkbox-Werte
            container.find('.answer-editor-item').each(function(idx) {
                $(this).find('input[type="checkbox"]').val(idx);
            });
        }
        
        // Checkbox-Label aktualisieren beim Laden
        $(document).ready(function() {
            $('input[type="checkbox"][name="is_correct[]"]').on('change', function() {
                $(this).next('label').text(this.checked ? 'Richtig' : 'Falsch');
            });
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```php
function check_permissions($file, $required_perms) {
    if (!file_exists($file)) {

    $current_perms = fileperms($file) & 0777;
    return $current_perms == $required_perms;
}
```

```php
// Benutzerstatistik abrufen
function getUserStatistics($db, $userId) {
    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT 
            SUM(correct_count) as total_correct,
            SUM(incorrect_count) as total_incorrect,
            udp.current_points,
            udp.streak,
            udp.last_answered,
            COUNT(CASE WHEN DATE(us.last_shown) = CURDATE() THEN 1 END) as questions_today,
            SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(us.last_shown) = CURDATE() AND us.correct_count > 0 THEN us.correct_count ELSE 0 END) as correct_today,
            SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(us.last_shown) = CURDATE() AND us.incorrect_count > 0 THEN us.incorrect_count ELSE 0 END) as incorrect_today
            FROM user_statistics us
            LEFT JOIN user_daily_points udp ON udp.user_id = us.user_id
            WHERE us.user_id = ? 
            GROUP BY us.user_id");
        $stmt->execute([$userId]);
        return $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    } catch (PDOException $e) {
        error_log("Fehler beim Abrufen der Benutzerstatistik: " . $e->getMessage());
        return false;
    }
}


// Funktion für eine Rankingtabelle
function getAdminRanking($db, $userId) {
    // SQL-Abfrage: Nur Benutzer, die auch in der Tabelle 'user_daily_points' existieren, und keine Admins
    $query = "
    SELECT 
        u.first_name,
        u.last_name,
        SUM(us.correct_count) AS total_correct,
        SUM(us.incorrect_count) AS total_incorrect,
        udp.current_points,
        udp.streak,
        MAX(us.last_shown) AS last_shown,  -- MAX gibt das letzte Datum der Aktivität zurück
        COUNT(CASE WHEN DATE(us.last_shown) = CURDATE() THEN 1 END) AS questions_today
    FROM user_statistics us
    JOIN users u ON u.id = us.user_id  -- Verwendet 'u.id' statt 'u.user_id' für den Join
    LEFT JOIN user_daily_points udp ON udp.user_id = us.user_id
    WHERE udp.user_id IS NOT NULL  -- Nur Benutzer, die auch in user_daily_points existieren
    AND u.role != 'ADMIN'  -- Füge hier die Bedingung hinzu, dass Admins ausgeschlossen werden
    GROUP BY u.id, u.first_name, u.last_name, udp.current_points, udp.streak
    ORDER BY udp.streak DESC
    ";

    // Abfrage ausführen
    $result = $db->query($query);
    $rankingData = [];

    // Hier verwenden wir fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) statt fetch_assoc()
    while ($row = $result->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)) {
        // Berechne das Datum der letzten Aktivität (letztes 'last_shown' aus user_statistics)
        $row['last_active'] = $row['last_shown'] 
            ? date("d.m.Y, H:i", strtotime($row['last_shown'])) 
            : 'Noch keine Aktivität';

        // Füge das User-Objekt dem Ranking hinzu
        $rankingData[] = $row;
    }

    return $rankingData;
}

$userId = $_SESSION['user_id'];
$userStats = getUserStatistics($db, $userId);

if ($userStats) {
    $totalCorrect = $userStats['total_correct'] ?? 0;
    $totalIncorrect = $userStats['total_incorrect'] ?? 0;
    $totalQuestions = $totalCorrect + $totalIncorrect;

    function calculatePercentage($numerator, $denominator) {
        return ($denominator > 0) ? ($numerator / $denominator) * 100 : 0;
    }
    
    $todayCorrect = $userStats['correct_today'] ?? 0;
    $todayIncorrect = $userStats['incorrect_today'] ?? 0;
    $todayQuestions = $todayCorrect + $todayIncorrect;   
    $todayCorrectPercentage = calculatePercentage($todayCorrect, $todayQuestions);
    $todayIncorrectPercentage = calculatePercentage($todayIncorrect, $todayQuestions);
    $totalCorrectPercentage = calculatePercentage($totalCorrect, $totalQuestions);
    $totalIncorrectPercentage = calculatePercentage($totalIncorrect, $totalQuestions);   

    $currentPoints = $userStats['current_points'] ?? 0;
    $questionsToday = $userStats['questions_today'] ?? 0;
    $streak = $userStats['streak'] ?? 0;
    $lastActive = $userStats['last_answered'] 
                ? date('d.m.Y H:i', strtotime($userStats['last_answered'])) 
                : 'Noch keine Aktivität';
}

if ($userRole === ROLE_ADMIN) {
    $rankingData = getAdminRanking($db, $userId);  // Funktion, um das Ranking zu holen
}

            function getRankIcon(streak) {
                if (streak >= 20) {
                    return '<i class="fas fa-trophy rank-icon"></i>'; // Gold für hohe Streaks
                } else if (streak >= 10) {
                    return '<i class="fas fa-medal rank-icon"></i>'; // Silber für mittlere Streaks
                } else {
                    return '<i class="fas fa-star rank-icon"></i>'; // Bronze für niedrige Streaks
                }
            }

            // Tabelle befüllen
            rankingData.forEach((user, index) => {
                const streakClass = user.streak >= 20 ? 'streak-high' : user.streak >= 10 ? 'streak-medium' : 'streak-low';

                const row = `
                    <tr>
                        <td>${getRankIcon(user.streak)} ${index + 1}</td>
                        <td>${user.first_name}</td>
                        <td>${user.last_name}</td>
                        <td class="${streakClass}">${user.streak}</td>
                        <td>${user.total_correct}</td>
                        <td>${user.total_incorrect}</td>
                        <td>${user.current_points}</td>
                        <td>${user.questions_today}</td>
                        <td>${user.last_active}</td>
                    </tr>
                `;
                
                rankingBody.innerHTML += row;
            });
```

```php
<?php
session_start();
require_once __DIR__ . '/config.php';

// Funktion zum Umwandeln der Rollenbezeichner
function getRoleConstant($role) {
    switch (strtolower($role)) {
        case 'user': return ROLE_USER;
        case 'editor': return ROLE_EDITOR;
        case 'manager': return ROLE_MANAGER;
        case 'admin': return ROLE_ADMIN;
        default: return null;
    }
}

// Einstellungen aus der Datenbank holen
function getSettings() {
    global $db;
    $stmt = $db->query("SELECT name, value FROM settings");
    return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_KEY_PAIR);
}

try {
    // Einstellungen laden
    $settings = getSettings();
    
    // Erlaubte Rolle aus der Datenbank holen
    $allowedRoleSetting = $settings['question_submission_role'] ?? 'user';
    $allowedRole = getRoleConstant($allowedRoleSetting);

    // Aktuelle Benutzerrolle
    $userRole = $_SESSION['user_role'] ?? null;
    $userRoleConstant = getRoleConstant($userRole);

    // Überprüfung der Berechtigung
    $isAllowed = false;
    
    // Admins dürfen immer
    if ($userRoleConstant === ROLE_ADMIN) {
        $isAllowed = true;
    }
    // Wenn die erlaubte Rolle existiert
    elseif ($allowedRole !== null) {
        // Hier könntest du eine Rangfolge implementieren, z.B.:
        $roleHierarchy = [
            ROLE_USER => 1,
            ROLE_EDITOR => 2,
            ROLE_MANAGER => 3,
            ROLE_ADMIN => 4
        ];

        // Benutzer muss mindestens die erforderliche Rolle haben
        $isAllowed = ($roleHierarchy[$userRoleConstant] ?? 0) >= $roleHierarchy[$allowedRole];
    }

    if (!$isAllowed) {
        header('Location: index.php');
        exit;
    }

} catch (Exception $e) {
    die("Fehler bei der Berechtigungsprüfung: " . $e->getMessage());
}

// // Überprüfung der Benutzerrolle
// if (!isset($_SESSION['user_id']) || $_SESSION['user_role'] !== 'user') {
//     header('Location: index.php');
//     exit;
// }

// CSRF-Token Handling
if (empty($_SESSION['csrf_token'])) {
    $_SESSION['csrf_token'] = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
}

// Datenbankabfragen
try {
    $stmt = $db->query("SELECT value FROM settings WHERE name = 'submission_category_id'");
    $submissionCategoryId = $stmt->fetchColumn();
    
    if (!$submissionCategoryId) {
        throw new Exception('Einreichungskategorie nicht konfiguriert');
    }

    $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT name FROM categories WHERE id = ?");
    $stmt->execute([$submissionCategoryId]);
    $categoryName = $stmt->fetchColumn();

} catch (Exception $e) {
    die("Konfigurationsfehler: " . $e->getMessage());
}

// Formularverarbeitung
$message = '';
$messageType = 'info';
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    try {
        // CSRF Validierung
        if (!hash_equals($_SESSION['csrf_token'], $_POST['csrf_token'] ?? '')) {
            throw new Exception("Ungültige Anfrage");
        }

        // Datenaufbereitung
        $allowedTags = '<br><ul><li>';
      
        // $question_text = trim(htmlspecialchars($_POST['question_text'] ?? ''));
        // $explanation = trim(htmlspecialchars($_POST['explanation'] ?? ''));
        // $answers = array_filter(array_map(function($a) {
        //    return trim(htmlspecialchars($a));
        // }, $_POST['answers'] ?? []));
      
		$allowedTags = '<br><ul><li>';

        $question_text = trim(strip_tags($_POST['question_text'] ?? '', $allowedTags));
        $explanation   = trim(strip_tags($_POST['explanation'] ?? '', $allowedTags));
        $answers = array_filter(array_map(function($a) use ($allowedTags) {
            return trim(strip_tags($a, $allowedTags));
        }, $_POST['answers'] ?? []));

      
        $correct_answer = (int)($_POST['correct_answer'] ?? -1);

        // Validierung
        $errors = [];
        if (empty($question_text)) $errors[] = "Frage ist erforderlich";
        if (strlen($question_text) < 10) $errors[] = "Frage muss mindestens 10 Zeichen lang sein";
        if (count($answers) < 4) $errors[] = "Mindestens 4 Antworten benötigt";
        if ($correct_answer < 0 || $correct_answer >= count($answers)) $errors[] = "Korrekte Antwort auswählen";
        if (count($answers) !== count(array_unique($answers))) $errors[] = "Doppelte Antworten sind nicht erlaubt";

        if (!empty($errors)) {
            throw new Exception(implode("<br>", $errors));
        }

        // Erklärungsbestätigung
        if (empty($explanation) && !isset($_POST['confirm_no_explanation'])) {
            $message = 'Möchten Sie wirklich ohne Erklärung fortfahren?';
            $messageType = 'warning';
            throw new Exception($message);
        }

        // Datenbanktransaktion
        $db->beginTransaction();

        // Frage speichern
        $stmt = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO questions (question_text, explanation) VALUES (?, ?)");
        $stmt->execute([$question_text, $explanation]);
        $question_id = $db->lastInsertId();

        // Kategoriezuweisung
        $stmt = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO question_categories (question_id, category_id) VALUES (?, ?)");
        $stmt->execute([$question_id, $submissionCategoryId]);

        // Antworten speichern
        $stmt = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO answers (question_id, answer_text, is_correct) VALUES (?, ?, ?)");
        foreach ($answers as $index => $answer) {
            if (empty($answer)) continue;
            $is_correct = ($index === $correct_answer) ? 1 : 0;
            $stmt->execute([$question_id, $answer, $is_correct]);
        }

        // Einreichung protokollieren
        $stmt = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO question_submissions (user_id, question_id, status) VALUES (?, ?, 'pending')");
        $stmt->execute([$_SESSION['user_id'], $question_id]);

        $db->commit();
        $message = "Frage erfolgreich eingereicht!";
        $messageType = 'success';

    } catch (Exception $e) {
        $db->rollBack();
        $message = $e->getMessage();
        $messageType = 'danger';
    }
}

    <script>
        // Antworten dynamisch hinzufügen
        let answerCount = 4;
        function addAnswer() {
            const newIndex = $('.answer-input').length;
            const newAnswer = `
                <div class="answer-item mb-2">
                    <div class="input-group">
                        <input type="text" 
                            class="form-control answer-input" 
                            name="answers[]" 
                            placeholder="Antwort ${newIndex + 1}" 
                            required
                            minlength="2"
                            maxlength="255">
                        <div class="input-group-append">
                            <button type="button" 
                                class="btn btn-danger" 
                                onclick="$(this).closest('.answer-item').remove()">
                                <i class="fas fa-trash"></i>
                            </button>
                            <div class="input-group-text bg-white">
                                <div class="custom-control custom-radio">
                                    <input type="radio" 
                                        id="correct${newIndex}" 
                                        name="correct_answer" 
                                        value="${newIndex}" 
                                        class="custom-control-input" 
                                        required>
                                    <label class="custom-control-label" for="correct${newIndex}"></label>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="invalid-feedback">Antwort muss zwischen 2 und 255 Zeichen lang sein</div>
                </div>`;
            $('#answers-container').append(newAnswer);
            answerCount++;
        }

        // Formularvalidierung
        $('#questionForm').on('submit', function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const formData = new FormData(this);
            
            // Antworten sammeln
            const answers = [];
            $('.answer-input').each(function() {
                const val = $(this).val().trim();
                if (val) answers.push(val);
            });

            // Validierung
            const errors = [];
            if ($('[name="question_text"]').val().trim().length < 10) errors.push("Frage zu kurz");
            if (answers.length < 4) errors.push("Mindestens 4 Antworten benötigt");
            if ($('[name="correct_answer"]:checked').length === 0) errors.push("Korrekte Antwort auswählen");
            if (new Set(answers).size !== answers.length) errors.push("Doppelte Antworten entfernen");

            if (errors.length > 0) {
                $('#messageContainer').html(`
                    <div class="alert alert-danger alert-dismissible fade show" role="alert">
                        ${errors.join('<br>')}
                        <button type="button" class="close" data-dismiss="alert">
                            <span>&times;</span>
                        </button>
                    </div>
                `);
                return;
            }

            // Erklärungsbestätigung
            if ($('[name="explanation"]').val().trim() === '') {
                if (!confirm('Möchten Sie wirklich ohne Erklärung fortfahren?\nEine Erklärung verbessert das Lernerlebnis!')) {
                    return;
                }
                $('#confirm_no_explanation').val('1');
            }

            // Formular absenden
            $(this).unbind('submit').submit();
        });
    </script>
```

## File: upload.php

```php
<?php
set_time_limit(120);

if (!isset($_FILES['file']) || $_FILES['file']['error'] !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
    http_response_code(400);
    echo 'Keine Datei hochgeladen oder Upload-Fehler.';
    exit;
}

$content = file_get_contents($_FILES['file']['tmp_name']);
$lines = preg_split('/\r\n|\r|\n/', $content);

// Anfangskommentare ignorieren
$lines = array_filter($lines, function($line) {
    return !str_starts_with(trim($line), '#');
});

// CSV-Kopfzeile
$csv = "Frage;Antworten;Richtige;Erklärung;Kategorien\n";

// POST-Parameter
$category = isset($_POST['category']) ? trim($_POST['category']) : '';
$choiceCount = isset($_POST['mcCount']) ? max(3, min(6, (int)$_POST['mcCount'])) : 4;

foreach ($lines as $line) {
    $line = trim($line);
    if ($line === '') continue;

    if (!str_contains($line, '|')) continue;
    [$questionHtml, $correctRaw] = explode('|', $line, 2);
    $correctIndices = array_map('intval', array_map('trim', explode(',', $correctRaw)));
    if (empty($correctIndices)) continue;

    preg_match_all('/<li>(.*?)<\/li>/', $questionHtml, $matches);
    $answers = $matches[1] ?? [];
    $letters = array_slice(range('A', 'Z'), 0, count($answers));

    if (count($answers) < max($correctIndices)) continue;

    $questionText = preg_split('/<br\s*\/?>/i', $questionHtml)[0] ?? $questionHtml;
    $explanation = '';
    $isMC = count($correctIndices) > 1;

    if (!$isMC) {
        // Single Choice
        $csvAnswers = implode('|', array_map('trim', $answers));
        $csv .= "\"$questionText\";\"$csvAnswers\";{$correctIndices[0]};\"$explanation\";\"$category\"\n";
    } else {
        // Multiple Choice → Metaantworten
        $correctLetters = array_map(fn($i) => $letters[$i - 1], $correctIndices);
        $correctText = generateMetaAnswer($correctLetters);

        $metaAnswers = [$correctText];
        $usedCombos = [$correctText];

        $tries = 0;
        $maxTries = 100;

        while (count($metaAnswers) < $choiceCount && $tries < $maxTries) {
            $tries++;

            // Erzeuge zufällige Kombinationen von Buchstaben
            $randIndices = range(0, count($letters) - 1);
            shuffle($randIndices);

            $count = rand(1, min(4, count($letters)));
            $selected = array_slice($randIndices, 0, $count);
            sort($selected);

            $combo = generateMetaAnswer(array_map(fn($i) => $letters[$i], $selected));

            if (!in_array($combo, $usedCombos)) {
                $metaAnswers[] = $combo;
                $usedCombos[] = $combo;
            }
        }

        // Notfalls auffüllen
        while (count($metaAnswers) < $choiceCount) {
            $allShuffled = $letters;
            shuffle($allShuffled);
            $dummy = generateMetaAnswer(array_slice($allShuffled, 0, rand(1, min(4, count($letters)))));
            if (!in_array($dummy, $usedCombos)) {
                $metaAnswers[] = $dummy;
                $usedCombos[] = $dummy;
            }
        }

        shuffle($metaAnswers);
        $correctIndex = array_search($correctText, $metaAnswers) + 1;

        // Frage mit A., B., C.
        $mcQuestion = $questionText . "<br><br><ul>";
        foreach ($answers as $i => $a) {
            $mcQuestion .= "<li>{$letters[$i]}. " . trim($a) . "</li>";
        }
        $mcQuestion .= "</ul>";

        $csvAnswers = implode('|', array_map('trim', $metaAnswers));
        $csv .= "\"$mcQuestion\";\"$csvAnswers\";$correctIndex;\"$explanation\";\"$category\"\n";
    }
}

header('Content-Type: text/csv; charset=UTF-8');
header('Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="fragen-konvertiert.csv"');
echo "\xEF\xBB\xBF"; // UTF-8 BOM für Excel
echo $csv;
exit;

// 🔧 Meta-Antwort-Generator (z. B. "A und B", "A, B und C", "Alle Aussagen")
function generateMetaAnswer(array $letters): string {
    sort($letters);
    $count = count($letters);

    if ($count === 0) return '';
    if ($count === 1) return $letters[0];
    if ($count === 2) return "{$letters[0]} und {$letters[1]}";
    if ($count === 3) return "{$letters[0]}, {$letters[1]} und {$letters[2]}";
    if ($count === 4) return "{$letters[0]}, {$letters[1]}, {$letters[2]} und {$letters[3]}";
    
    return "Alle Aussagen"; // Ab 5 Aussagen: neutraler Sammelbegriff
}
?>
```

```php
    // Verbindung zur Datenbank herstellen
    $conn = new PDO("mysql:host=" . DB_HOST . ";dbname=" . DB_NAME, DB_USER, DB_PASS);
    $conn->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);

    // Überprüfen, ob die Spalte 'logged_in' existiert
    $stmt = $conn->prepare("SHOW COLUMNS FROM users LIKE 'logged_in'");
    $stmt->execute();
    $loggedInExists = $stmt->rowCount() > 0;

    // Überprüfen, ob die Spalte 'logged_out' existiert
    $stmt = $conn->prepare("SHOW COLUMNS FROM users LIKE 'logged_out'");
    $stmt->execute();
    $loggedOutExists = $stmt->rowCount() > 0;

    // Überprüfen, ob die Spalte 'last_login' existiert
    $stmt = $conn->prepare("SHOW COLUMNS FROM users LIKE 'last_login'");
    $stmt->execute();
    $lastLoginExists = $stmt->rowCount() > 0;

    // Spalte 'logged_in' hinzufügen, falls sie nicht existiert
    if (!$loggedInExists) {
        $conn->exec("ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN logged_in BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE");
        echo "Spalte 'logged_in' erfolgreich hinzugefügt.<br>";
    } else {
        echo "Spalte 'logged_in' existiert bereits.<br>";
    }

    // Spalte 'logged_out' hinzufügen, falls sie nicht existiert
    if (!$loggedOutExists) {
        $conn->exec("ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN logged_out DATETIME DEFAULT NULL");
        echo "Spalte 'logged_out' erfolgreich hinzugefügt.<br>";
    } else {
        echo "Spalte 'logged_out' existiert bereits.<br>";
    }

    // Spalte 'last_login' hinzufügen, falls sie nicht existiert
    if (!$lastLoginExists) {
        $conn->exec("ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN last_login DATETIME DEFAULT NULL");
        echo "Spalte 'last_login' erfolgreich hinzugefügt.<br>";
    } else {
        echo "Spalte 'last_login' existiert bereits.<br>";
    }

} catch (PDOException $e) {
    echo "Fehler: " . $e->getMessage();
}
?>
```
